name.en: Mao Zedong Issues “The Last Battle against the Japanese”

aliases.en: The Last Battle against the Japanese

summary.zh: 毛泽东发表声明，号召全国规模反攻。
summary.en: Mao Zedong issued a statement calling for a nationwide counter-offensive.

description.zh:
1945 年 8 月 9 日，毛泽东在延安发表《对日寇的最后一战》声明，指出对日战争已处在最后阶段，号召中国人民的一切抗日力量举行全国规模的反攻，八路军、新四军及其他人民军队应在一切可能条件下，对不愿投降的侵略者及其走狗实行广泛进攻。

声明文本以《毛泽东选集》第三卷所收版本为准。
description.en:
On 9 August 1945 Mao Zedong issued the statement “The Last Battle against the Japanese” in Yan’an, declaring that the war against Japan had entered its final stage and calling on all Chinese anti-Japanese forces to launch a nationwide counter-offensive. The Eighth Route Army, New Fourth Army, and other people’s forces were to attack widely wherever the invaders and their collaborators refused to surrender.

The text follows the version collected in Selected Works of Mao Zedong, vol. 3.

sources.title: 《伟大胜利——中国受降档案》第七集
sources.author: 中央档案馆

name.en: The Eighth Route Army Launches the General Counter-Offensive

summary.zh: 朱德连续发布七道反攻命令，八路军向华北日伪军全面进攻。
summary.en: Zhu De issued seven counter-offensive orders; the Eighth Route Army attacked Japanese and puppet forces across North China.

description.zh:
1945 年 8 月 10 日至 11 日，八路军总司令朱德以延安总部名义连续发布七道反攻命令，要求各解放区抗日武装向附近城镇、交通要道的日伪军送出通牒，限期缴械，对拒绝投降者坚决消灭；同时命令晋绥、晋察冀、山东和冀热辽部队向东北及华北各城市推进。各解放区部队随即展开全面反攻，至 9 月 2 日共解放县以上城市 150 座。

命令序号与时间以中央档案馆藏件为准，战果统计为通行说法。
description.en:
From 10 to 11 August 1945 Zhu De, commander-in-chief of the Eighth Route Army, issued seven counter-offensive orders in the name of the Yan’an headquarters. Anti-Japanese forces in the liberated areas were to send ultimatums to Japanese and puppet troops in nearby towns and along transport routes, demand surrender within a set time, and destroy those who refused. Forces in the Jin-Sui, Jin-Cha-Ji, Shandong, and Ji-Re-Liao areas were ordered to advance toward cities in North China and the Northeast. The liberated areas then launched a general counter-offensive; by 2 September they had liberated 150 county-level towns and cities.

Order numbers and times follow the documents held by the Central Archives; the tally of liberated cities follows conventional accounts.

summary.zh: 日本天皇广播《终战诏书》，宣布接受《波茨坦公告》，中国抗日战争取得胜利。
summary.en: The Japanese emperor broadcast the rescript accepting the Potsdam Declaration, bringing victory in China’s war of resistance.

description.zh:
1945 年 8 月 15 日，日本天皇裕仁通过广播发布《终战诏书》，宣布接受中美英苏四国发表的《波茨坦公告》，实际上宣布无条件投降。中国各地举行庆祝活动，抗日战争取得胜利。

本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 15 August 1945, Emperor Hirohito broadcast the Imperial Rescript on the Termination of the War, accepting the Potsdam Declaration issued by China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union—in effect announcing unconditional surrender. Celebrations took place across China, marking victory in the war of resistance.

This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

name.en: Signing of the Japanese Instrument of Surrender

place.zh: 日本东京湾美国“密苏里”号战列舰

summary.zh: 日本代表在东京湾签署投降书，第二次世界大战正式结束。
summary.en: Japanese representatives signed the instrument of surrender in Tokyo Bay, formally ending the Second World War.

description.zh:
1945 年 9 月 2 日，日本政府代表在东京湾美国“密苏里”号战列舰上签署投降书，中、美、英、苏等同盟国代表签字接受。至此，中国抗日战争与第二次世界大战正式结束。

本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 2 September 1945, Japanese government representatives signed the instrument of surrender aboard the USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay, and representatives of the Allied powers, including China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union, accepted it. China’s war of resistance and the Second World War formally ended.

This is a political event with no route drawn; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: Surrender Ceremony in the China Theater

summary.zh: 中国战区受降仪式在南京举行，何应钦代表中国接受冈村宁次投降。
summary.en: The surrender ceremony for the China Theater was held in Nanjing, where He Yingqin accepted the surrender of Okamura Yasuji on behalf of China.

description.zh:
1945 年 9 月 9 日，中国战区受降仪式在南京中央军校大礼堂举行。中国陆军总司令何应钦代表中国战区最高统帅接受日本驻华派遣军总司令冈村宁次投降，在华日军向中国缴械。

政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 9 September 1945 the surrender ceremony for the China Theater was held in the auditorium of the Central Military Academy in Nanjing. He Yingqin, commander-in-chief of the Chinese Army, accepted the surrender of Okamura Yasuji, commander of the Japanese forces in China, on behalf of the supreme command of the China Theater, and Japanese troops in China laid down their arms.

A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

place.zh: 海南琼山天尾港（今海口西北）
place.en: Tianwei Port, Qiongshan, Hainan (northwest of present-day Haikou)

summary.zh: 日军台湾混成旅团在琼山天尾港登陆，当日攻占海口、府城。
summary.en: The Japanese Taiwan Mixed Brigade landed at Tianwei Port in Qiongshan and took Haikou and Fucheng the same day.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 10 日凌晨，日军第21军台湾混成旅团数千人，在海军第5舰队 30 余艘舰艇、50 余架飞机掩护下，从海口西北的琼山县天尾港强行登陆；当日攻占府城、海口。岛上中国守军仅有保安第5旅等约 3900 人，抵抗后撤往定安山区。日军随后向文昌、定安、嘉积、儋县等沿海城镇推进，至 4 月完成首轮占领。日期、兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Before dawn on 10 February 1939, several thousand troops of the Japanese 21st Army’s Taiwan Mixed Brigade, covered by more than 30 warships and 50 aircraft of the 5th Fleet, landed at Tianwei Port in Qiongshan, northwest of Haikou, and took Fucheng and Haikou that day. The Chinese defenders on the island, mainly the 5th Security Brigade, numbered only about 3,900 and withdrew to the Ding’an mountains after resisting. Japanese forces then pushed toward Wenchang, Ding’an, Jiaji and Xinzhou in Danxian, completing the first phase of occupation by April. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军攻占海口、府城，琼崖守军撤往定安山区。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Haikou and Fucheng; the Qiongya defenders withdrew to the Ding’an mountains.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 10 日，日军登陆后分左右两翼进攻：右翼台湾步兵第一联队攻占府城，左翼第二联队攻占海口，秀英炮台守军曾开炮还击。守军保安第15团、第11团等因众寡悬殊撤退。海口、府城失守后，琼崖当局撤往定安山区。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 10 February 1939 the landing force attacked in two wings: the right wing, the 1st Taiwan Infantry Regiment, took Fucheng, while the left wing, the 2nd Regiment, took Haikou; the Xiuying battery returned fire. The defenders, including the 15th and 11th Security Regiments, withdrew after being heavily outnumbered. The Qiongya authorities then retreated into the Ding’an mountains. Dates follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Japanese capture of Sanya and Yulin

summary.zh: 日本海军陆战队在三亚湾登陆，占领三亚、榆林、崖城。
summary.en: Japanese naval landing forces came ashore at Sanya Bay and took Sanya, Yulin and Yacheng.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 14 日拂晓，日本海军第5舰队载佐世保海军陆战队约 2500 人进入三亚湾，登陆后当日占领三亚、榆林，深夜占领崖城。日军随后在榆林、三亚设海军基地和航空场，控制海南南部。日期、兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: At dawn on 14 February 1939 the Japanese 5th Fleet carried about 2,500 Sasebo naval landing troops into Sanya Bay; they took Sanya and Yulin that day and Yacheng late that night. Japan subsequently established naval bases and airfields at Yulin and Sanya and controlled southern Hainan. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 琼崖抗日独立队在潭口渡口阻击东进日军，打响琼崖抗战第一枪。
summary.en: The Qiongya Independent Corps blocked the Japanese advance at Tankou Ford, firing the first shots of the Qiongya resistance.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 10 日，日军一部自海口东渡南渡江向文昌推进，琼崖抗日独立队第一中队在潭口渡口阻击，激战至黄昏后撤出。这是中共领导的琼崖抗日武装对日军的首次正面阻击，被称为「琼崖抗战第一枪」。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 10 February 1939 a Japanese detachment crossed the Nandu River east of Haikou toward Wenchang. The 1st Company of the Qiongya Independent Corps blocked it at Tankou Ford and fought until dusk before withdrawing. It was the first direct engagement between the CCP-led Qiongya forces and the Japanese, known as the “first shot of the Qiongya resistance.” Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Japanese seizure of the Shilu iron mine

summary.zh: 日军占领石碌铁矿，随后修铁路、建八所港，掠夺海南铁矿资源。
summary.en: Japan seized the Shilu iron mine, then built a railway and the Basuo port to extract Hainan’s iron ore.

description.zh: 1940 年 3 月 15 日，日军占领昌江石碌（今属昌江黎族自治县），此后开发石碌铁矿、修建石碌—八所港铁路和八所港，强征大批劳工，将铁矿石运往日本。田独、石碌、羊角岭水晶和那大锡矿是日军在海南重点掠夺的资源。据综述，1939—1945 年海南开采铁矿砂 338 万吨，其中 282 万吨运往日本；数字为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 15 March 1940 Japanese forces occupied Shilu in Changjiang (now Changjiang Li Autonomous County). They subsequently developed the Shilu iron mine, built the Shilu–Basuo railway and Basuo port, conscripted large numbers of labourers and shipped iron ore to Japan. Tian du, Shilu, the Yangjiaoling crystal mine and the Nada tin mine were among the resources Japan exploited most intensively in Hainan. According to survey accounts, 3.38 million tons of iron ore were mined in Hainan in 1939–1945, of which 2.82 million tons were shipped to Japan; these figures follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Establishment of the Hainan Guard District

summary.zh: 日本海军将海南岛根据地队升格为海南警备府，强化对海南的军事控制。
summary.en: The Japanese navy upgraded the Hainan Island Base Force to the Hainan Guard District, tightening its military control of the island.

description.zh:
1941 年 4 月 10 日，日本海军将海南岛根据地队升格为海南警备府，隶属中国方面舰队，统辖海口、三亚、榆林等要港和驻岛海军陆战队，把海南建成封锁华南海上交通、进窥法属印度支那和南进的基地。日军在岛上修筑机场、据点，实施「扫荡」与殖民统治。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。

本事件为建制事件，不绘制路线。
description.en:
On 10 April 1941 the Japanese navy upgraded the Hainan Island Base Force to the Hainan Guard District under the China Area Fleet, commanding the key ports of Haikou, Sanya and Yulin and the naval landing forces on the island. Hainan became a base for blockading South China’s sea lanes and for Japan’s southward advance toward French Indochina. Japanese forces built airfields and strongpoints and conducted “mopping-up” operations and colonial rule. Dates follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

This is an institutional event; no route is drawn.

summary.zh: 九一八事变次日，日军关东军进攻长春，中国守军抵抗后撤退，长春陷落。
summary.en: The day after the Mukden Incident, Japanese Kwantung Army forces attacked Changchun; the Chinese defenders withdrew and the city fell.

description.zh: 1931 年 9 月 19 日，关东军第 2 师团等部向长春发动进攻，驻长春中国军队与日军激战后退往吉林方向，长春当日陷落。长春是南满铁路与中东铁路交会点，沦陷后成为日军控制吉林、黑龙江的重要基地。日期与作战经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese 2nd Division and other Kwantung Army units attacked Changchun. The Chinese garrison fought briefly and withdrew toward Jilin, and the city fell the same day. As the junction of the South Manchuria and Chinese Eastern railways, Changchun became an important base for Japanese control of Jilin and Heilongjiang. Dates and operational details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军占领长春后沿吉长铁路东进，吉林省城吉林陷落。
summary.en: After taking Changchun, Japanese forces advanced east along the Jilin–Changchun railway and occupied Jilin City.

description.zh: 1931 年 9 月 21 日，日军第 2 师团一部沿吉长铁路进攻吉林省城吉林，代理吉林省主席熙洽下令不抵抗，日军占领吉林。吉林沦陷使日军迅速控制吉林省大部。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 21 September 1931 a detachment of the Japanese 2nd Division advanced along the Jilin–Changchun railway toward Jilin City. Acting Jilin governor Xi Qia ordered no resistance, and the Japanese occupied the city, rapidly extending their control over most of Jilin province. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 江桥抗战后，日军第 2 师团等部攻占黑龙江省城齐齐哈尔。
summary.en: After the Jiangqiao resistance, Japanese forces captured Qiqihar, the capital of Heilongjiang.

description.zh: 1931 年 11 月，日军第 2 师团等部沿洮昂铁路北犯，在嫩江江桥遭马占山部抗击。11 月 19 日，日军占领齐齐哈尔，黑龙江省城沦陷。江桥抗战是九一八后中国军队有组织的抵抗之一。日期与兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In November 1931 the Japanese 2nd Division and other units advanced north along the Tao’ang railway and met resistance from Ma Zhanshan’s forces at the Nen River bridge. On 19 November the Japanese occupied Qiqihar, the provincial capital. The Jiangqiao resistance was one of the first organized Chinese military stands after the Mukden Incident. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日本与伪满洲国签订《日满议定书》，正式承认伪满并取得驻军、经营铁路等权益。
summary.en: Japan and the puppet state of Manchukuo signed the Japan–Manchukuo Protocol, formalizing Japanese recognition and securing garrison and railway rights.

description.zh: 1932 年 9 月 15 日，日本驻伪满特命全权大使武藤信义与伪满洲国总理郑孝胥在长春签订《日满议定书》。日本据此承认伪满洲国，并取得在伪满驻军、管理铁路和开发资源等特权，东北进一步被纳入日本殖民统治体系。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 15 September 1932 Japanese ambassador Mutō Nobuyoshi and Manchukuo premier Zheng Xiaoxu signed the Japan–Manchukuo Protocol in Changchun. Japan recognized the puppet state and secured privileges including troop stationing, railway management and resource development, drawing Northeast China further into its colonial system. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese garrison troops carried out a massacre at Pingdingshan near Fushun, killing a large number of miners and civilians.

description.zh: 1932 年 9 月 16 日，日军抚顺守备队以报复抗日义勇军袭击为由，包围抚顺平顶山村落，屠杀村民并焚毁房屋。具体死难人数各说不一，通行说法为三千人左右，待页码级核对。本事件为惨案，不绘路线。
description.en: On 16 September 1932 Japanese garrison troops at Fushun, claiming retaliation for an attack by anti-Japanese volunteers, surrounded the village of Pingdingshan, massacred residents and burned the houses. Accounts of the death toll differ; the conventional figure is about 3,000 and awaits page-level verification. As a massacre, this event is not drawn as a route.

summary.zh: 卢沟桥事变后日军增兵华北，第 29 军撤离，北平沦陷。
summary.en: After the Marco Polo Bridge Incident Japan reinforced North China; the 29th Army withdrew and Beiping fell.

description.zh: 1937 年 7 月 28 日，日军向北平南苑、北苑等地发动总攻，第 29 军副军长佟麟阁、第 132 师师长赵登禹殉国。7 月 29 日，第 29 军奉命撤离北平，日军占领北平。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 28 July 1937 Japanese forces launched a general assault on Nanyuan, Beiyuan and other positions around Beiping. 29th Army deputy commander Tong Linge and 132nd Division commander Zhao Dengyu were killed. On 29 July the 29th Army withdrew on orders and the Japanese occupied Beiping. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军进攻天津，中国守军撤退，天津沦陷。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Tianjin; the Chinese defenders withdrew and the city fell.

description.zh: 1937 年 7 月 29 日至 30 日，日军第 20 师团等部进攻天津，中国第 38 师等部抵抗后撤离。7 月 30 日天津沦陷，日军控制海河与天津港。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: From 29 to 30 July 1937 the Japanese 20th Division and other units attacked Tianjin. The Chinese 38th Division and other forces resisted and then withdrew. Tianjin fell on 30 July, giving Japan control of the Hai River and Tianjin port. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 日本海军封锁中国海岸
name.en: Japanese Naval Blockade of the China Coast

summary.zh: 日本海军宣布封锁中国中部沿海，切断中国海上补给。
summary.en: The Japanese navy declared a blockade of China’s central coast, cutting maritime supply lines.

description.zh: 1937 年 8 月 25 日，日本海军第三舰队宣布封锁上海至汕头之间的中国海岸，禁止中国船只航行，随后将封锁范围扩大至中国全部沿海。封锁与日军占领沿海港口相配合，切断了中国经海路输入军需物资的主要通道。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 25 August 1937 the Japanese 3rd Fleet declared a blockade of the Chinese coast between Shanghai and Shantou, barring Chinese shipping; the blockade was later extended to the entire Chinese coast. Together with the seizure of coastal ports, it cut China’s main maritime route for importing military supplies. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 淞沪会战后期中国军队西撤，日军占领上海。
summary.en: At the end of the Battle of Shanghai the Chinese army withdrew west and Japanese forces occupied the city.

description.zh: 1937 年 11 月，日军第 10 军在金山卫登陆，迂回中国守军侧后。11 月 12 日，中国军队撤离上海，日军占领上海除租界外地区。上海沦陷使日军获得进攻南京的基地。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In November 1937 the Japanese 10th Army landed at Jinshanwei and turned the Chinese flank. On 12 November the Chinese forces withdrew from Shanghai and the Japanese occupied the city outside the foreign concessions. The fall of Shanghai gave Japan a base for the advance on Nanjing. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 伪中华民国临时政府成立
name.en: Establishment of the Provisional Government of the Republic of China

summary.zh: 日本在北平扶植成立伪中华民国临时政府。
summary.en: Japan established the puppet Provisional Government of the Republic of China in Beiping.

description.zh: 1937 年 12 月 14 日，日本在北平扶植成立伪中华民国临时政府，以王克敏为首，管辖华北日占区。伪政权名义上“自治”，实际受日本华北方面军控制。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 14 December 1937 Japan installed the puppet Provisional Government of the Republic of China in Beiping under Wang Kemin to administer the Japanese-occupied areas of North China. Nominally autonomous, it was controlled by the Japanese North China Area Army. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 10 军自金山卫登陆后南下，杭州沦陷。
summary.en: After landing at Jinshanwei, the Japanese 10th Army advanced south and captured Hangzhou.

description.zh: 1937 年 11 月，日军第 10 军在金山卫登陆，沿沪杭线西进。12 月 24 日，日军占领杭州，中国守军撤往钱塘江以南。杭州沦陷后，中日两军隔钱塘江对峙。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In November 1937 the Japanese 10th Army landed at Jinshanwei and advanced west along the Shanghai–Hangzhou line. On 24 December Japanese forces occupied Hangzhou and the Chinese defenders withdrew south of the Qiantang River, where the two sides faced each other across the river. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 2 军渡过黄河，占领山东省会济南。
summary.en: The Japanese 2nd Army crossed the Yellow River and occupied Jinan, the Shandong provincial capital.

description.zh: 1937 年 12 月，日军第 2 军自河北南下，在济阳、泺口一带渡过黄河。12 月 27 日，日军占领济南，山东省主席韩复榘此前擅自撤退。济南沦陷使日军控制胶济铁路西端。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In December 1937 the Japanese 2nd Army advanced south from Hebei and crossed the Yellow River near Jiyang and Luokou. On 27 December it occupied Jinan after Shandong chairman Han Fuju had withdrawn without orders. The fall of Jinan gave Japan the western end of the Jiaoji railway. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 伪中华民国维新政府成立
name.en: Establishment of the Reformed Government of the Republic of China

summary.zh: 日本在南京扶植成立伪中华民国维新政府。
summary.en: Japan established the puppet Reformed Government of the Republic of China in Nanjing.

description.zh: 1938 年 3 月 28 日，日本在南京扶植成立伪中华民国维新政府，以梁鸿志为首，管辖华中日占区。伪维新政府与北平伪临时政府并立，均受日军控制。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 28 March 1938 Japan installed the puppet Reformed Government of the Republic of China in Nanjing under Liang Hongzhi to administer the Japanese-occupied areas of Central China. It coexisted with the Beiping provisional regime and was likewise controlled by the Japanese military. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军海军陆战队在厦门五通登陆，厦门保卫战开始。
summary.en: Japanese naval landing forces came ashore at Wutong on Xiamen Island, beginning the battle for Xiamen.

description.zh: 1938 年 5 月 10 日凌晨，日军以航母舰载机、军舰炮火掩护，海军陆战队在厦门东北五通一带登陆。中国守军第 75 师守备队、壮丁队和保安警察抵抗，厦门保卫战展开。日期与登陆点据厦门市档案馆藏电报，待页码级核对。
description.en: Before dawn on 10 May 1938, covered by carrier aircraft and naval gunfire, Japanese naval landing forces came ashore at Wutong in northeastern Xiamen. Chinese 75th Division garrison troops, militia and police resisted, opening the battle for Xiamen. The date and landing site follow a telegram held by the Xiamen Municipal Archives and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 厦门保卫战持续三昼夜，厦门全岛沦陷。
summary.en: After three days of fighting, the whole of Xiamen Island fell to Japanese forces.

description.zh: 1938 年 5 月 10 日至 13 日，日军在厦门岛逐次推进，中国守军因兵力悬殊撤退。5 月 13 日傍晚，日军控制厦门全岛，厦门沦陷。日期据厦门市档案馆藏档案与地方志，待页码级核对。
description.en: From 10 to 13 May 1938 Japanese forces advanced across Xiamen Island; the outnumbered Chinese garrison withdrew. By the evening of 13 May the Japanese controlled the whole island and Xiamen fell. The date follows archival and local gazetteer accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: At the end of the Battle of Xuzhou the Chinese forces broke out and Japanese troops occupied the city.

description.zh: 1938 年 5 月，日军南北夹击徐州。中国第五战区部队在完成台儿庄作战后逐次转移。5 月 19 日，日军占领徐州，陇海、津浦两铁路交会点失守。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In May 1938 Japanese forces attacked Xuzhou from north and south. After the Taierzhuang fighting, Chinese 5th War Zone troops withdrew in stages. On 19 May the Japanese occupied Xuzhou, seizing the junction of the Longhai and Jin-Pu railways. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军波田支队等部攻占安庆，武汉会战开始。
summary.en: Japanese forces including the Bohati Detachment captured Anqing, opening the Battle of Wuhan.

description.zh: 1938 年 6 月 12 日，日军波田支队在海军配合下攻占安庆，武汉会战拉开序幕。安庆是长江中游重要港口，失守后日军沿长江北岸西进。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 12 June 1938 the Japanese Bohati Detachment, supported by the navy, captured Anqing, opening the Battle of Wuhan. Anqing was an important port on the middle Yangtze; after its fall the Japanese advanced west along the north bank. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军攻占九江，武汉会战外围作战扩大。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Jiujiang, widening the outer operations of the Battle of Wuhan.

description.zh: 1938 年 7 月 26 日，日军第 106 师团等部攻占九江，中国守军退守庐山、瑞昌一线。九江沦陷后，日军沿南浔铁路南下，武汉会战进入激烈阶段。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 26 July 1938 the Japanese 106th Division and other units captured Jiujiang; Chinese defenders fell back to Lushan and Ruichang. After the fall of Jiujiang the Japanese advanced south along the Nanxun railway and the Battle of Wuhan entered its intense phase. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Establishment of the Kōain (Asia Development Board)

summary.zh: 日本设立兴亚院，统一管理在华占领区的政治、经济事务。
summary.en: Japan established the Kōain to centralize political and economic administration of its occupied areas in China.

description.zh: 1938 年 12 月 16 日，日本设立兴亚院，作为内阁直属机构，统一指导在华占领区的政治、经济和文化事务，并在北平、上海、汉口等地设联络部。兴亚院成立标志着日本对华殖民统治机构化。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 16 December 1938 Japan established the Kōain as a cabinet-level body to coordinate political, economic and cultural affairs in its occupied areas in China, with liaison offices in Beiping, Shanghai and Hankou. Its creation marked the institutionalization of Japan’s colonial rule in China. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 18 师团在宝安登陆，占领南头、深圳，切断粤港交通。
summary.en: The Japanese 18th Division landed in Bao’an and occupied Nantou and Shenzhen, cutting the Guangzhou–Hong Kong land link.

description.zh: 1939 年 8 月 13 日，日军第 18 师团自虎门出发，在宝安蛇口、西乡等地登陆。8 月 15 日占领南头城，随后控制深圳镇，切断广州与香港之间的陆路交通。日期据《深圳通史》与日本防卫省战史档案，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 13 August 1939 the Japanese 18th Division moved from Humen and landed at Shekou and Xixiang in Bao’an. It occupied Nantou on 15 August and then controlled Shenzhen town, cutting the overland link between Guangzhou and Hong Kong. The date follows the Shenzhen History and Japanese defense archives and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 11 军攻占南昌，南昌会战结束。
summary.en: The Japanese 11th Army captured Nanchang, ending the Battle of Nanchang.

description.zh: 1939 年 3 月 17 日，日军第 11 军向南昌发动进攻，中国第 9 战区部队抵抗。3 月 27 日，日军占领南昌，南昌会战结束。日军随后遭到中国军队反攻，4 月一度撤出，5 月再次占领。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 17 March 1939 the Japanese 11th Army attacked Nanchang and Chinese 9th War Zone troops resisted. On 27 March the Japanese occupied Nanchang, ending the battle. Chinese counterattacks forced a temporary withdrawal in April before the Japanese retook the city in May. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军在汕头港外妈屿岛登陆，突袭汕头。
summary.en: Japanese forces landed on Mayu Island outside Shantou harbour and attacked the city.

description.zh: 1939 年 6 月 21 日凌晨，日军第 21 军第 104 师团一部及海军陆战队共约万人，在汕头港外妈屿岛、达濠岛登陆，分路进攻汕头市区。中国守军独立第 9 旅、保安第 5 团等部抵抗。日期与兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Before dawn on 21 June 1939, elements of the Japanese 21st Army’s 104th Division and naval landing forces, about 10,000 men in conventional accounts, landed on Mayu and Dahao islands outside Shantou harbour and attacked the city by several routes. Chinese 9th Independent Brigade and 5th Security Regiment troops resisted. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军攻占汕头市区，汕头沦陷。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured central Shantou and the city fell.

description.zh: 1939 年 6 月 21 日日军登陆后，22 日凌晨三路攻入汕头市区，汕头沦陷。汕头是广州失守后华南最后一个对外通商口岸，沦陷使中国经潮韶公路输入物资的通道被切断。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: After landing on 21 June 1939, Japanese forces entered central Shantou by three routes in the early hours of 22 June, and the city fell. Shantou was the last major external trading port in South China after the fall of Guangzhou; its loss cut China’s supply route via the Chaozhou–Shaoguan road. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces advanced north from Shantou and captured Chaozhou.

description.zh: 1939 年 6 月 25 日，日军自汕头分两路进攻潮州，在枫溪、浮洋一带遭中国守军独立第 9 旅等部阻击。6 月 27 日上午，日军攻入潮州城，潮州沦陷。日期据汕头市档案馆档案，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 25 June 1939 Japanese forces advanced from Shantou toward Chaozhou in two columns and met resistance from the Chinese 9th Independent Brigade near Fengxi and Fuyang. On the morning of 27 June they entered Chaozhou, which then fell. The date follows Shantou municipal archives and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 伪蒙疆联合自治政府成立
name.en: Establishment of the Mengjiang United Autonomous Government

summary.zh: 日本扶植的伪蒙疆联合自治政府在张家口成立。
summary.en: Japan established the puppet Mengjiang United Autonomous Government in Zhangjiakou.

description.zh: 1939 年 9 月 1 日，日本将察南、晋北、蒙古联盟三个伪政权合并，在张家口成立伪蒙疆联合自治政府，以德穆楚克栋鲁普（德王）为主席。伪政权受日本驻蒙军控制，是日本统治察哈尔、绥远沦陷区的重要工具。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 1 September 1939 Japan merged the three puppet regimes of South Chahar, North Shanxi and the Mongol Federation into the Mengjiang United Autonomous Government in Zhangjiakou, with Demchugdongrub (Prince De) as chairman. Controlled by the Japanese garrison army in Mongolia, it was an instrument of Japanese rule over occupied Chahar and Suiyuan. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: After landing at Qinzhou Bay, Japanese forces captured Nanning, opening the Battle of South Guangxi.

description.zh: 1939 年 11 月 15 日，日军第 5 师团等在钦州湾登陆，沿邕钦公路北犯。11 月 24 日，日军占领南宁，随后进攻昆仑关。中国军队调集兵力反攻，桂南会战展开。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 15 November 1939 the Japanese 5th Division and other units landed at Qinzhou Bay and advanced north along the Nanning–Qinzhou road. On 24 November they occupied Nanning and then attacked Kunlun Pass. Chinese forces concentrated for a counteroffensive, opening the Battle of South Guangxi. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Late in the Zaoyang–Yichang campaign, Japanese forces captured Yichang, the gateway to the upper Yangtze.

description.zh: 1940 年 5 月，日军发动枣宜会战。6 月 12 日，日军第 13 军等部攻占宜昌，中国军队反攻未克。宜昌是长江上游重要门户，沦陷后重庆受到更大威胁。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In May 1940 Japan launched the Zaoyang–Yichang campaign. On 12 June the Japanese 13th Army and other units captured Yichang; Chinese counterattacks failed to retake it. Yichang was the gateway to the upper Yangtze, and its fall increased the threat to Chongqing. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 日军进驻法属印度支那北部
name.en: Japanese Entry into Northern French Indochina

summary.zh: 日军进驻法属印度支那北部，切断滇越铁路。
summary.en: Japanese forces entered northern French Indochina and cut the Yunnan–Vietnam railway.

description.zh: 1940 年 9 月，日本趁法国战败，与维希法国达成协议，日军于 9 月 22 日自镇南关进入法属印度支那北部，随后在海防登陆，进驻河内。日军控制越南北部后，切断滇越铁路，并建立轰炸中国西南和南下南洋的基地。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In September 1940, exploiting the French defeat, Japan reached an agreement with Vichy France and on 22 September Japanese forces entered northern French Indochina through Zhennanguan, later landing at Haiphong and occupying Hanoi. Control of northern Vietnam cut the Yunnan–Vietnam railway and gave Japan bases for bombing southwest China and for the southward advance. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军在宁波投撒鼠疫菌，造成平民感染死亡。
summary.en: Japanese forces spread plague bacteria in Ningbo, causing civilian infections and deaths.

description.zh: 1940 年 10 月 27 日，日军第 731 部队在宁波开明街一带投撒带有鼠疫菌的跳蚤、谷物等，引发鼠疫流行，造成平民死亡。具体死亡人数各说不一，待页码级核对。本事件为细菌战惨案，不绘路线。注意：事件日期与“宁波沦陷”（1941-04-20）不同，勿混。
description.en: On 27 October 1940 the Japanese Unit 731 spread plague-infected fleas and grain around Kaiming Street in Ningbo, triggering a plague outbreak and civilian deaths. Accounts of the death toll differ and await page-level verification. This is a bacteriological-warfare atrocity and is not drawn as a route. It is distinct from the fall of Ningbo on 20 April 1941.

summary.zh: 日军包围冀东潘家峪村，屠杀村民。
summary.en: Japanese forces surrounded Panjiayu village in eastern Hebei and massacred its residents.

description.zh: 1941 年 1 月 25 日，日军驻唐山部队包围冀东丰润县潘家峪村，将村民集中屠杀并焚毁房屋。具体死难人数各说不一，通行说法为一千余人，待页码级核对。本事件为惨案，不绘路线。
description.en: On 25 January 1941 Japanese troops based in Tangshan surrounded Panjiayu village in Fengrun, eastern Hebei, massacred the assembled villagers and burned the houses. Accounts of the death toll differ; the conventional figure is over 1,000 and awaits page-level verification. As a massacre, this event is not drawn as a route.

summary.zh: 宁绍战役开始，日军占领绍兴。
summary.en: The Ningbo–Shaoxing campaign began and Japanese forces captured Shaoxing.

description.zh: 1941 年 4 月 16 日，日军第 13 军自杭州附近向钱塘江南岸发动进攻，宁绍战役开始。4 月 17 日凌晨，日军占领绍兴，这是战役中中国方面失守的第一座城市。日期据《近代史研究》相关研究，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 16 April 1941 the Japanese 13th Army attacked south across the Qiantang River from near Hangzhou, opening the Ningbo–Shaoxing campaign. In the early hours of 17 April Japanese forces occupied Shaoxing, the first city lost by the Chinese side in the campaign. The date follows research in Modern Chinese History Studies and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces landed at Zhenhai and captured the county town.

description.en: At dawn on 19 April 1941 the Japanese 5th Division and naval landing forces came ashore on both banks of the Yong River mouth at Zhenhai; Chinese provisional 34th Division troops resisted. The county town fell that morning and the Japanese advanced west along the Yong River toward Ningbo. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces landed at the Feiyun River mouth and occupied Rui’an.

description.en: On 18 April 1941 a Japanese force landed at the mouth of the Feiyun River, broke through the Chinese beach defenses and occupied Rui’an the same day before advancing north toward Wenzhou. The date follows Wenzhou local histories and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: After landing at the Feiyun River, Japanese forces occupied Rui’an and Wenzhou.

description.en: On 18 April 1941 Japanese forces landed at the Feiyun River mouth and occupied Rui’an; on 19 April they advanced north and took central Wenzhou. After looting supplies, they withdrew in early May. The date follows Wenzhou local histories and awaits page-level verification.

The city then fell; Japan closed the port and seized supplies. The date follows Ningbo Daily and municipal archives and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军在闽江口及连江、长乐沿海登陆，第一次福州战役开始。
summary.en: Japanese forces landed at the Min River estuary and along the Lianjiang and Changle coasts, opening the first battle for Fuzhou.

description.zh: 1941 年 4 月 19 日拂晓，日军第 48 师团、第 18 师团一部及海军陆战队在闽江口两侧的连江、长乐沿海多处登陆，随后向福州推进。中国守军第 75 师、第 80 师等部抵抗。日期据《福州史志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: At dawn on 19 April 1941 the Japanese 48th Division, elements of the 18th Division and naval landing forces came ashore at several points around the Min River estuary and along the Lianjiang and Changle coasts, then advanced on Fuzhou. Chinese 75th and 80th Division troops resisted. The date follows Fuzhou local history and awaits page-level verification.

Mawei fell on 21 April and that evening Japanese troops entered central Fuzhou, which fell for the first time. The occupation gave Japan control of the Min River estuary and the Fujian coast. The date follows Fuzhou local history and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Japanese Entry into the Shanghai International Settlement

summary.zh: 太平洋战争爆发当日，日军进入上海公共租界。
summary.en: On the day the Pacific War began, Japanese forces entered the Shanghai International Settlement.

description.zh: 1941 年 12 月 8 日，太平洋战争爆发当天，日军从虹口等处进入上海公共租界，解除英美等国驻军武装，上海“孤岛”时期结束。日军随后控制上海租界的市政、金融和新闻。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 8 December 1941, the day the Pacific War began, Japanese forces entered the Shanghai International Settlement from Hongkou and other points, disarmed British and American troops and ended Shanghai’s “isolated island” period. Japan then controlled the settlement’s administration, finance and press. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces captured Hong Kong.

description.zh: 1941 年 12 月 8 日，日军第 38 师团自深圳进攻香港，经十八日战斗，12 月 25 日港督杨慕琦向日军投降，香港沦陷。香港沦陷使日军控制华南沿海，并切断中国经香港的补给线。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 8 December 1941 the Japanese 38th Division attacked Hong Kong from Shenzhen. After eighteen days of fighting, Governor Mark Young surrendered on 25 December and Hong Kong fell. The occupation gave Japan control of the South China coast and cut China’s supply route through Hong Kong. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军轰炸成都，造成大量平民伤亡。
summary.en: Japanese aircraft bombed Chengdu, causing heavy civilian casualties.

description.zh: 1939 年 6 月 11 日，日军飞机轰炸成都市区，投弹多枚，造成平民伤亡和房屋损毁。具体伤亡数字各说不一，待页码级核对。本事件为战略轰炸惨案，不绘路线。
description.en: On 11 June 1939 Japanese aircraft bombed central Chengdu, causing civilian casualties and destroying houses. Accounts of the casualties differ and await page-level verification. This is a strategic-bombing atrocity and is not drawn as a route.

name.en: May Day Sweep in Central Hebei

summary.zh: 日军华北方面军对冀中根据地发动“五一大扫荡”。
summary.en: The Japanese North China Area Army launched the “May Day Sweep” against the Central Hebei base area.

description.zh: 1942 年 5 月 1 日，日军华北方面军调集第 110 师团、第 27 师团及伪军等部，对冀中抗日根据地发动大规模“扫荡”，企图围歼八路军冀中军区部队。八路军采取分散游击、地道战等方式坚持，根据地遭受严重损失。日期与兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。本事件为战役性“扫荡”，不绘单线。
description.en: On 1 May 1942 the Japanese North China Area Army deployed the 110th and 27th Divisions and puppet troops in a large-scale sweep of the Central Hebei anti-Japanese base area, aiming to destroy the Eighth Route Army’s Central Hebei Military District. The Eighth Route Army dispersed into guerrilla and tunnel warfare; the base area suffered heavy losses. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification. As a campaign-level sweep, it is not drawn as a single route.

summary.zh: 日军第 56 师团自缅甸侵入滇西，占领畹町。
summary.en: The Japanese 56th Division invaded western Yunnan from Burma and occupied Wanding.

description.zh: 1942 年 5 月，日军第 56 师团自缅甸向中国云南边境推进。5 月 3 日，日军占领畹町，随后沿滇缅公路北犯龙陵、腾冲。中国远征军撤退，滇西沦陷。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In May 1942 the Japanese 56th Division advanced from Burma toward the Yunnan border. On 3 May it occupied Wanding and then advanced north along the Burma Road toward Longling and Tengchong. The Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew and western Yunnan fell. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces advanced north along the Burma Road and occupied Longling.

description.zh: 1942 年 5 月 4 日，日军第 56 师团一部占领龙陵，随后继续向惠通桥推进。中国军队炸毁惠通桥，阻止日军东渡怒江。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 4 May 1942 a detachment of the Japanese 56th Division occupied Longling and continued toward the Huitong Bridge. Chinese forces blew up the bridge to stop the Japanese from crossing the Salween. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Japanese Advance to the Huitong Bridge

place.en: Huitong Bridge on the Salween, Yunnan

summary.zh: 日军进抵惠通桥，中国军队炸桥阻敌。
summary.en: Japanese forces reached the Huitong Bridge, which Chinese troops destroyed to block their advance.

description.zh: 1942 年 5 月 5 日，日军先头部队进抵怒江惠通桥，中国守军炸毁桥梁，阻止日军东进。此后中日两军隔怒江对峙，滇西沦陷区形成。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 5 May 1942 Japanese advance troops reached the Huitong Bridge over the Salween; Chinese defenders blew up the bridge and halted the Japanese eastward advance. The two sides then faced each other across the Salween, and the occupied zone in western Yunnan took shape. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces used poison gas in Beituan village in Central Hebei, killing villagers and soldiers sheltering in tunnels.

description.zh: 1942 年 5 月 27 日，日军在“五一大扫荡”中对河北定县北疃村施放毒气，杀害躲避在地道中的村民和八路军伤病员。具体死难人数各说不一，待页码级核对。本事件为惨案，不绘路线。
description.en: On 27 May 1942, during the “May Day Sweep,” Japanese forces used poison gas in Beituan village, Dingxian, Hebei, killing villagers and Eighth Route Army wounded sheltering in tunnels. Accounts of the death toll differ and await page-level verification. As a massacre, this event is not drawn as a route.

summary.en: Japanese forces captured Quzhou and its airfield during the Zhejiang–Jiangxi campaign.

description.zh: 1942 年 6 月 3 日，日军向衢州发起进攻，中国守军第 86 军等部抵抗。6 月 7 日，衢州失守，日军破坏衢州机场。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 3 June 1942 Japanese forces attacked Quzhou and Chinese 86th Division troops resisted. Quzhou fell on 7 June and the Japanese destroyed its airfield. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军攻占上饶，浙赣铁路东段被打通。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Shangrao, opening the eastern section of the Zhejiang–Jiangxi railway.

description.zh: 1942 年 6 月 14 日，日军第 22 师团等部占领上饶，第三战区长官部所在地失守。7 月 1 日，东西两路日军在横峰会合，浙赣铁路被打通。日期据浙赣会战史料，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 14 June 1942 the Japanese 22nd Division and other units occupied Shangrao, seat of the Chinese 3rd War Zone headquarters. On 1 July Japanese columns from east and west met at Hengfeng, opening the Zhejiang–Jiangxi railway. The date follows campaign histories and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Bacteriological Warfare in the Zhejiang–Jiangxi Campaign

place.zh: 浙江衢州、金华、玉山一带
place.en: Quzhou, Jinhua and Yushan area, Zhejiang

summary.zh: 日军在浙赣战役撤退时散布细菌，造成疫病流行。
summary.en: Retreating Japanese forces spread bacteria during the Zhejiang–Jiangxi campaign, causing epidemics.

description.zh: 1942 年 8 月，日军在浙赣战役撤退过程中，在衢州、金华、玉山一带散布鼠疫、霍乱、伤寒等细菌，造成军民感染死亡。具体死亡人数各说不一，待页码级核对。本事件为细菌战惨案，不绘路线。
description.en: In August 1942, while withdrawing from the Zhejiang–Jiangxi campaign, Japanese forces spread plague, cholera and typhoid bacteria around Quzhou, Jinhua and Yushan, causing military and civilian infections and deaths. Accounts of the death toll differ and await page-level verification. This is a bacteriological-warfare atrocity and is not drawn as a route.

summary.en: Japanese forces massacred civilians and refugees at Changjiao in Nanxian, Hunan.

description.zh: 1943 年 5 月 9 日至 12 日，日军在湖南南县厂窖地区屠杀平民和逃难群众，制造厂窖惨案。具体死难人数各说不一，通行说法为三万余人，待页码级核对。本事件为惨案，不绘路线。
description.en: From 9 to 12 May 1943 Japanese forces massacred civilians and refugees in the Changjiao area of Nanxian, Hunan. Accounts of the death toll differ; the conventional figure is over 30,000 and awaits page-level verification. As a massacre, this event is not drawn as a route.

summary.zh: 豫中会战中日军攻占郑州。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Zhengzhou during the Central Henan campaign.

description.zh: 1944 年 4 月，日军发动豫中会战，第 12 军自中牟、邙山头渡过黄河。4 月 23 日，日军占领郑州。郑州沦陷日期有 4 月 19 日、20 日、23 日诸说，此处取“至 4 月 23 日相继攻陷郑州”的记载，待页码级核对。
description.en: In April 1944 Japan launched the Central Henan campaign; the 12th Army crossed the Yellow River at Zhongmu and the Mangshan foothills. On 23 April Japanese forces occupied Zhengzhou. Accounts of the date vary among 19, 20 and 23 April; this entry follows the record that Zhengzhou was taken by 23 April and awaits page-level verification.

description.en: On 30 April 1944 the Japanese 12th Army attacked Xuchang with three divisions and two brigades; the Chinese New 29th Division resisted. Xuchang fell on 1 May. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

description.en: In May 1944 Japanese forces completed the encirclement of Luoyang. On 25 May the Chinese 15th Army and other units broke out in several directions, Luoyang fell and the Central Henan campaign ended. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Japanese Landing at the Min River Estuary (1944)

summary.zh: 日军在闽江口登陆，第二次福州战役开始。
summary.en: Japanese forces landed at the Min River estuary, opening the second battle for Fuzhou.

description.zh: 1944 年 9 月 27 日，日军第 62 独立混成旅团在闽江口晓沃、道沃、浦口、东岱等地登陆，28 日占领连江，随后向福州推进。日期据《福州史志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 27 September 1944 the Japanese 62nd Independent Mixed Brigade landed at Xiaowo, Daowo, Pukou and Dongdai around the Min River estuary, occupied Lianjiang on 28 September and advanced on Fuzhou. The date follows Fuzhou local history and awaits page-level verification.

description.en: On 1 October 1944 Japanese forces advanced on Fuzhou from Lianjiang in two columns. On 4 October they entered the city from Dabeiling and Mawei, and Fuzhou fell for the second time. The date follows Fuzhou local history and awaits page-level verification.

description.en: On 2 December 1944 a detachment of the Japanese 13th Division captured Dushan in Guizhou, shocking Chongqing. The Japanese began withdrawing on 4 December and Dushan was recovered on 8 December. The date follows Qiannan Incident histories and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: The Taiwan surrender ceremony of the China Theater was held in Taipei, and Taiwan returned to China.

description.zh: 1945 年 10 月 25 日，中国战区台湾省受降仪式在台北举行，日本台湾总督安藤利吉向中国代表陈仪投降，台湾及澎湖列岛回归中国。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。本事件为受降事件，不绘路线。
description.en: On 25 October 1945 the China Theater’s Taiwan surrender ceremony was held in Taipei. Japanese governor-general Rikichi Andō surrendered to Chinese representative Chen Yi, and Taiwan and the Penghu Islands returned to China. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification. As a surrender event, it is not drawn as a route.

summary.en: The Japanese 10th Army landed at Jinshanwei, turning the flank of the Chinese forces at Shanghai.

description.zh: 1937 年 11 月 5 日，日军第 10 军在杭州湾北岸金山卫登陆，突破中国守军防线，向松江、嘉兴方向推进，威胁淞沪中国军队侧后。中国军队随后全线西撤，上海于 11 月 12 日沦陷。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 5 November 1937 the Japanese 10th Army landed at Jinshanwei on the north bank of Hangzhou Bay, broke through the Chinese defenses and advanced toward Songjiang and Jiaxing, threatening the rear of the Chinese forces at Shanghai. The Chinese army then withdrew along the whole line and Shanghai fell on 12 November. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日本内阁决定“广田三原则”，要求中国取缔排日、承认伪满、共同防共。
summary.en: The Japanese cabinet adopted “Hirota’s Three Principles,” demanding an end to anti-Japanese activity, recognition of Manchukuo and joint anti-communism.

description.zh: 1935 年 10 月 4 日，日本冈田启介内阁决定《外、陆、海三相关于对华政策的谅解》，即“广田三原则”：中国取缔排日言行并摆脱对欧美依赖、事实上默认伪满洲国、在邻近外蒙地区与日本合作防共。10 月 7 日，广田弘毅向中国驻日大使蒋作宾提出。中方未接受，交涉无果。日期为阁议决定日，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 4 October 1935 the Japanese cabinet of Okada Keisuke adopted the “Understanding of the Foreign, Army and Navy Ministers on Policy toward China,” known as Hirota’s Three Principles: China should suppress anti-Japanese words and deeds and abandon reliance on the Western powers; tacitly accept Manchukuo; and cooperate with Japan against communism in areas bordering Outer Mongolia. Foreign Minister Hirota Kōki presented them to Chinese ambassador Jiang Zuobin on 7 October. China did not accept them and the talks failed. The date is that of the cabinet decision and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 日本发表“不以国民政府为对手”声明
name.en: Japan’s “Not to Deal with the Nationalist Government” Statement

summary.zh: 日本政府发表声明，宣称“不以国民政府为对手”。
summary.en: The Japanese government declared that it would “not deal with the Nationalist Government.”

description.zh: 1938 年 1 月 16 日，日本近卫文麿内阁发表声明，称在国民政府不改变抗日政策的情况下，日本“不以国民政府为对手”，将扶植新政权。声明标志着日本试图以军事压力和政治诱降迫使中国屈服。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 16 January 1938 the Japanese cabinet of Konoe Fumimaro declared that, so long as the Nationalist Government did not change its policy of resistance, Japan would “not deal with it” and would foster new regimes instead. The statement marked Japan’s attempt to force China to submit through military pressure and political inducement. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日本提出建立“东亚新秩序”，公开否定九国公约体系。
summary.en: Japan proclaimed a “New Order in East Asia,” openly rejecting the Washington treaty system.

description.zh: 1938 年 11 月 3 日，日本近卫内阁发表第二次声明，提出建立“东亚新秩序”，声称日本、伪满、中国应相互结合，公开否定华盛顿体系下的门户开放原则。该声明为汪精卫投日后的对华政策定调。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 3 November 1938 the second Konoe cabinet issued a statement proclaiming a “New Order in East Asia,” asserting that Japan, Manchukuo and China should be closely linked and openly rejecting the Open Door principle of the Washington system. The statement set the framework for Japan’s China policy after Wang Jingwei’s defection. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 日本设立华北开发、华中振兴两会社
name.en: Establishment of the North China and Central China Development Companies

summary.zh: 日本设立华北开发、华中振兴两大会社，统制沦陷区经济。
summary.en: Japan established the North China and Central China development companies to control the occupied economies.

description.zh: 1938 年 11 月 7 日，日本政府主导的华北开发株式会社与华中振兴株式会社先后成立（华北开发于同年 6 月设立、11 月召开总会；华中振兴 11 月 7 日在上海成立，日期有异说）。两社以“中日合办”名义统制华北、华中的交通、矿业、电力、通信等业，是日本掠夺沦陷区资源的核心机构。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 7 November 1938 the Japanese government’s North China Development Company and Central China Development Company were established (the North China company was incorporated in June and held its general meeting in November; the Central China company was founded in Shanghai on 7 November; dates vary). Under a “Sino-Japanese joint venture” formula they controlled transport, mining, electric power and communications in North and Central China and were central to Japan’s extraction of occupied resources. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 德国驻华大使陶德曼受托转达日本停战条件，调停未成。
summary.en: German ambassador Trautmann conveyed Japan’s armistice terms to China; the mediation failed.

description.zh: 1937 年 11 月 5 日，德国驻华大使陶德曼受日本委托，向蒋介石转达日方停战条件，包括承认伪满、华北特殊化、赔款等。随着南京沦陷和日本提出更苛刻条件，调停失败。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 5 November 1937 German ambassador Oskar Trautmann, acting at Japan’s request, conveyed Japanese armistice terms to Chiang Kai-shek, including recognition of Manchukuo, special status for North China and indemnities. After the fall of Nanjing and Japan’s harsher terms, the mediation failed. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Japanese Landing on the Leizhou Peninsula

summary.zh: 日军独立混成第 23 旅团在雷州半岛东海岸登陆。
summary.en: The Japanese 23rd Independent Mixed Brigade landed on the east coast of the Leizhou Peninsula.

description.zh: 1943 年 2 月 16 日晨，日军独立混成第 23 旅团 1600 余人，在海军舰艇和飞机掩护下，于雷州半岛东海岸通明、下岚两港登陆，随即进攻海康县城。此次作战旨在封锁中国海上交通、掠夺物资并支援太平洋战场。日期与兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On the morning of 16 February 1943, more than 1,600 troops of the Japanese 23rd Independent Mixed Brigade, covered by warships and aircraft, landed at Tongming and Xialan on the east coast of the Leizhou Peninsula and advanced on Haikang county town. The operation aimed to blockade China’s maritime traffic, seize supplies and support the Pacific theater. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军占领海康、遂溪，雷州半岛沦陷。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Haikang and Suixi, and the Leizhou Peninsula fell.

description.zh: 1943 年 2 月 16 日日军登陆后，当日占领海康县城，17 日占客路，18 至 19 日相继占领遂溪城月、洋青及遂溪县城。雷州半岛成为日军封锁华南沿海、掠夺物资的占领区。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: After landing on 16 February 1943, Japanese forces occupied Haikang county town the same day, Khelu on 17 February, and Chengyue, Yangqing and Suixi county town on 18–19 February. The Leizhou Peninsula became an occupied zone for blockading the South China coast and seizing supplies. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军海军陆战队占领广州湾西营，广州湾沦陷。
summary.en: Japanese naval landing forces occupied Xiyang, and Guangzhouwan fell.

description.zh: 1943 年 2 月 16 日，日军一部 300 余人在广州湾西营登陆，窜占麻章、赤坎；21 日，日本海军陆战队在西营码头登陆，占领西营市区。法国广州湾租借地当局与日军签订移交协定，广州湾沦陷。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 16 February 1943 a Japanese force of more than 300 landed at Xiyang in Guangzhouwan and occupied Mazhang and Chikan; on 21 February Japanese naval landing forces came ashore at Xiyang pier and occupied the urban area. The French authorities of the Guangzhouwan leased territory signed a transfer agreement with Japan, and Guangzhouwan fell. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军小薗江混成旅团沿金华—丽水—温州公路南犯，占领温州。
summary.en: The Japanese Kogiso Mixed Brigade advanced south along the Jinhua–Lishui–Wenzhou road and occupied Wenzhou.

description.zh: 1942 年 7 月，日军驻上海的第 13 军所属小薗江混成旅团近千人，沿金华、丽水、青田、温州公路南犯，7 月 1 日占丽水、9 日占青田、11 日占温州，并一度盘踞乐清磐石和瑞安县城，8 月 15 日撤走。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In July 1942 the Japanese 13th Army’s Kogiso Mixed Brigade, about 1,000 strong and based in Shanghai, advanced south along the Jinhua–Lishui–Qingtian–Wenzhou road, occupying Lishui on 1 July, Qingtian on 9 July and Wenzhou on 11 July. It briefly held Pan’shi in Yueqing and Rui’an county town before withdrawing on 15 August. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军甲支队自金华经丽水、青田进攻，占领温州并长期盘踞。
summary.en: The Japanese Kō Detachment advanced from Jinhua via Lishui and Qingtian and occupied Wenzhou for a prolonged period.

description.zh: 1944 年 9 月，日军第 13 军组织甲支队（后改编为独立混成第 89 旅团）共 4 个大队，由黎冈少将指挥，自金华集结，经丽水、青田，于 9 月 9 日占领温州，随后占领乐清西乡和县城，在瓯江口以北沿海构筑工事、修建简易机场，直至 1945 年 6 月才撤出。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In September 1944 the Japanese 13th Army formed the Kō Detachment (later the 89th Independent Mixed Brigade), four battalions under Major General Kogiso, which assembled at Jinhua, advanced via Lishui and Qingtian and occupied Wenzhou on 9 September. It then took western Yueqing and the county town, built fortifications and a simple airfield along the coast north of the Ou River mouth, and did not withdraw until June 1945. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces captured Shaoguan, the key northern Guangdong city, opening the southern section of the Canton–Hankou railway.

description.zh: 1945 年 1 月，日军第 6 方面军为打通粤汉铁路南段并破坏赣南空军基地，向粤北、赣南发动进攻。1 月 28 日，日军占领粤北重镇曲江（韶关），随后沿粤汉铁路南北展开。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In January 1945 the Japanese 6th Area Army attacked northern Guangdong and southern Jiangxi to open the southern section of the Canton–Hankou railway and destroy air bases in southern Jiangxi. On 28 January it captured Qujiang (Shaoguan), the key city of northern Guangdong, and then expanded along the railway. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军自粤北北犯，占领南雄。
summary.en: Japanese forces advanced north from northern Guangdong and occupied Nanxiong.

description.zh: 1945 年 2 月 1 日，日军占领始兴；2 月 3 日占领南雄。南路日军随后经南雄进入江西，进攻大余、新城，配合北路日军会攻赣州。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 1 February 1945 Japanese forces occupied Shixing and on 3 February Nanxiong. The southern column then entered Jiangxi through Nanxiong, attacked Dayu and Xincheng, and converged with the northern column on Ganzhou. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军占领大余县城，继续向新城、赣州推进。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Dayu and advanced toward Xincheng and Ganzhou.

description.zh: 1945 年 2 月 5 日，南路日军攻占大余县城，随后沿赣余公路北犯，占领黄龙、青龙、池江等地，2 月 8 日与北路日军会攻新城机场。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 5 February 1945 the southern Japanese column captured Dayu county town and advanced north along the Ganzhou–Dayu road, occupying Huanglong, Qinglong and Chijiang before joining the northern column in attacking the Xincheng airfield on 8 February. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 27 师团攻占遂川机场，随后南下进攻赣州。
summary.en: The Japanese 27th Division captured the Suichuan airfield and advanced south toward Ganzhou.

description.zh: 1945 年 1 月，日军第 27 师团自湘东茶陵、攸县南下，进攻遂川。1 月 31 日，日军攻占遂川机场，随后占领遂川县城，并沿公路南犯赣州。日期有 1 月 30 日、31 日诸说，待页码级核对。
description.en: In January 1945 the Japanese 27th Division advanced south from Chaling and Youxian in eastern Hunan toward Suichuan. On 31 January it captured the Suichuan airfield, then the county town, and advanced south along the road toward Ganzhou. Accounts differ between 30 and 31 January and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 27 师团进占赣州，赣南沦陷。
summary.en: The Japanese 27th Division entered Ganzhou, and southern Jiangxi fell.

description.zh: 1945 年 2 月 5 日，日军第 27 师团进占赣州城，随后占领全城并继续南侵，占领南康、大余、新城等地。赣州于 7 月 12 日被中国军队收复。日期有 2 月 5 日进占、2 月 6 日全城诸说，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 5 February 1945 the Japanese 27th Division entered Ganzhou and then occupied the whole city, continuing south to take Nankang, Dayu and Xincheng. Ganzhou was recovered by Chinese forces on 12 July. Accounts differ between entry on 5 February and full occupation on 6 February and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军察哈尔派遣兵团占领张家口，控制平绥线东段。
summary.en: The Japanese Chahar Expeditionary Force captured Zhangjiakou, controlling the eastern section of the Peiping–Suiyuan railway.

description.zh: 1937 年 8 月，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团沿平绥线西进，配合南口作战。8 月 27 日，日军占领张家口，中国守军撤退。张家口沦陷使日军控制察哈尔东部，并为进攻大同打开通路。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In August 1937 the Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar Expeditionary Force advanced west along the Peiping–Suiyuan railway in support of the Nankou operation. On 27 August it captured Zhangjiakou and the Chinese defenders withdrew. The fall of Zhangjiakou gave Japan control of eastern Chahar and opened the route toward Datong. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 1 军沿平汉线南下，占领保定。
summary.en: The Japanese 1st Army advanced south along the Peiping–Hankou railway and captured Baoding.

description.zh: 1937 年 9 月，日军第 1 军沿平汉线南下，中国守军在第 2 战区节节抵抗。9 月 24 日，日军占领保定，随后继续向石家庄推进。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In September 1937 the Japanese 1st Army advanced south along the Peiping–Hankou railway against Chinese 2nd War Zone troops. On 24 September it captured Baoding and continued toward Shijiazhuang. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军占领石家庄，控制平汉、正太两铁路交会点。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Shijiazhuang, controlling the junction of the Peiping–Hankou and Zhengding–Taiyuan railways.

description.zh: 1937 年 10 月，日军第 1 军沿平汉线继续南下。10 月 10 日，日军占领石家庄，控制平汉、正太两铁路交会点，为沿正太线西攻娘子关、太原创造条件。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In October 1937 the Japanese 1st Army continued south along the Peiping–Hankou railway. On 10 October it captured Shijiazhuang, the junction of the Peiping–Hankou and Zhengding–Taiyuan railways, creating conditions for the westward drive along the Zhengding–Taiyuan line toward Niangziguan and Taiyuan. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 20 师团等部攻占娘子关，打开晋东门户。
summary.en: The Japanese 20th Division and other units captured Niangziguan, opening the eastern gateway to Shanxi.

description.zh: 1937 年 10 月，日军第 20 师团等部沿正太线西进，进攻娘子关。中国军队第 26 路军、第 27 路军等部在娘子关、旧关一带顽强抵抗。10 月 26 日，娘子关失守，日军随后西进太原。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In October 1937 the Japanese 20th Division and other units advanced west along the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway against Niangziguan. Chinese 26th and 27th Route Army troops resisted stubbornly at Niangziguan and Jiuguan. Niangziguan fell on 26 October and the Japanese advanced west toward Taiyuan. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军占领绥远省会归绥。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Guisui, the capital of Suiyuan.

description.zh: 1937 年 10 月，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团沿平绥线西进，进攻绥远。10 月 14 日，日军占领归绥（今呼和浩特），中国守军撤退。归绥沦陷使日军控制绥远东部，随后进攻包头。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In October 1937 the Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar Expeditionary Force advanced west along the Peiping–Suiyuan railway into Suiyuan. On 14 October it captured Guisui (present-day Hohhot) and the Chinese defenders withdrew. The fall of Guisui gave Japan control of eastern Suiyuan and opened the way to Baotou. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军占领包头，平绥线西段沦陷。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Baotou, completing the occupation of the western Peiping–Suiyuan railway.

description.zh: 1937 年 10 月 17 日，日军占领包头，平绥线西段至此基本沦陷。日军随后在绥远扶植伪政权，控制煤炭、铁路等资源。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 17 October 1937 Japanese forces captured Baotou, completing the occupation of the western Peiping–Suiyuan railway. Japan then installed puppet authorities in Suiyuan and controlled coal, railway and other resources. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Opening of the Tiandu Iron Mine

place.zh: 海南崖县田独（今三亚田独）

summary.zh: 日军发现并开采田独铁矿，修建田独—榆林铁路与榆林港矿石码头。
summary.en: Japanese forces discovered and began mining the Tiandu iron ore deposit, building the Tiandu–Yulin railway and an ore terminal at Yulin port.

description.zh: 1939 年 7 月，日军随军地质勘探人员在崖县田独发现优质铁矿，随即由石原株式会社组织开采。1940 年 6 月 11 日首次出矿，并修建田独至河口约 10 公里的轻便铁路，在榆林港建万吨级矿石码头。1944 年下半年因盟军封锁海域停产。据日方资料，田独铁矿共开采约 269 万吨、掠运约 268 万吨；数字待页码级核对。
description.en: In July 1939 Japanese military geologists discovered high-grade iron ore at Tiandu in Ya county, and the Ishihara interests began mining it. First ore was shipped on 11 June 1940; a roughly 10-km light railway was built from Tiandu to the river mouth, and a 10,000-ton ore terminal was built at Yulin port. Mining stopped in the second half of 1944 under Allied naval blockade. According to Japanese sources, about 2.69 million tons were mined and about 2.68 million tons shipped away; these figures await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 石碌—八所铁路铺轨完成，第一列矿石车抵达八所港。
summary.en: The Shilu–Basuo railway was completed and the first ore train reached Basuo port.

description.zh: 为把石碌铁矿的矿石运到八所港装船，日军修建石碌—八所铁路，全长约 52 公里。1942 年 3 月铺轨完成，3 月 23 日第一列运矿车由石碌抵达八所。据日方资料，石碌铁矿 1941—1945 年开采约 69.5 万吨、运出约 41 万吨；数字待页码级核对。
description.en: To move ore from the Shilu mine to Basuo port, Japan built the roughly 52-km Shilu–Basuo railway. Track laying was completed in March 1942, and on 23 March the first ore train ran from Shilu to Basuo. According to Japanese sources, the Shilu mine produced about 695,000 tons and shipped about 410,000 tons in 1941–1945; these figures await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 榆林—北黎铁路基本完工，在北黎与石八线接轨。
summary.en: The Yulin–Beili railway was basically completed and joined the Shilu–Basuo line at Beili.

description.zh: 在修建石八线的同时，日军为连接榆林海军基地与北黎、八所等港口，修建榆林—北黎铁路，全长约 187.9 公里。1943 年 3 月基本完工，并在北黎与石八线接轨，形成海南西部铁路骨架。具体通车日待页码级核对。
description.en: While building the Shilu–Basuo line, Japan also built the roughly 187.9-km Yulin–Beili railway to link the Yulin naval base with Beili, Basuo and other ports. It was basically completed in March 1943 and joined the Shilu–Basuo line at Beili, forming the railway framework of western Hainan. The exact opening date awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 田独铁矿劳工死亡万余人，遗骸葬于田独万人坑。
summary.en: More than 10,000 laborers died at the Tiandu iron mine, and their remains were buried in the Tiandu mass grave.

description.zh: 日军为掠夺田独铁矿，从上海、广州、香港、澳门、汕头、厦门等沦陷区诱骗、强征劳工，并在海南各县强抽民夫。劳工在日军和工头押制下从事高强度劳动，病死、饿死、打死、烧死、活埋者众多。战后调查与《海南铁矿志》记载死亡万余人；1945 年 8 月日军投降时，田独铁矿仅存 1713 人。具体数字待页码级核对。本事件为惨案，不绘路线。
description.en: To extract the Tiandu iron ore, Japan deceived and forcibly recruited laborers from Shanghai, Guangzhou, Hong Kong, Macao, Shantou and Xiamen and impressed villagers across Hainan. Under Japanese guards and foremen they performed heavy labor, and many died of disease, starvation, beatings, burning or burial alive. Postwar investigations and the Hainan Iron Mine Gazetteer record more than 10,000 deaths; when Japan surrendered in August 1945 only 1,713 laborers remained at Tiandu. These figures await page-level verification. As a massacre, this event is not drawn as a route.

name.zh: 日军完成海南首轮占领
name.en: Completion of Japan’s First Occupation of Hainan

summary.zh: 日军完成海南岛首轮占领，控制文昌、定安、嘉积、儋县等沿海城镇。
summary.en: Japan completed its first occupation of Hainan, controlling Wenchang, Ding’an, Jiaji, Danxian and other coastal towns.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月登陆海口、三亚后，日军继续向文昌、定安、嘉积、儋县新州等沿海城镇推进。至 4 月底，日军完成海南岛首轮占领，控制主要港口、县城与交通线。各城具体失守日期待页码级核对。本事件为占领阶段节点，不绘单线。
description.en: After landing at Haikou and Sanya in February 1939, Japanese forces pushed toward Wenchang, Ding’an, Jiaji and Xinzhou in Danxian. By the end of April they had completed the first occupation of Hainan, controlling the main ports, county towns and roads. The exact date each town fell awaits page-level verification. This is a phase marker and is not drawn as a single route.

name.en: Japanese “Sweep” of the Qiongya Base Area

summary.zh: 日军对琼崖抗日根据地发动“扫荡”，琼崖独立总队反“扫荡”。
summary.en: Japanese forces launched a “sweep” against the Qiongya anti-Japanese base area, and the Qiongya Independent Corps countered it.

description.zh: 1942 年 5 月，日军调集海口、嘉积、那大等据点兵力，对琼山、文昌、定安一带的琼崖抗日根据地发动“扫荡”，企图消灭琼崖独立总队主力。琼崖独立总队以分散游击、民众自卫等方式反“扫荡”，坚持根据地。具体兵力、战斗次数与起止日期待页码级核对。本事件为“扫荡”阶段节点，不绘单线。
description.en: In May 1942 Japanese forces drawn from Haikou, Jiaji, Nada and other garrisons launched a “sweep” against the Qiongya base area in Qiongshan, Wenchang and Ding’an, aiming to destroy the main force of the Qiongya Independent Corps. The Corps resisted through dispersed guerrilla warfare and local self-defense. Strength, number of engagements and exact dates await page-level verification. This is a phase marker and is not drawn as a single route.

name.en: Surrender of Japanese Forces in Hainan

summary.zh: 国民党第 46 军渡海接收海南，日军海南警备府所部投降。
summary.en: The Chinese 46th Army crossed to Hainan to receive the surrender of the Japanese Hainan Guard District.

description.zh: 1945 年 9 月，国民党第 46 军渡海进入海南。10 月初，叶佩高、朱晖日在海口成立前进指挥所，负责对日受降；10 月中旬起，第 188 师、新编第 19 师、第 175 师分批登陆，接收日军武器、器材与物资。日军海南警备府所部投降。精确受降仪式日期与各批接收日程待页码级核对。本事件为受降事件，不绘路线。
description.en: In September 1945 the Chinese 46th Army crossed to Hainan. In early October Ye Peigao and Zhu Huiri established an advance command post at Haikou to handle the Japanese surrender; from mid-October the 188th, New 19th and 175th Divisions landed in batches and took over Japanese weapons, equipment and supplies. The Japanese Hainan Guard District surrendered. The exact ceremony date and reception schedule await page-level verification. As a surrender event, it is not drawn as a route.

place.zh: 海南崖县崖城（今三亚崖城）

summary.zh: 日军自三亚分路进攻，占领崖县县城崖城。
summary.en: Japanese forces advanced from Sanya by several routes and occupied Yacheng, seat of Ya county.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 14 日日军在三亚登陆后，一部向榆林“扫荡”，一部从崖州湾头灶、大旦港、马岭等处登陆，三路进攻崖县县城。2 月 15 日，日军占领崖城。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。
description.en: After landing at Sanya on 14 February 1939, Japanese forces sent one column to sweep Yulin and landed at Touzao, Dadan and Maling around Yazhou Bay, attacking Yacheng by three routes. Yacheng fell on 15 February. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军自海口进攻定安，占领定安县城。
summary.en: Japanese forces advanced from Haikou and occupied Ding’an county town.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 20 日，日军 700 余人以飞机、战车掩护，自海口猛攻定安县城。定安为国民党琼崖警备司令部驻地附近要地，失守后国民党军政机关退入山区。日期有 2 月 20 日、22 日诸说，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 20 February 1939 more than 700 Japanese troops, covered by aircraft and armoured vehicles, attacked Ding’an county town from Haikou. Ding’an was a key point near the Nationalist Qiongya garrison headquarters, whose offices withdrew into the mountains after its fall. Accounts differ between 20 and 22 February and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军自海口进攻文昌，占领文昌县城文城。
summary.en: Japanese forces advanced from Haikou and occupied Wencheng, seat of Wenchang county.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 22 日，日军 200 余人以战车、飞机掩护，自海口进攻文昌县城文城，当日占领；2 月 23 日进入清澜港。日期有 2 月 21 日、22 日诸说，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 22 February 1939 more than 200 Japanese troops, covered by armoured vehicles and aircraft, advanced from Haikou and occupied Wencheng, the seat of Wenchang county; they entered Qinglan port on 23 February. Accounts differ between 21 and 22 February and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军占领澄迈县城金江镇。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Jinjiang, seat of Chengmai county.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月日军在澄迈湾登陆后，向澄迈内地推进。4 月 14 日，日军占领澄迈县城金江镇。金江地处南渡江中游，是海口通往琼西的重要节点。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。
description.en: After landing in Chengmai Bay in February 1939, Japanese forces pushed inland. On 14 April they occupied Jinjiang, seat of Chengmai county. Jinjiang lies on the middle Nandu River and was an important node between Haikou and western Hainan. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军占领琼东重镇嘉积。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Jiaji, the key town of Qiongdong.

description.zh: 1939 年 4 月 15 日，日军占领琼东县嘉积镇。嘉积是海南东部水陆交通枢纽，失守后日军以此为据点控制万泉河流域和琼东、乐会一带。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 15 April 1939 Japanese forces occupied Jiaji in Qiongdong county. Jiaji was a transport hub in eastern Hainan; after its fall Japan used it as a base to control the Wanquan River valley and the Qiongdong–Lehui area. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces captured Lingao county town and also controlled the ports of Bo’ao, Yangpu and Baimajing.

description.zh: 1939 年 4 月 18 日，日军攻占临高县城，同时占领博鳌、乐会和洋浦港、白马井。临高失守使日军控制琼州海峡南岸与琼西北沿海。另有 9 月 25 日日军在新盈港登陆后占临城说，日期待页码级核对。
description.en: On 18 April 1939 Japanese forces captured Lingao county town and also took Bo’ao, Lehui, Yangpu port and Baimajing, giving them control of the south shore of the Qiongzhou Strait and the northwest coast. Another account has Japanese forces landing at Xinying on 25 September and then taking the county town; the date awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces landed at Baimajing and Xinying and occupied Xinzhou, seat of Dan county.

description.zh: 1939 年 4 月 16 日，日军从白马井登陆；17 日在新英登陆，随后向东进攻。4 月 18 日占领儋县县城新州。5 月 4 日，日军与伪军侵占琼西重镇那大，以那大基督教堂为据点。日期据海南史志网与儋州地方史，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 16 April 1939 Japanese forces landed at Baimajing, and on 17 April at Xinying, then advanced east. On 18 April they occupied Xinzhou, seat of Dan county. On 4 May Japanese and puppet troops seized Nada, the key town of western Hainan, using its church as a strongpoint. Dates follow Hainan and Danzhou local histories and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军自三亚、藤桥方向进攻，占领陵水县城。
summary.en: Japanese forces advanced from Sanya and Tengqiao and occupied Lingshui county town.

description.zh: 1939 年 4 月，日军自三亚、藤桥方向进攻陵水。4 月 28 日，日军占领陵水县城。陵水失守后，日军控制海南东南沿海，并以此为基地向保亭山区渗透。日期有 4 月 21 日、28 日诸说，待页码级核对。
description.en: In April 1939 Japanese forces advanced on Lingshui from Sanya and Tengqiao. On 28 April they occupied the county town, gaining control of the southeast coast and a base for penetration into the Baoting mountains. Accounts differ between 21 and 28 April and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Tunchang town, then part of Qiongshan county (present-day Tunchang county).

description.zh: 1939 年 5 月 11 日，日军占领琼山县屯昌镇（今屯昌县）。屯昌地处海南中部，是连接琼山、定安、澄迈与五指山山区的重要节点。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 11 May 1939 Japanese forces occupied Tunchang town, then part of Qiongshan county and now Tunchang county. Tunchang lies in central Hainan and was an important node linking Qiongshan, Ding’an and Chengmai with the Wuzhishan mountains. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军占领感恩县城。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Gan’en county town.

description.zh: 1939 年 6 月 27 日，日军占领感恩县城（今东方感城）。感恩位于海南西南沿海，失守后日军与昌江、崖县据点连成一线，控制琼西南沿海。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 27 June 1939 Japanese forces occupied Gan’en county town (present-day Gancheng, Dongfang). Gan’en lies on the southwest coast; after its fall Japanese garrisons at Changjiang and Ya county were linked, giving Japan control of the southwest coast. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces invaded Changjiang, occupied Xinjie, Duntou and Basuo, and set up headquarters at Beili.

description.zh: 1939 年 7 月 18 日，日军侵犯昌江，占领新街、墩头、八所，并在北黎设立司令部。昌江、感恩沿海与八所港被日军控制，为后来开采石碌铁矿、修建石八铁路准备了条件。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 18 July 1939 Japanese forces invaded Changjiang, occupied Xinjie, Duntou and Basuo, and established headquarters at Beili. Control of the Changjiang–Gan’en coast and Basuo port prepared the way for mining the Shilu iron ore and building the Shilu–Basuo railway. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Wanning county town.

description.zh: 1939 年 8 月 13 日，日军占领万宁县城。万宁位于海南东南沿海，失守后日军控制万泉河下游与东部海岸，与嘉积、陵水据点相连。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 13 August 1939 Japanese forces occupied Wanning county town. Wanning lies on the southeast coast; after its fall Japan controlled the lower Wanquan River and the east coast, linking the Jiaji and Lingshui garrisons. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces advanced from Lingshui and occupied Baoting county town.

description.zh: 1940 年 3 月 15 日，驻陵水日军出占保亭县城。保亭地处五指山南麓，是日军向中部山区渗透的节点。另有 1940 年 7 月 16 日占领说，日期待页码级核对。
description.en: On 15 March 1940 Japanese forces from Lingshui occupied Baoting county town. Baoting lies on the southern slope of the Wuzhishan range and was a Japanese node for penetration into the central mountains. Another account gives 16 July 1940; the date awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军自崖县方向进攻，占领乐东县城。
summary.en: Japanese forces advanced from Ya county and occupied Ledong county town.

description.zh: 1940 年 3 月 15 日，驻崖县日军出占乐东县城（抱由）。乐东地处五指山西南，失守后日军与崖县、感恩据点相连，但山区仍为琼崖抗日武装活动区。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 15 March 1940 Japanese forces from Ya county occupied Ledong county town (Baoyou). Ledong lies southwest of the Wuzhishan range; after its fall Japanese garrisons linked up with Ya county and Gan’en, but the mountains remained an area of Qiongya anti-Japanese activity. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 日军占领海南环岛县城与据点
name.en: Japanese Occupation of Hainan’s Coastal County Towns and Garrisons

summary.zh: 至 1940 年 3 月，日军占领海南除白沙县城和五指山周围山区外的环岛县城、港口与交通线。
summary.en: By March 1940 Japan had occupied Hainan’s coastal county towns, ports and roads, except Baisha county town and the Wuzhishan mountains.

description.zh: 至 1940 年 3 月，日军已占领海南岛 14 个县的县城和大部分市镇：琼山、文昌、定安、澄迈、琼东、乐东、万宁、陵水、临高、儋县、崖县、昌江、感恩、保亭；在环岛沿海和内陆山区设 360 多个军事据点，在县城、乡镇设 195 个维持会/分会。白沙县城和五指山及其周围山区未被长期占领，是琼崖抗日根据地。日军仍不断对根据地“蚕食”“扫荡”。数字据海南史志网综述，待页码级核对。本事件为占领范围总览，不绘单线。
description.en: By March 1940 Japan had occupied the county towns and most market towns of Hainan’s 14 counties: Qiongshan, Wenchang, Ding’an, Chengmai, Qiongdong, Ledong, Wanning, Lingshui, Lingao, Dan county, Ya county, Changjiang, Gan’en and Baoting. It established more than 360 military posts along the coast and in the interior and 195 maintenance associations or branches in county and market towns. Baisha county town and the Wuzhishan mountains were not permanently occupied and remained the Qiongya anti-Japanese base area; Japan continued “nibbling” and “sweeping” operations against it. Figures follow Hainan local history and await page-level verification. This is an overview of the occupied area, not a single route.

summary.en: A second Japanese force landed at the northeast corner of Chengmai Bay near Laocheng in support of the Haikou operation.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 10 日至 12 日，日军为策应海口、府城作战，另部在澄迈湾东北角、老城附近登陆，随后向金江、临高、福山方向推进。4 月 14 日占领澄迈县城金江。登陆点据人民网与海南史志网，具体滩头待页码级核对。
description.en: From 10 to 12 February 1939, to support the attack on Haikou and Fucheng, another Japanese force landed at the northeast corner of Chengmai Bay near Laocheng and advanced toward Jinjiang, Lingao and Fushan. It occupied Jinjiang, seat of Chengmai county, on 14 April. The landing site follows People’s Daily Online and Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军在头灶港、大旦港、马岭干溪登陆，三路进攻崖城。
summary.en: Japanese forces landed at Touzao, Dadan and Maling and attacked Yacheng by three routes.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 14 日，日军在三亚登陆后，另部从崖州湾头灶港、大旦港和马岭村西干溪登陆，三路进攻崖县县城。2 月 15 日占领崖城。登陆点据海南史志网，具体滩头与兵力待页码级核对。
description.en: On 14 February 1939, after landing at Sanya, another Japanese force came ashore at Touzao, Dadan and the dry creek west of Maling village on Yazhou Bay and attacked the county seat by three routes. Yacheng fell on 15 February. Landing sites follow Hainan local history and await page-level verification.

place.en: Baimajing, Dan county (north bank of Yangpu harbour entrance), Hainan

summary.zh: 日军川崎部队与海军陆战队在白马井登陆，随后占新英、新州。
summary.en: The Japanese Kawasaki force and naval landing troops came ashore at Baimajing and then took Xinying and Xinzhou.

description.zh: 1939 年 4 月 16 日，台湾混成旅团川崎部队与坂垣大佐指挥的海军陆战队在海南岛西部、今洋浦港入口北岸白马井登陆；4 月 17 日占新英港，4 月 18 日占儋县县城新州。登陆点据人民网与儋州地方史，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 16 April 1939 the Kawasaki force of the Taiwan Mixed Brigade and naval landing troops under Colonel Sakagami came ashore at Baimajing on the north bank of the present Yangpu harbour entrance in western Hainan. They took Xinying port on 17 April and Xinzhou, seat of Dan county, on 18 April. The landing site follows People’s Daily Online and Danzhou local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军进入清澜港，控制文昌沿海。
summary.en: Japanese forces entered Qinglan port and controlled the Wenchang coast.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 22 日日军占领文昌县城文城后，同部于 2 月 23 日进入清澜港。现有资料多写作“进入”，可能是自文城陆路推进，也可能是海上登陆，具体方式待页码级核对。清澜港失守后，日军控制文昌沿海与清澜湾。
description.en: After occupying Wencheng, seat of Wenchang county, on 22 February 1939, the same Japanese force entered Qinglan port on 23 February. Sources mostly say “entered”; it may have advanced overland from Wencheng or landed by sea, and the exact manner awaits page-level verification. The fall of Qinglan gave Japan control of the Wenchang coast and Qinglan Bay.

name.en: Japanese Occupation of Basuo and Beili

place.zh: 海南昌江八所、北黎（今东方）
place.en: Basuo and Beili, Changjiang (present-day Dongfang), Hainan

summary.zh: 日军占领八所、墩头、北黎，并在北黎设司令部。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Basuo, Duntou and Beili and established headquarters at Beili.

description.zh: 1939 年 7 月 18 日，日军侵犯昌江，占领新街、墩头、八所，并在北黎设立司令部。八所、北黎成为日军控制琼西南沿海、后来开采石碌铁矿和修建石八铁路的基地。登陆/占领方式与具体滩头待页码级核对。
description.en: On 18 July 1939 Japanese forces invaded Changjiang, occupied Xinjie, Duntou and Basuo, and established headquarters at Beili. Basuo and Beili became bases for controlling the southwest coast and later for mining the Shilu iron ore and building the Shilu–Basuo railway. The landing method and exact beachhead await page-level verification.

name.en: First Japanese Occupation of Sanzao Island

place.zh: 广东中山三灶岛（今珠海金湾）
place.en: Sanzao Island, Zhongshan (present-day Jinwan, Zhuhai), Guangdong

summary.zh: 日军首次占领三灶岛，盘踞 24 天后撤离。
summary.en: Japanese forces first occupied Sanzao Island and withdrew after 24 days.

description.zh: 1937 年 12 月 4 日，日军 400 余人从高栏岛出发，在汉奸带领下进犯三灶岛，占领莲塘附近各乡，24 天后撤离。三灶岛位于珠江口，是日军觊觎的华南航空基地选址。日期据珠海地方志与日军“妙高号”档案，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 4 December 1937 more than 400 Japanese troops moved from Gaolan Island with Chinese collaborators and attacked Sanzao Island, occupying villages around Liantang before withdrawing 24 days later. Sanzao, at the mouth of the Pearl River, was a prospective Japanese air base in South China. The date follows Zhuhai local gazetteers and the Japanese “Myōkō” archives and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 日军登陆三灶岛莲塘湾
name.en: Japanese Landing at Liantang Bay, Sanzao Island

summary.zh: 日军 6000 余人在莲塘湾登陆，占领三灶岛并修建海军第六航空基地。
summary.en: More than 6,000 Japanese troops landed at Liantang Bay, occupied Sanzao and built the Navy’s 6th Air Base.

description.zh: 1938 年 2 月 16 日，日军 6000 余人分乘 20 多艘舰艇在莲塘湾登陆，第二次占领三灶岛，随即在岛南海澄村一带修建机场，称“海军第六航空基地”。6 月 4 日第 14 航空队进驻，9 月 16 日高雄航空队临时进驻；岛上曾驻 74 架飞机、近千名航空人员。日期与兵力据珠海地方志，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 16 February 1938 more than 6,000 Japanese troops in over 20 ships landed at Liantang Bay and occupied Sanzao for the second time, then built an airfield near Haicheng village in the south of the island, designated the Navy’s 6th Air Base. The 14th Air Group arrived on 4 June and the Takao air unit on 16 September; at its height the base hosted 74 aircraft and nearly 1,000 air personnel. Dates and strength follow Zhuhai local gazetteers and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军在三灶岛实施“三光”政策，屠杀居民、焚毁村庄。
summary.en: Japanese forces carried out a “three-all” campaign on Sanzao Island, massacring residents and burning villages.

description.zh: 1938 年 4 月 12 日起，日军在三灶岛展开屠杀，实行“三光”政策。据珠海地方志，岛上 36 个村庄被毁、3264 间房屋和 164 艘渔船被焚；机场建成后，又秘密杀害修建机场的朝鲜籍与中国民工 3000 余人。具体死难人数待页码级核对。本事件为惨案，不绘路线。
description.en: From 12 April 1938 Japanese forces carried out a massacre on Sanzao Island under a “three-all” policy. According to Zhuhai local gazetteers, 36 villages were destroyed and 3,264 houses and 164 fishing boats burned; after the airfield was completed, more than 3,000 Korean and Chinese laborers who had built it were secretly killed. The exact death toll awaits page-level verification. As a massacre, this event is not drawn as a route.

name.en: Japanese Landing at Pinghai and Renshan

summary.zh: 日军第 104 师团在平海碧甲玻璃沙厂北面海岸登陆，占平海、稔山。
summary.en: The Japanese 104th Division landed on the coast north of the Biji glassworks at Pinghai and took Pinghai and Renshan.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 12 日凌晨，日军第 104 师团在大亚湾右面、平海碧甲（毕甲）玻璃沙厂北面海岸登陆，当天占平海，13 日占稔山、吉隆，随后向平山、惠州南面推进。登陆点据《广州战役》与惠州地方史，待页码级核对。
description.en: Before dawn on 12 October 1938 the Japanese 104th Division landed on the right flank of Dayawan, on the coast north of the Biji glassworks at Pinghai. It took Pinghai the same day and Renshan and Jilong on 13 October, then advanced toward Pingshan and the south of Huizhou. The landing site follows Guangzhou campaign and Huizhou local histories and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军及川支队在盐灶背南岸登陆。
summary.en: The Japanese Oikawa Detachment landed on the south bank at Yanzaobei.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 12 日凌晨，日军及川支队在大亚湾盐灶背南岸登陆，随后经稔山、平山方向配合主力进攻惠州。登陆点据《广州战役》与惠州地方史，待页码级核对。
description.en: Before dawn on 12 October 1938 the Japanese Oikawa Detachment landed on the south bank at Yanzaobei in Dayawan and advanced via Renshan and Pingshan in support of the main attack on Huizhou. The landing site follows Guangzhou campaign and Huizhou local histories and awaits page-level verification.
