name.en: Japanese Landing at Aotou and Xiachong

summary.zh: 日军第 18 师团主力在澳头以东马涌至霞涌以西桂米涌海滩登陆。
summary.en: The main force of the Japanese 18th Division landed on the beach from Mayong east of Aotou to Guimiyong west of Xiachong.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 12 日凌晨 2 时 45 分，日军第 18 师团主力在大亚湾中路、澳头圩以东 5 公里的马涌至霞涌墟以西桂米涌之间七八公里长的沙滩登陆；一部在澳头西南约 5 公里的倒装湾小桂登陆。当天进攻淡水，13 日占淡水。登陆点据《广州战役》与惠州地方史，待页码级核对。
description.en: At 02:45 on 12 October 1938 the main force of the Japanese 18th Division landed on the 7–8 km beach between Mayong, 5 km east of Aotou, and Guimiyong, west of Xiachong, in the central Dayawan sector; another element landed at Xiaogui in Daozhuang Bay about 5 km southwest of Aotou. It attacked Danshui that day and took it on 13 October. The landing sites follow Guangzhou campaign and Huizhou local histories and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 18 师团占领淡水。
summary.en: The Japanese 18th Division occupied Danshui.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 12 日日军在澳头、霞涌登陆后，经新桥、分墩、大径进攻淡水；13 日凌晨占领淡水城。中国守军第 151 师一部抵抗后向惠州方向撤退。日期据《广州战役》，待页码级核对。
description.en: After landing at Aotou and Xiachong on 12 October 1938, Japanese forces advanced on Danshui via Xinqiao, Fendun and Dajing and occupied the town in the early hours of 13 October. Part of the Chinese 151st Division resisted and then withdrew toward Huizhou. The date follows the Guangzhou campaign history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 18、第 104 师团攻占惠州。
summary.en: The Japanese 18th and 104th Divisions captured Huizhou.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 13 日日军自淡水、澳头、稔山三路进攻惠州，14 日占领横沥并进至惠州南郊。14 日黄昏日军攻城，中国守军第 151 师稍作抵抗后撤退，15 日惠州失陷。日期据《广州战役》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 13 October 1938 Japanese forces advanced on Huizhou from Danshui, Aotou and Renshan by three routes, took Hengli on 14 October and reached the southern outskirts. At dusk on 14 October they attacked the city; the Chinese 151st Division resisted briefly and withdrew, and Huizhou fell on 15 October. The date follows the Guangzhou campaign history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军攻占博罗，主力向增城突进。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Boluo and pushed on toward Zengcheng.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 16 日，日军攻占博罗，随后主力沿增博公路向增城突进；及川支队由惠州向广州作大迂回。日期据《广州战役》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 16 October 1938 Japanese forces captured Boluo and then pushed along the Boluo–Zengcheng road toward Zengcheng, while the Oikawa Detachment made a wide flanking move from Huizhou toward Guangzhou. The date follows the Guangzhou campaign history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 18 师团攻占增城。
summary.en: The Japanese 18th Division captured Zengcheng.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 19 日日军第 18 师团到达增城，与中国守军激战；20 日突破第 186 师防线，10 时占领增城以西钟岗，14 时增城县城失守。日期据《广州战役》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 19 October 1938 the Japanese 18th Division reached Zengcheng and fought the Chinese defenders; on 20 October it broke the 186th Division’s line, took Zhonggang west of the county town at 10:00 and the county town itself at 14:00. The date follows the Guangzhou campaign history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 104 师团占领从化，切断广州至韶关联系。
summary.en: The Japanese 104th Division occupied Conghua, cutting the Guangzhou–Shaoguan link.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 21 日广州失守后，日军第 104 师团向广州以北推进，攻占太平场，23 日占领从化，企图切断广州至韶关的联系。日期据《广州战役》，待页码级核对。
description.en: After the fall of Guangzhou on 21 October 1938, the Japanese 104th Division advanced north of the city, took Taipingchang and occupied Conghua on 23 October, aiming to cut the Guangzhou–Shaoguan link. The date follows the Guangzhou campaign history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 5 师团与海军攻占虎门要塞。
summary.en: The Japanese 5th Division and navy captured the Humen forts.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 23 日，日军第 5 师团与海军配合攻占虎门要塞，控制珠江口。虎门失守后，日军沿珠江口西进，25 日占三水、26 日占佛山。日期据《广州战役》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 23 October 1938 the Japanese 5th Division and navy captured the Humen forts and controlled the Pearl River estuary. After Humen fell, Japanese forces advanced west along the estuary, taking Sanshui on 25 October and Foshan on 26 October. The date follows the Guangzhou campaign history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 5 师团攻占三水。
summary.en: The Japanese 5th Division captured Sanshui.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 25 日，日军第 5 师团攻陷三水，控制西江、北江交汇地带。日期据《广州战役》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 25 October 1938 the Japanese 5th Division captured Sanshui, controlling the confluence of the West and North rivers. The date follows the Guangzhou campaign history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军占领佛山，控制广三铁路沿线。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Foshan and controlled the Guangzhou–Sanshui railway.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 26 日，日军占领南海县澜石、佛山两镇，佛山沦陷。日军随后控制广三铁路沿线与珠江三角洲要点。日期据佛山地方史，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 26 October 1938 Japanese forces occupied Lanshi and Foshan in Nanhai county, and Foshan fell. Japan then controlled the Guangzhou–Sanshui railway and key points in the Pearl River Delta. The date follows Foshan local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军占领顺德，控制珠江三角洲南部。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Shunde and controlled the southern Pearl River Delta.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月广州失守后，日军向珠江三角洲推进，10 月 23 日进攻陈村，26 日前后占领顺德各属。顺德县治大良此后多次易手，1940 年 2 月 29 日再度沦陷。日期据顺德地方史，待页码级核对。
description.en: After Guangzhou fell in October 1938, Japanese forces advanced into the Pearl River Delta, attacking Chencun on 23 October and occupying Shunde’s towns around 26 October. The county seat Daliang changed hands repeatedly and fell again on 29 February 1940. The date follows Shunde local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军占领番禺，控制广州南部与珠江航道。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Panyu and controlled southern Guangzhou and the Pearl River channels.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月广州失守后，日军第 21 军一部占领番禺，控制广州南部与珠江航道。11 月日军在番禺沙湾、石楼等地“扫荡”。日期据广州战役与番禺地方史，待页码级核对。
description.en: After Guangzhou fell in October 1938, elements of the Japanese 21st Army occupied Panyu and controlled southern Guangzhou and the Pearl River channels. In November Japanese forces conducted sweeps at Shawan and Shilou in Panyu. The date follows Guangzhou campaign and Panyu local histories and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第一次占领宝安南头、深圳镇。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Nantou and Shenzhen town for the first time.

description.zh: 1938 年 11 月 22 日，日军在大鹏湾登陆，随后东路由盐田、龙岗、沙头角直扑深圳镇，西路自虎门在沙井、西乡登岸进攻南头。11 月 26 日，日军占领深圳镇与南头城。11 月 30 日中国军队收复深圳镇，12 月 2 日收复宝安。日期据《深圳通史》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 22 November 1938 Japanese forces landed at Dapeng Bay; the eastern column advanced via Yantian, Longgang and Shatoujiao toward Shenzhen town, while the western column landed at Shajing and Xixiang from Humen and attacked Nantou. On 26 November Japanese troops occupied Shenzhen town and Nantou. Chinese forces recovered Shenzhen on 30 November and Bao’an on 2 December. The date follows the Shenzhen History and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军攻占江门，粤中门户失守。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Jiangmen, the gateway to central Guangdong.

description.zh: 1939 年 3 月 28 日，日军南支派遣军陆海空部队 2000 余人及伪军 800 余人进犯新会，29 日直逼江门外围。30 日下午江门守军退守城外，江门沦陷。日期据新会地方史，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 28 March 1939 more than 2,000 Japanese army, navy and air troops of the South China Expeditionary Army, with 800 puppet troops, attacked Xinhui and on 29 March closed on Jiangmen. On the afternoon of 30 March the defenders withdrew from the town and Jiangmen fell. The date follows Xinhui local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军攻占新会县城会城。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Huicheng, seat of Xinhui county.

description.zh: 1939 年 3 月 30 日江门失守后，日军向新会县城会城推进。中国守军省保七团增援，但兵力悬殊，4 月 2 日会城失守。日期据新会地方史，待页码级核对。
description.en: After Jiangmen fell on 30 March 1939, Japanese forces advanced on Huicheng, seat of Xinhui county. The Chinese 7th Security Regiment reinforced the town, but the defenders were outnumbered and Huicheng fell on 2 April. The date follows Xinhui local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军藤井兵团入侵中山，占领石岐。
summary.en: The Japanese Fujii Brigade invaded Zhongshan and occupied Shiqi.

description.zh: 1940 年 3 月 5 日，日军藤井兵团约 1 万人入侵中山，一路从顺德攻入大小黄圃，一路从海路登陆唐家、香洲；3 月 7 日占领石岐，3 月 15 日占小榄，中山县境大部分沦陷。日期据中山地方史，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 5 March 1940 the Japanese Fujii Brigade, about 10,000 strong, invaded Zhongshan: one column entered Dahuangpu and Xiaohuangpu from Shunde, another landed by sea at Tangjia and Xiangzhou. Shiqi fell on 7 March and Xiaolan on 15 March, and most of Zhongshan was occupied. The date follows Zhongshan local history and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Japanese Landing at Tangjia and Xiangzhou

place.zh: 广东中山唐家、香洲（今珠海）
place.en: Tangjia and Xiangzhou, Zhongshan (present-day Zhuhai), Guangdong

summary.zh: 日军海路登陆唐家、香洲，进攻前山、坦洲、翠亨。
summary.en: Japanese forces landed by sea at Tangjia and Xiangzhou and attacked Qianshan, Tanzhou and Cuiheng.

description.zh: 1940 年 3 月 6 日，日军一部从海路登陆中山唐家、香洲，随后攻陷前山、坦洲、翠亨，配合从顺德南下的主力包围石岐。日期据中山地方史，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 6 March 1940 a Japanese force landed by sea at Tangjia and Xiangzhou in Zhongshan and then took Qianshan, Tanzhou and Cuiheng, cooperating with the main force advancing south from Shunde to envelop Shiqi. The date follows Zhongshan local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 18 师团在赤湾登陆，再次占领南头、深圳镇。
summary.en: The Japanese 18th Division landed at Chiwan and again occupied Nantou and Shenzhen town.

description.zh: 1940 年 6 月 22 日，日军第 18 师团在赤湾登陆，当天占领南头、深圳镇，宝安第三次沦陷。此后日军长期盘踞宝安，直至 1945 年投降。日期据《深圳通史》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 22 June 1940 the Japanese 18th Division landed at Chiwan and occupied Nantou and Shenzhen town the same day, the third fall of Bao’an. Japanese forces then remained in Bao’an until their surrender in 1945. The date follows the Shenzhen History and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军海军陆战队在钱澳、长尾山一带登陆。
summary.en: Japanese naval landing forces came ashore at Qian’ao and Changweishan.

description.zh: 1938 年 6 月 20 日，日军舰艇、飞机轰炸南澳；21 日凌晨 3 时，日本海军陆战队 300 余人从钱澳、长尾山一带登陆，分四路进攻隆澳。中国守军保安营稍作抵抗后撤退。日期据汕头市档案馆，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 20 June 1938 Japanese warships and aircraft bombed Nan’ao; at 03:00 on 21 June more than 300 Japanese naval landing troops came ashore at Qian’ao and Changweishan and attacked Long’ao by four routes. The Chinese security battalion resisted briefly and withdrew. The date follows Shantou municipal archives and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军占领南澳全岛，这是潮汕第一个沦陷的县。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied all of Nan’ao, the first county in the Chaoshan region to fall.

description.zh: 1938 年 6 月 21 日日军登陆后，长驱直入占领县城隆澳，至 6 月 23 日控制南澳全岛。这是潮汕第一个沦陷的县。7 月 17 日中国义勇军一度收复南澳，7 月 20 日后日军反扑，8 月初南澳再陷。日期据汕头市档案馆，待页码级核对。
description.en: After landing on 21 June 1938, Japanese forces advanced unopposed into Long’ao and by 23 June controlled all of Nan’ao, the first county in the Chaoshan region to fall. Chinese volunteers briefly recovered the island on 17 July, but Japanese forces counterattacked after 20 July and Nan’ao fell again in early August. The date follows Shantou municipal archives and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军自潮州沿韩江进占澄海。
summary.en: Japanese forces advanced from Chaozhou along the Han River and occupied Chenghai.

description.zh: 1939 年 6 月 29 日，侵占汕头的日军由潮州沿韩江进占澄海，澄海沦陷。至此，韩江、榕江、练江出海口均被日军控制。日期据汕头市档案馆，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 29 June 1939 Japanese forces occupying Shantou advanced from Chaozhou along the Han River and occupied Chenghai. With this, the mouths of the Han, Rong and Lian rivers were all under Japanese control. The date follows Shantou municipal archives and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Surrender of Japanese Forces in Guangzhou

place.en: Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, Guangzhou, Guangdong

summary.zh: 张发奎在广州接受田中久一投降。
summary.en: Zhang Fakui accepted the surrender of Tanaka Hisakazu in Guangzhou.

description.zh: 1945 年 9 月 16 日上午 10 时，中国第二方面军司令官张发奎在广州中山纪念堂接受日本第 23 军司令官兼香港占领地总督田中久一投降，受降范围包括广州、雷州半岛与海南岛。日期据中国受降档案，待页码级核对。本事件为受降事件，不绘路线。
description.en: At 10:00 on 16 September 1945 Zhang Fakui, commander of the Chinese 2nd Front Army, accepted the surrender of Tanaka Hisakazu, commander of the Japanese 23rd Army and governor of occupied Hong Kong, at the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall in Guangzhou. The surrender covered Guangzhou, the Leizhou Peninsula and Hainan. The date follows Chinese surrender archives and awaits page-level verification. As a surrender event, it is not drawn as a route.

name.en: Surrender of Japanese Forces in Shantou

summary.zh: 余汉谋在汕头接受田中久一代表投降。
summary.en: Yu Hanmou accepted the surrender of Tanaka Hisakazu’s representative in Shantou.

description.zh: 1945 年 9 月 28 日上午 9 时，中国第七战区司令长官余汉谋派代表徐景唐在汕头“潮汕前进指挥所”接受日军第 23 军参谋长富田直亮代表田中久一投降，受降范围包括曲江、潮汕地区。日期据中国受降档案，待页码级核对。本事件为受降事件，不绘路线。
description.en: At 09:00 on 28 September 1945 Xu Jingtang, representing Chinese 7th War Zone commander Yu Hanmou, accepted the surrender of Major General Tomita Naoaki, chief of staff of the Japanese 23rd Army and representative of Tanaka Hisakazu, at the Chaoshan advance command post in Shantou. The surrender covered Qujiang and the Chaoshan region. The date follows Chinese surrender archives and awaits page-level verification. As a surrender event, it is not drawn as a route.

summary.zh: 日军第 18 师团突破铁扇关门防线，占领小楼、正果。
summary.en: The Japanese 18th Division broke the Tieshan Pass line and occupied Xiaolou and Zhengguo.

description.zh: 1939 年 12 月 15 日，日军第 18 师团万余人由增城沿增龙公路北上，17 日突破中国第 63 军第 151 师铁扇关门防线，进占小楼、正果。这是第一次粤北会战右路的起点。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 15 December 1939 more than 10,000 troops of the Japanese 18th Division advanced north from Zengcheng along the Zengcheng–Longmen road. On 17 December they broke the Tieshan Pass line of the Chinese 63rd Army’s 151st Division and occupied Xiaolou and Zhengguo, opening the right-wing advance of the first northern Guangdong campaign. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: The Japanese 18th Division occupied Yonghan.

description.zh: 1939 年 12 月 19 日，日军第 18 师团沿增城—龙门一线北上，占领永汉，随后继续向左潭、梅坑推进。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 19 December 1939 the Japanese 18th Division advanced north along the Zengcheng–Longmen axis and occupied Yonghan, then continued toward Zuotan and Meikeng. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: The Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade occupied Conghua.

description.zh: 1939 年 12 月 20 日，日军近卫混成旅团由从化方向北犯，占领从化县城；21 日进占鸡笼冈，随后分路进攻良口、牛背脊。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 20 December 1939 the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade advanced north from the Conghua direction and occupied Conghua county town; on 21 December it took Jilonggang and then advanced on Liangkou and Niubeiji. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军近卫混成旅团占领良口。
summary.en: The Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade occupied Liangkou.

description.zh: 1939 年 12 月 22 日，日军近卫混成旅团约 3000 人突破中国第 186 师蜈蚣山、热水、鸭洞阵地，占领良口；25 日又占吕田。良口、牛背脊是翁从公路要冲，此后成为中国军队反击的重点。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 22 December 1939 about 3,000 troops of the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade broke the Chinese 186th Division’s positions at Wugongshan, Reshui and Yadong and occupied Liangkou; on 25 December they took Lü tian. Liangkou and Niubeiji were key points on the Wengyuan–Conghua road and later became the focus of the Chinese counterattack. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 18 师团占梅坑，近卫混成旅团占吕田。
summary.en: The Japanese 18th Division took Meikeng and the Guard Mixed Brigade took Lü tian.

description.zh: 1939 年 12 月 25 日，日军第 18 师团突破中国军队防线，进占画眉堂、梅坑；同日近卫混成旅团集中七八千人突破第 151 师阵地，进占吕田。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 25 December 1939 the Japanese 18th Division broke the Chinese line and occupied Huameitang and Meikeng; the same day the Guard Mixed Brigade concentrated 7,000–8,000 troops, broke the 151st Division’s positions and occupied Lü tian. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: The Japanese 18th Division occupied Xinfeng.

description.zh: 1939 年 12 月 28 日，日军第 18 师团占领新丰，粤北战局危急。中国第 12 集团军急调第 54 军由湘入粤增援。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 28 December 1939 the Japanese 18th Division occupied Xinfeng, placing northern Guangdong in crisis. The Chinese 12th Group Army urgently moved the 54th Army from Hunan into Guangdong. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

description.zh: 1939 年 12 月 29 日，日军近卫混成旅团占官渡；30 日占领翁源，31 日占新江。日军三路对粤北形成大包围，但中国军队随即反击。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 29 December 1939 the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade took Guandu; on 30 December it occupied Wengyuan and on 31 December Xinjiang. The three Japanese columns had enveloped northern Guangdong, but the Chinese army counterattacked immediately. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

description.zh: 1939 年 12 月 30 日，日军第 104 师团沿粤汉铁路北犯，攻占英德。左路日军逼近曲江，第一次粤北会战进入最紧张阶段。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 30 December 1939 the Japanese 104th Division advanced north along the Canton–Hankou railway and captured Yingde. The left column was closing on Qujiang, the tensest phase of the first northern Guangdong campaign. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: The Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade occupied Xinjiang, closing on Qujiang.

description.zh: 1939 年 12 月 31 日，日军近卫混成旅团占领新江，兵锋直指曲江。1940 年 1 月 1 日，日军因桂南战场吃紧开始全线退却；中国军队追击，至 1 月 16 日收复清远、花县、从化、龙门等地。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 31 December 1939 the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade occupied Xinjiang and pointed directly at Qujiang. On 1 January 1940, with the Guangxi front under pressure, the Japanese began a general withdrawal; Chinese forces pursued and by 16 January had recovered Qingyuan, Hua county, Conghua and Longmen. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Fall of Hua County (Second Northern Guangdong Campaign)

summary.zh: 日军第 104 师团一部进攻花县，县城失守。
summary.en: Elements of the Japanese 104th Division attacked Hua county and captured the county town.

description.zh: 1940 年 5 月 16 日，日军第 104 师团一部与伪军 1000 余人分别由象山、两龙向十八岭、牛牯岭进犯，中国第 158 师抵抗数日后退守福源水、正迳花、街亭一带高地，花县县城失守。6 月 1 日中国军队收复花县。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。本事件不在 #123 路线上，标 `routeEvent:false`。
description.en: On 16 May 1940 elements of the Japanese 104th Division and more than 1,000 puppet troops attacked Shibaling and Niuguling from Xiangshan and Lianglong. The Chinese 158th Division resisted for several days before withdrawing to high ground at Fuyuanshui, Zhengjinghua and Jieting, and the county town fell. Chinese forces recovered Hua county on 1 June. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification. This event is not on route #123 and is marked routeEvent:false.

name.en: Fall of Jiekou (Second Northern Guangdong Campaign)

summary.zh: 日军第 38 师团占领从化街口。
summary.en: The Japanese 38th Division occupied Jiekou in Conghua.

description.zh: 1940 年 5 月 13 日，日军第 38 师团从神岗、太平场沿广从公路北犯。5 月 17 日，街口被占，中国第 187 师退守荷村、新庄、白石山一带。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 13 May 1940 the Japanese 38th Division advanced north from Shenggang and Taipingchang along the Guangzhou–Conghua road. Jiekou fell on 17 May and the Chinese 187th Division withdrew to Hecun, Xinzhuang and Baishishan. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 38 师团占领鸡笼冈、门楼关。
summary.en: The Japanese 38th Division occupied Jilonggang and Menlouguan.

description.zh: 1940 年 5 月 18 日，日军第 38 师团占领鸡笼冈、门楼关；18 至 20 日又由鸡笼冈分三路向良口进攻。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 18 May 1940 the Japanese 38th Division occupied Jilonggang and Menlouguan; from 18 to 20 May it advanced on Liangkou from Jilonggang by three routes. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Fall of Liangkou (Second Northern Guangdong Campaign)

summary.zh: 日军第 38 师团突破李寨顶，占领良口。
summary.en: The Japanese 38th Division broke the Lizhaiding position and occupied Liangkou.

description.zh: 1940 年 5 月 20 日，日军第 38 师团突破中国第 152 师李寨顶阵地，占领良口；22 日又攻占横坑、石榴花顶。中国军队随后在良口东西北三面反击。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 20 May 1940 the Japanese 38th Division broke the Chinese 152nd Division’s Lizhaiding position and occupied Liangkou; on 22 May it took Hengkeng and Shiliuhuading. Chinese forces then counterattacked from the east, west and north of Liangkou. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

place.zh: 广东从化良口石榴花顶

summary.zh: 日军进攻石榴花顶，中国第 152 师顽强阻击。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Shiliuhuading and the Chinese 152nd Division fought a stubborn defense.

description.zh: 1940 年 5 月 22 日凌晨，日军集中飞机、大炮向石榴花顶阵地猛攻，并施放毒气；中国第 152 师多次击退日军，终因兵力不足退至五指山阵地。24 日中国军队全线反攻，6 月 1 日日军退却，3 日收复良口。日期据从化文史网，待页码级核对。
description.en: Before dawn on 22 May 1940 Japanese forces concentrated aircraft and artillery against the Shiliuhuading position and used poison gas; the Chinese 152nd Division repelled several attacks but withdrew to Wuzhishan for lack of strength. On 24 May Chinese forces counterattacked all along the line; the Japanese withdrew on 1 June and Liangkou was recovered on 3 June. The date follows Conghua local history and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: First Japanese Air Raid on Suzhou

summary.zh: 1937年8月16日，日军航空队两批24架次首次轰炸苏州城，死伤500余人。
summary.en: On 16 August 1937 two waves of 24 Japanese aircraft bombed Suzhou for the first time, killing and wounding more than 500 people.

description.zh: 淞沪会战爆发后，日军航空队对苏州实施持续轰炸。8月16日，日机两批24架次首炸阊门外兵营和城内道前街、西善长巷、学士街一带，死伤500余人；至11月15日，苏州城区共受弹4200余颗，街市、房舍、学校、医院、工厂破坏严重。此为日军航空队对平民城市的无差别轰炸，不绘制地面路线。日期据《苏州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: After the Battle of Shanghai began, Japanese aircraft bombed Suzhou repeatedly. On 16 August 1937 two waves of 24 aircraft hit the barracks outside Changmen and the Daqian Street, Xishanchang Lane and Xueshi Street areas, killing and wounding more than 500 people; by 15 November the city had received more than 4,200 bombs. This was an indiscriminate air raid on a civilian city, so no ground route is drawn. The date follows the Suzhou chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年11月13日，日军从常熟白茆口、浒浦镇一带登陆，向常熟县城进击。
summary.en: On 13 November 1937 Japanese forces landed at Baimaokou and Hupu in Changshu and advanced on the county town.

description.zh: 日军登陆后沿途烧杀，吴市一带被杀害群众571人，全县3000余名群众被杀、3万余间房屋被烧。11月19日攻入常熟县城，杀害无辜群众1500人，烧毁全城三分之一房屋。此段为日军登陆后向常熟县城进攻的起点，路线为示意简化。
description.en: After landing, Japanese forces burned and killed along the way: 571 people were killed in the Wushi area, more than 3,000 across the county, and over 30,000 houses were burned. They entered Changshu on 19 November, killing some 1,500 civilians and burning a third of the city. This is the starting point of the advance on Changshu; the route is schematic.

summary.zh: 1937年11月15日，日军进攻昆山，吴县县政府官员撤逃。
summary.en: On 15 November 1937 Japanese forces attacked Kunshan; officials of Wu county government fled.

description.zh: 淞沪会战后期，日军沿京沪铁路西进。11月15日进攻昆山，昆山城陷的具体日期史料记载不一，本事件只记「进攻」，不写「沦陷」；路线自昆山向苏州，表示日军沿铁路西进方向。日期据《1937年江苏历史大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the late stage of the Battle of Shanghai, Japanese forces advanced west along the Nanjing–Shanghai railway. They attacked Kunshan on 15 November; sources differ on the exact date the town fell, so this event records the attack rather than the fall. The route from Kunshan to Suzhou shows the westward advance and is schematic. The date follows the 1937 Jiangsu chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年11月19日，日军攻入常熟县城，常熟沦陷。
summary.en: On 19 November 1937 Japanese forces entered Changshu and the county town fell.

description.zh: 日军从白茆口登陆后于11月19日攻入常熟县城。城内商店停业，南门莲墩浜盐公堂发生机枪扫射，300余人被杀；全城三分之一房屋被烧。三源日期一致。
description.en: After landing at Baimaokou, Japanese forces entered Changshu on 19 November. Shops closed, more than 300 people were machine-gunned at the Liandunbang salt depot by the south gate, and a third of the city's houses were burned. Three sources agree on the date.

summary.zh: 1937年11月19日，日军攻入苏州城，苏州沦陷。
summary.en: On 19 November 1937 Japanese forces entered Suzhou and the city fell.

description.zh: 11月17日日军分两路进犯苏州，19日第10军海劳原部攻入苏州城。城郊遭血腥屠杀，6774人被杀，大火燃烧三天三夜；城内尸骸枕藉，银行、店铺、住宅被劫掠。三源日期一致。
description.en: Japanese forces attacked Suzhou from two directions on 17 November and the 10th Army entered the city on 19 November. Some 6,774 people were killed in the suburbs and fires burned for three days; banks, shops and homes were looted. Three sources agree on the date.

summary.zh: 1937年11月24日，日军在无锡东亭许巷放火焚烧全村，用机枪杀害群众223人。
summary.en: On 24 November 1937 Japanese troops burned Xuxiang village in Dongting, Wuxi, and machine-gunned 223 people.

description.zh: 11月23日日军分两路进犯无锡，一路从常熟白茆口登陆，另一路从苏州沿京杭运河西进。24日，日军在东亭许巷放火焚烧全村，用机枪杀害群众223人。此为日军进攻无锡途中的暴行，不单独绘线。数字据《1937年江苏历史大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Japanese forces attacked Wuxi from two directions on 23 November: one column landed at Baimaokou in Changshu, the other advanced west from Suzhou along the Grand Canal. On 24 November they burned Xuxiang village in Dongting and machine-gunned 223 people. This atrocity during the advance on Wuxi is not drawn as a separate route. The figure follows the 1937 Jiangsu chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年11月25日，日军侵占无锡，随后大肆烧杀。
summary.en: On 25 November 1937 Japanese forces occupied Wuxi and carried out large-scale burning and killing.

description.zh: 11月25日，日军第16师团第20联队侵占无锡。占领后最初三天，从闾口桥至吴桥被残杀的无辜平民尸体有2000余具；日军纵火焚烧城区，大火七日不熄，全城房屋被焚半数以上。无锡沦陷日期有11月25日与11月27日两说，本事件取25日通行说法，正文并列27日说。
description.en: On 25 November the Japanese 16th Division's 20th Regiment occupied Wuxi. In the first three days more than 2,000 civilian bodies were counted between Lukou Bridge and Wu Bridge; fires burned for seven days and more than half the city's houses were destroyed. Sources give both 25 and 27 November; this event follows the common 25 November account and notes the alternative.

summary.zh: 1937年11月28日，日军占领宜兴，街头收尸700余具。
summary.en: On 28 November 1937 Japanese forces took Yixing; more than 700 bodies were collected from the streets.

description.zh: 11月28日，由浙江长兴转向北进的日军第10军所部占领宜兴，街头尸体遍地，经雇工以芦席裹尸，收尸700余具。宜兴是太湖南岸一路日军向南京迂回的重要节点。日期据南京大屠杀纪念馆与《中华民族抗日编年》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 28 November troops of the Japanese 10th Army, turning north from Changxing in Zhejiang, occupied Yixing. Bodies lay in the streets and more than 700 were collected by hired workers. Yixing was an important node on the southern Taihu route to Nanjing. The date follows the Nanjing memorial and the Chinese war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年11月29日，日军攻占常州，烧杀淫掠。
summary.en: On 29 November 1937 Japanese forces took Changzhou and burned, killed and looted.

description.zh: 11月29日，日军第16师团攻占常州。日军沿路烧杀，仅常州、戚墅堰等地即毁房9000余间、被杀4000余人；城东北三河口等乡镇一半街道化为灰烬。三源日期一致。
description.en: On 29 November the Japanese 16th Division took Changzhou. Along the way it burned and killed: more than 9,000 houses were destroyed and over 4,000 people killed in Changzhou and Qishuyan alone, and half the streets of Sanhekou and other northeastern townships were reduced to ashes. Three sources agree on the date.

summary.zh: 1937年12月2日，日军攻占江阴要塞。
summary.en: On 2 December 1937 Japanese forces captured the Jiangyin fortress.

description.zh: 江阴为长江下游要塞。11月27日起日军以海空军进攻江阴要塞，中国海军与要塞守军奋战六昼夜；日军又调陆军从无锡三面围攻，12月2日攻占江阴要塞。江阴城在11月底已失守，本事件专记要塞，避免把城陷与要塞陷混为一谈。
description.en: Jiangyin was a key fortress on the lower Yangtze. From 27 November Japanese sea and air forces attacked the fortress; Chinese naval and garrison troops fought for six days and nights, while Japanese ground troops attacked from three directions from Wuxi. The fortress fell on 2 December. The town had already fallen in late November; this event records the fortress specifically to avoid conflating the two.

summary.zh: 1937年12月2日，日军攻占丹阳。
summary.en: On 2 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Danyang.

description.zh: 12月2日，日军攻占丹阳，在城郊皇塘、折柳、井巷、横塘等地杀害无辜农民120余人。丹阳是京沪铁路与京杭运河交会处，为日军西进南京的通道。
description.en: On 2 December Japanese forces took Danyang and killed more than 120 peasants in Huangtang, Zheliu, Jingxiang and Hengtang. Danyang, at the junction of the Nanjing–Shanghai railway and the Grand Canal, was a corridor for the Japanese advance on Nanjing.

summary.zh: 1937年12月2日，日军攻占金坛。
summary.en: On 2 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Jintan.

description.zh: 12月2日，日军第9师团由常州出发攻占金坛，烧毁房屋千余间，枪杀农民200余人。金坛是日军第9师团经溧水、句容进攻南京的必经之地。
description.en: On 2 December the Japanese 9th Division advanced from Changzhou and took Jintan, burning more than 1,000 houses and shooting over 200 peasants. Jintan lay on the 9th Division's route to Nanjing via Lishui and Jurong.

summary.zh: 1937年12月2日，日军攻占溧阳。
summary.en: On 2 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Liyang.

description.zh: 12月2日，日军攻占溧阳。溧阳位于太湖南岸通往南京的公路线上，与金坛、丹阳同日失守。具体日期据《1937年江苏历史大事记》，省级党史只记 12 月日军攻陷江苏全省，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 2 December Japanese forces took Liyang. Liyang lay on the road from the southern shore of Taihu to Nanjing and fell the same day as Jintan and Danyang. The specific date follows the 1937 Jiangsu chronicle; the provincial party history only records the general December collapse and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年12月4日，日军攻占溧水。
summary.en: On 4 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Lishui.

description.zh: 12月4日，日军攻占溧水。溧水是南京东南门户，日军自溧阳、金坛方向西进，12月4日陷溧水，5日陷句容，随后逼近南京。日期据《1937年江苏历史大事记》与国家档案局《第51师卫戍南京战斗经过》。
description.en: On 4 December Japanese forces took Lishui. As the southeastern gateway to Nanjing, Lishui fell on 4 December and Jurong on 5 December, after which the Japanese closed on Nanjing. The date follows the 1937 Jiangsu chronicle and the National Archives account of the 51st Division.

summary.zh: 1937年12月5日，日军攻占句容。
summary.en: On 5 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Jurong.

description.zh: 12月5日，日军攻占句容。句容是南京东南重要屏障，日军占领后沿句容—南京公路推进，参加南京外围作战。日期据《1937年江苏历史大事记》与国家档案局《第51师卫戍南京战斗经过》。
description.en: On 5 December Japanese forces took Jurong, an important southeastern shield for Nanjing. They then advanced along the Jurong–Nanjing road into the outer battle for Nanjing. The date follows the 1937 Jiangsu chronicle and the National Archives account of the 51st Division.

summary.zh: 1937年12月8日，日军攻占镇江，大肆烧杀。
summary.en: On 8 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Zhenjiang and carried out large-scale burning and killing.

description.zh: 12月8日，日军第11师团天谷支队攻占镇江。日军在镇江大肆烧杀淫掠，后经慈善团体收埋尸体3000余具；据伪丹徒县署统计，被枪杀民众达4525人，烧毁房屋30151间。三源日期一致。
description.en: On 8 December the Japanese 11th Division's Amaya detachment took Zhenjiang. Japanese troops burned, killed and looted; charities buried more than 3,000 bodies, and the puppet Dantu county office recorded 4,525 people shot and 30,151 houses burned. Three sources agree on the date.

summary.zh: 1937年12月14日，日军渡江攻占扬州。
summary.en: On 14 December 1937 Japanese forces crossed the Yangtze and captured Yangzhou.

description.zh: 12月14日，日军第13师团天谷支队渡江攻占扬州。日军逐街逐院搜杀，进城头三天杀害市民500余人；占领第一周有600多名妇女被污辱。扬州沦陷后，江苏省政府已于12月14日前匆忙迁往淮阴。
description.en: On 14 December the Japanese 13th Division's Amaya detachment crossed the Yangtze and took Yangzhou. Troops searched street by street and courtyard by courtyard, killing more than 500 residents in the first three days; over 600 women were raped in the first week. The Jiangsu provincial government had already fled to Huaiyin before the fall.

summary.zh: 1937年12月17日，驻扬州日军在万福桥屠杀民夫400余人。
summary.en: On 17 December 1937 Japanese troops in Yangzhou massacred more than 400 labourers at Wanfu Bridge.

description.zh: 12月17日，驻扬州日军在城东万福桥屠杀民夫400余人，仅一人跳水逃生；万福村100多间房屋被烧、100多名百姓被杀。惨案数字有400余人与460余人两说，正文并列。此为暴行事件，不绘路线。
description.en: On 17 December Japanese troops in Yangzhou massacred more than 400 labourers at Wanfu Bridge east of the city; only one man escaped by jumping into the river. More than 100 houses were burned in Wanfu village and over 100 villagers killed. Sources give both 400-plus and 460-plus; both are noted. This atrocity is not drawn as a route.

name.en: Landing at Yaogang and Fall of Nantong

summary.zh: 1938年3月17日，日军约5000人在南通姚港登陆，当日南通城沦陷。
summary.en: On 17 March 1938 about 5,000 Japanese troops landed at Yaogang near Nantong; the city fell the same day.

description.zh: 1938年3月17日，日军约5000人在南通城郊姚港附近登陆，国民党部队未作有效抵抗即弃城而走，南通城当日沦陷。日军随后沿公路进犯如皋、海门、东台。日期据南通市志办、南通史志办，两源一致。
description.en: On 17 March 1938 about 5,000 Japanese troops landed near Yaogang outside Nantong. Nationalist units withdrew without effective resistance and the city fell the same day. Japanese forces then advanced along the roads toward Rugao, Haimen and Dongtai. Two Nantong chronicles agree on the date.

sources.title: 《南通地区抗日战争大事年表》
sources.author: 南通市地方志办公室

summary.zh: 1938年3月19日，日军侵占如皋城。
summary.en: On 19 March 1938 Japanese forces occupied Rugao.

description.zh: 3月19日中午，日军在飞机大炮掩护下进入如皋城，四处搜捕抢掠，焚毁南门吊桥至地藏庙间房屋，明代大觉庵200余间全毁。日期据南通市志办、南通史志办，两源一致。
description.en: At noon on 19 March Japanese troops entered Rugao under air and artillery cover, searching and looting. They burned the houses between the south gate drawbridge and Dizang Temple, including more than 200 rooms of the Ming-era Dajue Nunnery. Two Nantong chronicles agree on the date.

sources.title: 《南通地区抗日战争大事年表》
sources.author: 南通市地方志办公室

summary.zh: 1938年3月21日，日军进犯海门，占领茅镇、三厂、青龙港、四甲坝。
summary.en: On 21 March 1938 Japanese forces attacked Haimen and occupied Maozhen, Sanchang, Qinglonggang and Sijiaba.

description.zh: 3月21日清晨，日军5000余人由南通沿公路进犯海门，先后占领海门县治茅镇及三厂、青龙港、四甲坝等地，国民党海门县政府退驻江家镇。日期据南通史志办与《日军肆虐海门纪略》。
description.en: At dawn on 21 March more than 5,000 Japanese troops advanced from Nantong along the road into Haimen, occupying the county seat of Maozhen as well as Sanchang, Qinglonggang and Sijiaba. The Nationalist county government retreated to Jiangjia town. The date follows the Nantong chronicle and the Haimen account.

summary.zh: 1938年3月25日，日军川上部侵占东台城。
summary.en: On 25 March 1938 the Japanese Kawakami unit occupied Dongtai.

description.zh: 3月25日，日军川上部侵占东台城，烧杀抢掠，魁星楼遭炮击，东台城首次沦陷。此前南通沦陷后，万余难民逃入东台。日期据《东台抗战大事记》与中共江苏地方简史。
description.en: On 25 March the Japanese Kawakami unit occupied Dongtai, burning, killing and looting; the Kuixing Tower was shelled. This was the city's first fall. After Nantong fell, more than 10,000 refugees had fled to Dongtai. The date follows the Dongtai chronicle and the provincial party history.

summary.zh: 1938年4月26日，日军占领盐城，焚城七天七夜。
summary.en: On 26 April 1938 Japanese forces occupied Yancheng and burned the city for seven days and nights.

description.zh: 4月26日，日军占领盐城，焚城七天七夜，造成盐城历史上空前浩劫；第一次侵占时烧毁房屋4.5万间，红十字会收埋尸体480余具。日期据中共江苏地方简史与盐城市史志网。
description.en: On 26 April Japanese forces took Yancheng and burned it for seven days and nights, an unprecedented disaster in the city's history. During the first occupation 45,000 houses were burned and the Red Cross buried more than 480 bodies. The date follows the provincial party history and the Yancheng gazetteer website.

summary.zh: 1938年5月7日，日军攻占阜宁城，实行「三光」。
summary.en: On 7 May 1938 Japanese forces captured Funing and carried out a "three-all" campaign.

description.zh: 5月7日，日军攻占阜宁城，疯狂实行「三光」政策，先将守军未及撤走的伤员全部杀害，又在城内城外及附近村庄烧杀淫掠。日期据中共江苏地方简史与《日寇暴行录》。
description.en: On 7 May Japanese forces took Funing and carried out a "three-all" policy: they first killed the wounded soldiers left behind, then burned, killed and raped in the city and nearby villages. The date follows the provincial party history and the atrocity record.

summary.zh: 1938年11月22日，日军攻陷宿迁城（通行说法）。
summary.en: On 22 November 1938 Japanese forces captured Suqian (common account).

description.zh: 11月20日，日军约3000人在飞机、坦克配合下沿宿睢公路东犯，进攻宿迁；11月22日宿城陷落（通行说法），日军进城后屠杀居民，宿城惨案清理尸体4000余具。宿迁沦陷日期另有「11月下旬」说，正文并列。
description.en: On 20 November about 3,000 Japanese troops with aircraft and tanks advanced east along the Suqian–Suining road and attacked Suqian. The city fell on 22 November in the common account; Japanese troops then massacred residents, and more than 4,000 bodies were recovered after the Suqian massacre. Some sources say only "late November"; both are noted.

summary.zh: 1939年2月28日，日军占领连云港及云台山大桅尖。
summary.en: On 28 February 1939 Japanese forces occupied Lianyungang and the Dazhujian peak of Yuntai Mountain.

description.zh: 1939年2月27日，中国守军放弃连云港，2月28日日军占领连云港及云台山大桅尖；3月4日占领墟沟，连云地区全境沦陷。连云港保卫战自1938年5月开始，历时约289天。日期据《连云港保卫战》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 27 February 1939 Chinese defenders abandoned Lianyungang; on 28 February Japanese forces occupied the port and the Dazhujian peak, and on 4 March they took Xugou, completing the occupation of the Lianyungang area. The defence had lasted about 289 days since May 1938. The date follows the Lianyungang campaign account and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1939年3月4日，日军占领海州、新浦、连云港。
summary.en: On 4 March 1939 Japanese forces occupied Haizhou, Xinpu and Lianyungang.

description.zh: 3月4日上午，日军第114师团步兵1个大队、第21师团步兵1个大队及第5师团第212联队向海州城发起进攻，联合各路部队占领海州、新浦、连云港。海州地区全境沦陷后，日军在新浦设立海州特务机关。
description.en: On the morning of 4 March, one battalion of the Japanese 114th Division, one of the 21st Division and the 212th Regiment of the 5th Division attacked Haizhou and, together with other columns, occupied Haizhou, Xinpu and Lianyungang. After the area fell, the Japanese set up the Haizhou special agency in Xinpu.

summary.zh: 1939年3月1日，日军一夜之间侵入淮阴城。
summary.en: On 1 March 1939 Japanese forces entered Huaiyin overnight.

description.zh: 1939年3月1日，由连云港沿盐河、由宿迁沿运河、由沭阳沿淮沭路三个方向的日军，一夜之间侵入淮阴城；淮安、涟水等地相继沦陷。国民党江苏省政府及第24集团军总部连夜撤离。日期据淮安地方史与中共江苏地方简史。
description.en: On 1 March 1939 Japanese columns from Lianyungang along the Yan River, from Suqian along the Grand Canal and from Shuyang along the Huaishu road entered Huaiyin overnight; Huaian and Lianshui fell soon after. The Nationalist Jiangsu provincial government and the 24th Group Army headquarters fled during the night. The date follows Huai'an local history and the provincial party history.

summary.zh: 1939年10月2日，日军侵占高邮城。
summary.en: On 2 October 1939 Japanese forces occupied Gaoyou.

description.zh: 1939年10月2日黎明，8架日机轮番轰炸车逻镇、高邮城，掩护日军独立混成旅两个大队乘汽艇由高邮湖石工头登陆，上午7时许翻越城墙进入高邮城。日军占领后连续屠杀，杀害无辜百姓1200余人。日期据《高邮日报》与高邮市文史资料。
description.en: At dawn on 2 October 1939 eight Japanese aircraft bombed Cheluo and Gaoyou, covering two battalions of an independent mixed brigade that landed by motorboat at Shigongtou on Gaoyou Lake and entered the city over the wall around 7 a.m. After the occupation Japanese troops killed more than 1,200 civilians. The date follows the Gaoyou newspaper and local文史 materials.

summary.zh: 1941年2月16日，日军独立混成第12旅团进驻泰州。
summary.en: On 16 February 1941 the Japanese 12th Independent Mixed Brigade entered Taizhou.

description.zh: 1941年2月13日，鲁苏皖边区游击总指挥部副总指挥李长江率部投敌，泰州城沦陷；2月16日，日军独立混成第12旅团进驻泰县县城。新四军随后发起讨逆战役，2月21日攻克泰州后主动撤出。本事件记日军进驻，日期取2月16日，正文并列2月13日、2月15日说。
description.en: On 13 February 1941 Li Changjiang, deputy commander of the Lu-Su-Wan guerrilla headquarters, defected with his troops and Taizhou fell; on 16 February the Japanese 12th Independent Mixed Brigade entered the county seat. The New Fourth Army then launched a punitive campaign, took Taizhou on 21 February and withdrew. This event records the Japanese entry on 16 February and notes the 13 and 15 February accounts.

summary.zh: 1943年4月起，日伪对苏中四分区（南通、如皋、海门、启东）全面「清乡」。
summary.en: From April 1943 Japanese and puppet forces carried out a full "qingxiang" (clearance) campaign in the Fourth Sub-district of Central Jiangsu (Nantong, Rugao, Haimen and Qidong).

description.zh: 1943年4月起，日伪对苏中四分区全面「清乡」，在清乡区边沿构筑竹篱笆封锁线，区内据点增至200余处；4月11日「苏北地区清乡主任公署」在南通城成立。此为过程性统治事件，日期取4月开始，不绘路线。
description.en: From April 1943 Japanese and puppet forces carried out a full clearance campaign in the Fourth Sub-district, building bamboo blockade fences along its edges and increasing strongpoints inside to more than 200; on 11 April the "North Jiangsu Clearance Administration" was established in Nantong. This is a process event dated to the start of April and is not drawn as a route.

summary.zh: 1937年11月30日，日军第18师团攻占广德，第145师师长饶国华殉国。
summary.en: On 30 November 1937 the Japanese 18th Division captured Guangde; Major General Rao Guohua of the 145th Division died in the defence.

description.zh: 11月23日日军第18师团及伪满军一部由浙江泗安进攻广德东部界牌，一度占领窑机场，被第145师击退。11月26日起日军飞机数百架次轰炸广德、芜湖、安庆、阜阳等地；11月30日广德县城失守，第145师师长饶国华自杀殉国。日军焚毁县城周围10公里内集镇，杀害居民近2万人。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》与人民网，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 23 November the Japanese 18th Division and a Manchukuo unit attacked Jiepai east of Guangde and briefly seized the airfield before being driven back by the 145th Division. From 26 November Japanese aircraft bombed Guangde, Wuhu, Anqing and Fuyang; on 30 November Guangde fell and Major General Rao Guohua took his own life. Japanese troops burned market towns within 10 km of the county seat and killed nearly 20,000 residents. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and People's Daily and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年12月5日，郎溪失陷。
summary.en: On 5 December 1937 Langxi fell.

description.zh: 广德失守后，日军第18师团兵分两路，一路经宣城、湾沚进攻芜湖，一路经郎溪、溧阳迂回南京。12月5日郎溪失陷。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: After Guangde fell, the Japanese 18th Division split: one column moved via Xuancheng and Wanzhi toward Wuhu, the other via Langxi and Liyang to outflank Nanjing. Langxi fell on 5 December. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

sources.author: 安徽文化网

summary.zh: 1937年12月6日，宣城失陷。
summary.en: On 6 December 1937 Xuancheng fell.

description.zh: 12月5日郎溪失陷后，日军第18师团继续北犯，12月6日宣城失陷。宣城是皖南通往芜湖、南京的交通节点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: After Langxi fell on 5 December, the Japanese 18th Division advanced north and took Xuancheng on 6 December. Xuancheng was a transport node between southern Anhui, Wuhu and Nanjing. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年12月10日，芜湖沦陷。
summary.en: On 10 December 1937 Wuhu fell.

description.zh: 12月10日，日军第18师团攻占芜湖。日军在芜湖大肆屠杀平民，据红十字会统计，1938年一年内被杀平民即达997人；12月12日，芜湖日军炮击英舰「蜜蜂号」「瓢虫号」，并在和县江面炸沉美舰「巴纳号」。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》与人民网，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 10 December the Japanese 18th Division took Wuhu. Japanese troops massacred civilians; the Red Cross recorded 997 civilians killed in 1938 alone. On 12 December Japanese forces at Wuhu shelled the British gunboats Bee and Ladybird, and Japanese aircraft sank the US gunboat Panay on the Yangtze near He county. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and People's Daily and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年12月11日，当涂沦陷。
summary.en: On 11 December 1937 Dangtu fell.

description.zh: 芜湖失陷次日，日军沿长江东岸北进，12月11日当涂沦陷。当涂是芜湖通往马鞍山、南京的沿江节点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: The day after Wuhu fell, Japanese forces advanced north along the east bank of the Yangtze and took Dangtu on 11 December. Dangtu was a riverine node between Wuhu, Ma'anshan and Nanjing. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

sources.author: 安徽文化网

summary.zh: 1937年12月12日，日机在和县江面炸沉美舰「巴纳号」。
summary.en: On 12 December 1937 Japanese aircraft sank the US gunboat Panay on the Yangtze near He county.

description.zh: 12月12日，日军飞机在和县江面炸沉美国海军炮舰「巴纳号」，美军公司两艘油轮被炸起火；同日芜湖日军炮击英舰「蜜蜂号」「瓢虫号」和英国货轮「清泰号」，造成英国水兵伤亡。事后英美政府仅向日本政府提出抗议。该事件是日军在长江流域对第三国军舰的直接攻击，不绘地面路线。
description.en: On 12 December Japanese aircraft sank the US Navy gunboat Panay on the Yangtze near He county and set two Standard Oil tankers on fire; the same day Japanese forces at Wuhu shelled the British gunboats Bee and Ladybird and the British freighter Ching Tai, causing British casualties. Britain and the United States only protested. This direct attack on third-country warships is not drawn as a ground route.

summary.zh: 1937年12月22日，全椒沦陷。
summary.en: On 22 December 1937 Quanjiao fell.

description.zh: 12月22日，全椒沦陷；次日日军占领马鞍山矿区，24日滁县沦陷。日军沿津浦铁路南段与滁河推进，切断南京江北退路。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Quanjiao fell on 22 December; the next day Japanese forces occupied the Ma'anshan iron mines, and Chuxian fell on 24 December. Japanese forces advanced along the southern Tianjin–Pukou railway and the Chu River, cutting the Nationalist retreat north of Nanjing. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年12月23日，日军占领马鞍山矿区。
summary.en: On 23 December 1937 Japanese forces occupied the Ma'anshan iron-mining area.

description.zh: 12月23日，日军占领马鞍山矿区，随后由日伪华中矿业公司开采铁矿，向日本本土和伪满输送。马鞍山矿区是日军在安徽掠夺战略资源的重要据点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 23 December Japanese forces occupied the Ma'anshan iron-mining area. The Japanese-controlled Central China Mining Company then extracted iron ore for Japan and Manchukuo. The mines were an important base for Japan's seizure of strategic resources in Anhui. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年12月24日，滁县沦陷。
summary.en: On 24 December 1937 Chuxian fell.

description.zh: 12月24日，滁县沦陷。滁县位于津浦铁路南段，是南京江北门户；日军占领后沿铁路继续北犯明光、蚌埠。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Chuxian fell on 24 December. Located on the southern section of the Tianjin–Pukou railway, it was the northern gateway to Nanjing; after occupying it Japanese forces continued north toward Mingguang and Bengbu. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年1月18日，明光失陷。
summary.en: On 18 January 1938 Mingguang fell.

description.zh: 1月18日，津浦路南段和淮河防御战开始，国民党第31军沿津浦路抵抗进攻徐州的日军，明光当日失陷。明光是津浦铁路南段重镇。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 18 January the defence of the southern Tianjin–Pukou railway and the Huai River began. The Chinese 31st Army resisted the Japanese drive toward Xuzhou along the railway, but Mingguang fell that day. Mingguang was a key town on the southern section of the railway. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年1月30日，定远池河失陷。
summary.en: On 30 January 1938 Chihe in Dingyuan fell.

description.zh: 1月30日，国民党第31军在定远池河镇阻击日军，激战数天后撤守，池河失陷。池河是津浦路西侧通往定远、蚌埠的要点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 30 January the Chinese 31st Army fought a delaying action at Chihe in Dingyuan and then withdrew; Chihe fell. The town was a key point west of the Tianjin–Pukou railway on the road to Dingyuan and Bengbu. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年2月1日，临淮关失陷。
summary.en: On 1 February 1938 Linhuaiguan fell.

description.zh: 2月1日，国民党第3集团军第50军工事尽毁，入夜临淮关失陷。临淮关是淮河与津浦铁路交会处，日军由此渡淮南犯蚌埠。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 1 February the positions of the Chinese 50th Army, 3rd Group Army, were destroyed and Linhuaiguan fell that night. At the junction of the Huai River and the Tianjin–Pukou railway, it was the crossing point from which Japanese forces moved south toward Bengbu. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年2月2日，定远失陷。
summary.en: On 2 February 1938 Dingyuan fell.

description.zh: 2月2日，定远、凤阳、蚌埠相继失陷。定远位于津浦路西侧，是日军控制淮河中游、掩护蚌埠侧翼的要点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 2 February Dingyuan, Fengyang and Bengbu fell in succession. West of the Tianjin–Pukou railway, Dingyuan was a key point for controlling the middle Huai River and covering Bengbu's flank. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年2月2日，凤阳失陷。
summary.en: On 2 February 1938 Fengyang fell.

description.zh: 2月2日，凤阳与定远、蚌埠同日失陷。凤阳是淮河中游重镇，明中都皇城所在地；日军占领后纵火焚烧，县城遭到严重破坏。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Fengyang fell on 2 February together with Dingyuan and Bengbu. A key town on the middle Huai River and site of the Ming central capital, it was heavily damaged by Japanese burning after occupation. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年2月2日，蚌埠失陷。
summary.en: On 2 February 1938 Bengbu fell.

description.zh: 1月31日，驻守蚌埠的国民党军第167师撤往淮河北岸，夜间炸毁淮河铁桥；2月2日蚌埠失陷。蚌埠是津浦铁路与淮河交会处，此后成为日军在安徽的统治中心，伪安徽省政府于1938年10月28日设于此。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 31 January the Chinese 167th Division withdrew north of the Huai River and blew up the railway bridge that night; Bengbu fell on 2 February. At the junction of the Tianjin–Pukou railway and the Huai River, Bengbu became the centre of Japanese rule in Anhui, and the puppet Anhui provincial government was established there on 28 October 1938. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年2月4日，日军在凤阳山马村烧毁全村，杀死350余人。
summary.en: On 4 February 1938 Japanese troops burned Shanmacun in Fengyang and killed more than 350 people.

description.zh: 2月4日（农历正月初五），300余名日军包围凤阳县山马村，先以机枪扫射，再入村逐户搜杀，焚烧全村；被杀群众350余人。此为本批日军在淮河中游制造的典型惨案，不绘路线。日期与数字据《安徽沦陷大事记》与人民网，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 4 February (the fifth day of the first lunar month) more than 300 Japanese troops surrounded Shanmacun in Fengyang, machine-gunned the villagers, searched house by house and burned the village, killing over 350 people. This is a representative atrocity in the middle Huai River area and is not drawn as a route. The date and figures follow the Anhui occupation chronology and People's Daily and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年2月5日，日军强渡淮河进占怀远。
summary.en: On 5 February 1938 Japanese forces crossed the Huai River and occupied Huaiyuan.

description.zh: 2月5日，日军以飞机大炮掩护强渡淮河，进占怀远。此后日军在淮河北岸与小蚌埠、临淮关北岸与中国军队反复争夺。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 5 February Japanese forces crossed the Huai River under air and artillery cover and occupied Huaiyuan. Japanese and Chinese forces then contested the north bank of the Huai around Xiaobengbu and the north bank at Linhuaiguan. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年5月9日，蒙城失陷。
summary.en: On 9 May 1938 Mengcheng fell.

description.zh: 5月7日，日军第13师团在飞机配合下猛攻蒙城，国民党第48军第173师一个团守军激烈抵抗；5月9日蒙城失陷，第173师副师长周元及以下官兵近3000人壮烈牺牲。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 7 May the Japanese 13th Division, supported by aircraft, attacked Mengcheng; a regiment of the Chinese 173rd Division, 48th Army, resisted fiercely. Mengcheng fell on 9 May, and Major General Zhou Yuan, deputy commander of the 173rd Division, and nearly 3,000 officers and men died. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年5月18日，萧县沦陷。
summary.en: On 18 May 1938 Xiaoxian fell.

description.zh: 5月18日，萧县沦陷。萧县位于徐州西南，是日军从南线迂回徐州的重要通道。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Xiaoxian fell on 18 May. Southwest of Xuzhou, it was an important corridor for the Japanese southern envelopment of Xuzhou. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年5月19日，宿县沦陷。
summary.en: On 19 May 1938 Suxian fell.

description.zh: 5月19日，宿县沦陷，与徐州失守同日。宿县是津浦铁路南段重镇，日军占领后沿铁路北犯徐州。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Suxian fell on 19 May, the same day as Xuzhou. A key town on the southern section of the Tianjin–Pukou railway, it was used by Japanese forces to advance north toward Xuzhou. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年5月24日，砀山沦陷。
summary.en: On 24 May 1938 Dangshan fell.

description.zh: 5月24日，砀山沦陷。砀山位于徐州以西、陇海铁路沿线，是日军切断陇海线、阻止中国军队西撤的要点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Dangshan fell on 24 May. West of Xuzhou on the Longhai railway, it was a key point for cutting the railway and blocking the Chinese withdrawal. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年5月30日，涡阳沦陷。
summary.en: On 30 May 1938 Guoyang fell.

description.zh: 5月30日，涡阳沦陷；次日亳县沦陷。日军第13师团等部由蒙城西犯，企图切断中国军队经皖北西撤的通道。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Guoyang fell on 30 May and Boxian the next day. Japanese forces including the 13th Division advanced west from Mengcheng to cut the Chinese withdrawal route through northern Anhui. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年5月31日，亳县沦陷。
summary.en: On 31 May 1938 Boxian fell.

description.zh: 5月31日，亳县沦陷。亳县是皖北门户，日军占领后继续向西追击中国军队。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Boxian fell on 31 May. As the gateway to northern Anhui, it was occupied as Japanese forces continued westward in pursuit of Chinese troops. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年5月14日，合肥沦陷。
summary.en: On 14 May 1938 Hefei fell.

description.zh: 5月13日，日军坂井支队2000余人由东南方向进攻合肥，驻防的国民党第26集团军徐源泉部防守不力，一触即溃；14日晨日军进入合肥。此后日军沿合安公路南下进攻安庆。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》与人民网，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 13 May more than 2,000 troops of the Japanese Sakai detachment attacked Hefei from the southeast; the defending 26th Group Army under Xu Yuanquan collapsed quickly, and Japanese troops entered the city on the morning of 14 May. They then advanced south along the Hefei–Anqing road toward Anqing. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and People's Daily and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年6月19日，潜山沦陷。
summary.en: On 19 June 1938 Qianshan fell.

description.zh: 6月18日，日军坂井支队进攻潜山，国民党川军第146、147师奉命阻击，激战后向山区撤退，日军于次日占领潜山。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 18 June the Japanese Sakai detachment attacked Qianshan. The Sichuan 146th and 147th Divisions fought a delaying action and withdrew into the mountains; the Japanese occupied Qianshan the next day. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年6月30日，太湖沦陷。
summary.en: On 30 June 1938 Taihu fell.

description.zh: 6月30日，太湖沦陷。日军沿大别山南麓西进，配合长江方向进攻武汉。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Taihu fell on 30 June. Japanese forces advanced west along the southern foot of the Dabie Mountains in coordination with the Yangtze column for the Wuhan campaign. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年8月2日，宿松沦陷。
summary.en: On 2 August 1938 Susong fell.

description.zh: 8月2日，宿松沦陷。宿松是皖鄂交界门户，日军占领后继续西进黄梅、九江。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Susong fell on 2 August. At the Anhui–Hubei border, it was occupied as Japanese forces continued west toward Huangmei and Jiujiang. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年8月28日，六安失陷。
summary.en: On 28 August 1938 Lu'an fell.

description.zh: 8月26日，日军第10师团进攻六安，与国民党守军第51军第113、114师激战；至28日，守军撤至淠河西岸，六安失陷。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》与人民网，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 26 August the Japanese 10th Division attacked Lu'an and fought a fierce battle with the Chinese 113th and 114th Divisions of the 51st Army. By 28 August the defenders withdrew west of the Pi River and Lu'an fell. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and People's Daily and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年8月29日，霍山失陷。
summary.en: On 29 August 1938 Huoshan fell.

description.zh: 8月27日，日军第13师团由舒城进犯霍山，国民党安徽省保安五团、第71军在第七十七军支援下与日军激战；至29日，日军在飞机掩护下攻入城内，霍山失陷。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》与人民网，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 27 August the Japanese 13th Division advanced from Shucheng toward Huoshan. The Anhui 5th Security Regiment and the 71st Army, supported by the 77th Army, fought back; on 29 August Japanese troops entered the town under air cover and Huoshan fell. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and People's Daily and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年10月28日，东流沦陷。
summary.en: On 28 October 1938 Dongliu fell.

description.zh: 10月28日，东流（今属东至县）与贵池同日沦陷。日军沿长江南岸西进，配合进攻武汉。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记（二）》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Dongliu (now part of Dongzhi county) fell on 28 October together with Guichi. Japanese forces advanced west along the south bank of the Yangtze in support of the Wuhan campaign. The date follows the second part of the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年10月28日，贵池沦陷。
summary.en: On 28 October 1938 Guichi fell.

description.zh: 10月28日，贵池沦陷。贵池位于长江南岸，是日军由安庆西进、控制皖江航道的重要据点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记（二）》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Guichi fell on 28 October. On the south bank of the Yangtze, it was an important base for the Japanese advance west from Anqing and for controlling the Anhui section of the river. The date follows the second part of the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年11月26日，铜陵沦陷。
summary.en: On 26 November 1938 Tongling fell.

description.zh: 11月26日，日军攻陷铜陵；11月29日，日军宣布封锁长江。铜陵是皖江重要的铜矿和沿江据点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记（二）》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 26 November Japanese forces took Tongling; on 29 November Japan announced the blockade of the Yangtze. Tongling was an important copper-mining and riverine base in Anhui. The date follows the second part of the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Japanese Seizure of the Huainan Coal Mines

summary.zh: 1939年4月，日军将淮南大通、九龙岗两矿合并，成立日华合办淮南煤炭股份有限公司。
summary.en: In April 1939 the Japanese merged the Datong and Jiulonggang mines into the Japanese–Chinese Huainan Coal Company.

description.zh: 1939年4月，淮南大通、九龙岗两矿合并，由日本「兴亚在华联络部」和日伪政府联合组成「日华合办淮南煤炭股份有限公司」，公司设在上海，在淮南设「淮南矿业所」。日军占领期间共采煤429万吨，大多用于侵华战争；掠夺性开采对矿井破坏很大。日期只有月份，标 `datePrecision: month`，不绘路线。
description.en: In April 1939 the Datong and Jiulonggang mines were merged into the Japanese–Chinese Huainan Coal Company, jointly run by Japan's Kōain liaison office and the puppet government, with headquarters in Shanghai and a mining office in Huainan. During the occupation 4.29 million tons of coal were extracted, mostly for the war effort; destructive mining damaged the pits. Only the month is known, so the event is marked datePrecision: month and no route is drawn.

name.zh: 伪安徽省政府在蚌埠成立
name.en: Establishment of the Puppet Anhui Provincial Government

summary.zh: 1938年10月28日，伪安徽省政府在蚌埠成立。
summary.en: On 28 October 1938 the puppet Anhui provincial government was established in Bengbu.

description.zh: 1938年6月12日，伪南京维新政府任命倪道烺为安徽省长；10月28日，伪安徽省政府在蚌埠正式成立。此后伪省府、伪省党部及日军特务机关均设蚌埠，蚌埠成为日军在安徽的统治中心。政治事件，不绘路线。
description.en: On 12 June 1938 the puppet Nanjing Reformed Government appointed Ni Daolang governor of Anhui; on 28 October the puppet provincial government was formally established in Bengbu. The puppet provincial government, party headquarters and Japanese special agency were all based there, making Bengbu the centre of Japanese rule in Anhui. This political event is not drawn as a route.

name.en: Second Japanese Sweep in Southern Anhui

summary.zh: 1940年10月4日，日军1万余人第二次扫荡皖南，攻占泾县、南陵。
summary.en: On 4 October 1940 more than 10,000 Japanese and puppet troops launched a second sweep in southern Anhui, taking Jingxian and Nanling.

description.zh: 10月4日，日军第15、第17、第116师团及伪军共1万余人，对皖南发动第二次大规模「扫荡」。叶挺指挥皖南新四军在汀潭、枫坑口、泾县县城等地激战，10月9日收复泾县县城，南陵亦被收复，历时一周，毙伤日伪军近2000人，迫使其撤退。此为多路扫荡，不绘单一路线。
description.en: On 4 October more than 10,000 Japanese troops from the 15th, 17th and 116th Divisions and puppet forces launched a second large-scale sweep in southern Anhui. Ye Ting commanded the New Fourth Army in fighting at Tingtan, Fengkengkou and Jingxian; Jingxian was recovered on 9 October and Nanling soon after. The week-long operation killed or wounded nearly 2,000 Japanese and puppet troops and forced a withdrawal. As a multi-column sweep, it is not drawn as a single route.

sources.title: 《抗日战争：安徽沦陷大事记（二）》
sources.author: 安徽文化网

name.en: Japanese Sweep of the Chaoxian–Wuwei Centre

summary.zh: 1943年3月17日，日军6000余人分8路扫荡巢无中心区。
summary.en: On 17 March 1943 more than 6,000 Japanese and puppet troops swept the Chaoxian–Wuwei centre in eight columns.

description.zh: 3月17日，日军第116师团和第115师团一部及伪军共6000余人，由南京、芜湖、铜陵等地分8路「扫荡」皖中抗日根据地巢（县）无（为）中心区。新四军第七师在地方武装配合下，经两周激战，毙伤日伪军300余人，粉碎了「扫荡」。此为多路扫荡，不绘单一路线。
description.en: On 17 March more than 6,000 troops of the Japanese 116th Division, part of the 115th Division and puppet forces swept the Chaoxian–Wuwei centre of the Central Anhui base area in eight columns from Nanjing, Wuhu and Tongling. The New Fourth Army's 7th Division, with local forces, fought for two weeks, killed or wounded more than 300 Japanese and puppet troops and broke the sweep. As a multi-column operation, it is not drawn as a single route.

sources.title: 《抗日战争：安徽沦陷大事记（三）》
sources.author: 安徽文化网

summary.zh: 1944年5月29日，日伪军围攻灵璧、五河游击区，焚毁18个村庄，打死103人。
summary.en: On 29 May 1944 Japanese and puppet troops attacked the Lingbi–Wuhe guerrilla zone, burning 18 villages and killing 103 people.

description.zh: 5月29日，日伪军围攻淮北灵（璧）五（河）抗日游击区，焚毁18个村庄、1003户、4200余间房屋，打死无辜村民103人，打伤210余人。此为暴行事件，不绘路线。日期与数字据《安徽沦陷大事记（三）》与人民网，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 29 May Japanese and puppet troops attacked the Lingbi–Wuhe anti-Japanese guerrilla zone in northern Anhui, burning 18 villages, 1,003 households and more than 4,200 rooms, killing 103 villagers and wounding over 210. This atrocity is not drawn as a route. The date and figures follow the third part of the Anhui occupation chronology and People's Daily and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《抗日战争：安徽沦陷大事记（三）》
sources.author: 安徽文化网

sources.title: 《日本侵略军在安徽的滔天罪行》
sources.author: 人民网·中国共产党新闻网
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；广德、芜湖、安庆、合肥、凤阳山马村等暴行

summary.zh: 1945年9月24日，第十战区在蚌埠举行受降仪式。
summary.en: On 24 September 1945 the Chinese Tenth War Zone held a surrender ceremony in Bengbu.

description.zh: 9月24日下午3时，在蚌埠国民党军第十战区前进指挥所礼堂内举行第九受降区受降仪式，由第十战区司令长官李品仙、前进指挥所主任张金等主持，日军代表第6军司令官十川次郎在投降书上签字。受降事件，不绘路线。
description.en: At 3 p.m. on 24 September the Ninth Surrender District ceremony was held in the advance command post of the Chinese Tenth War Zone in Bengbu, presided over by Tenth War Zone commander Li Pinxian and advance command post director Zhang Jin. The Japanese representative, Lieutenant General Jūkawa Jirō, commander of the 6th Army, signed the instrument of surrender. This surrender event is not drawn as a route.

sources.title: 《抗日战争：安徽沦陷大事记（三）》
sources.author: 安徽文化网

summary.zh: 1937年10月5日，日军第10师团攻占德州。
summary.en: On 5 October 1937 the Japanese 10th Division captured Dezhou.

description.zh: 9月30日，日军第10师团沿津浦路侵入山东。10月3日进攻德州，中国守军第3集团军抵抗；10月5日德州沦陷。日军占领后掠夺资源、强征劳工，德州成为津浦路北段重要据点。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与《日军进攻山东》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 30 September the Japanese 10th Division entered Shandong along the Tianjin–Pukou railway. It attacked Dezhou on 3 October against resistance by the Chinese 3rd Group Army, and the city fell on 5 October. Japanese forces then plundered resources and conscripted labour, making Dezhou a key point on the northern section of the railway. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and the provincial party history and awaits page-level verification.

sources.title: 《日军进攻山东》
sources.author: 中共山东省委党史研究室，山东抗战纪念网
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；德州、济南、青岛、山东全境沦陷、伪山东省公署

summary.zh: 1937年11月19日，日军侵入临清。
summary.en: On 19 November 1937 Japanese forces entered Linqing.

description.zh: 11月16日，韩复榘下令第三集团军各部撤过黄河并炸毁黄河大桥，鲁北地区沦入敌手。11月19日，日军侵入临清、高唐等县。鲁西北专员范筑先坚持抗战，发布「皓电」，震动全国。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 16 November Han Fuju ordered the 3rd Group Army to withdraw across the Yellow River and blew up the railway bridge, leaving northern Shandong to the Japanese. On 19 November Japanese forces entered Linqing and Gaotang. Fan Zhuxian, commissioner of northwestern Shandong, refused to flee and issued his famous telegram, which inspired the country. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

sources.title: 《日军进攻山东》
sources.author: 中共山东省委党史研究室，山东抗战纪念网
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；德州、济南、青岛、山东全境沦陷、伪山东省公署

summary.zh: 1937年11月19日，日军侵入高唐。
summary.en: On 19 November 1937 Japanese forces entered Gaotang.

description.zh: 11月19日，日军侵入临清、高唐等县。高唐位于鲁西北平原，是日军控制鲁西北、进逼聊城的要点。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 19 November Japanese forces entered Linqing and Gaotang. Gaotang, on the northwestern Shandong plain, was a key point for controlling the region and advancing on Liaocheng. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

sources.title: 《日军进攻山东》
sources.author: 中共山东省委党史研究室，山东抗战纪念网
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；德州、济南、青岛、山东全境沦陷、伪山东省公署

summary.zh: 1937年12月26日，日军攻占周村。
summary.en: On 26 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Zhoucun.

description.zh: 12月中旬日军迫近周村。12月24日，驻守周村的国民党第22师师长谷良民率部南逃；25日日军侵占周村西北一带，26日攻占周村。周村是胶济铁路西段商埠，沦陷后成为日军控制鲁中的据点。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与周村地方史，待页码级核对。
description.en: In mid-December Japanese forces closed on Zhoucun. On 24 December the Nationalist 22nd Division commander Gu Liangmin fled south; on 25 December Japanese troops occupied the northwestern outskirts and on 26 December took the town. Zhoucun, a commercial centre on the western section of the Jiaoji railway, became a Japanese base for controlling central Shandong. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and local history and awaits page-level verification.

sources.title: 《日军进攻山东》
sources.author: 中共山东省委党史研究室，山东抗战纪念网
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；德州、济南、青岛、山东全境沦陷、伪山东省公署

summary.zh: 1937年12月27日，日军占领淄川。
summary.en: On 27 December 1937 Japanese forces occupied Zichuan.

description.zh: 12月27日，日军占领淄川，随后制造多起血腥惨案，掠夺淄川煤矿。淄川是胶济铁路与淄博煤矿区的重要节点。日期据《淄川地方大事记》与《山东抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 27 December Japanese forces occupied Zichuan, then carried out several massacres and seized the Zichuan coal mines. Zichuan was an important node on the Jiaoji railway and in the Zibo coal area. The date follows the Zichuan local chronology and the Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

sources.title: 《日军进攻山东》
sources.author: 中共山东省委党史研究室，山东抗战纪念网
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；德州、济南、青岛、山东全境沦陷、伪山东省公署

summary.zh: 1937年12月31日，日军占领泰安。
summary.en: On 31 December 1937 Japanese forces occupied Tai'an.

description.zh: 12月27日济南失守后，日军沿津浦路南下，12月31日占领泰安。泰安是津浦路中段与泰山门户，日军占领后继续南犯兖州、济宁。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与《日军侵占济宁及其暴行》，待页码级核对。
description.en: After Jinan fell on 27 December, Japanese forces advanced south along the Tianjin–Pukou railway and occupied Tai'an on 31 December. Tai'an was a key point on the central section of the railway and the gateway to Mount Tai; from there Japanese forces moved on Yanzhou and Jining. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and the Jining account and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年1月10日，日本海军陆战队在沙子口登陆，占领青岛。
summary.en: On 10 January 1938 Japanese marines landed at Shazikou and occupied Qingdao.

description.zh: 12月27日，青岛市长沈鸿烈下令炸毁日本纱厂机器设备，并凿沉中国海军第三舰队全部舰只；28日，全体机关人员、军警撤出青岛。1938年1月10日，日本海军陆战队在沙子口登陆，进入青岛市区，青岛失陷。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与《日军进攻山东》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 27 December Qingdao mayor Shen Honglie ordered the machinery of Japanese cotton mills destroyed and the ships of the Chinese 3rd Fleet scuttled; on 28 December the government offices, troops and police withdrew. On 10 January 1938 Japanese marines landed at Shazikou and entered Qingdao, which fell. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and the provincial party history and awaits page-level verification.

sources.title: 《日军进攻山东》
sources.author: 中共山东省委党史研究室，山东抗战纪念网
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；德州、济南、青岛、山东全境沦陷、伪山东省公署

summary.zh: 1938年1月10日，日军占领胶济线重镇潍县。
summary.en: On 10 January 1938 Japanese forces occupied Weixian, a key town on the Jiaoji railway.

description.zh: 1938年1月10日，日军占领胶济线中部重地潍县；1月19日，日军与海军陆战队会师青岛，胶济铁路沿线城市全部沦陷。潍县是胶济铁路中段枢纽。日期据人民网党史与《山东抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 10 January 1938 Japanese forces took Weixian, a key town on the central Jiaoji railway. On 19 January they linked up with the naval landing force at Qingdao, completing the occupation of the railway's urban centres. Weixian was the central junction of the Jiaoji line. The date follows the People's Daily party-history account and the Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

sources.title: 《共产党员脱下长衫，到游击队去》
sources.author: 人民网·党史

summary.zh: 1938年1月4日，日军占领兖州。
summary.en: On 4 January 1938 Japanese forces occupied Yanzhou.

description.zh: 1938年1月初，日军飞机轰炸兖州；1月4日，日军前锋占领兖州、曲阜。兖州是津浦铁路与兖石铁路交会处，日军由此南下济宁、滕县。日期据《日军侵占济宁及其暴行》，待页码级核对。
description.en: In early January 1938 Japanese aircraft bombed Yanzhou; on 4 January the Japanese advance guard occupied Yanzhou and Qufu. Yanzhou was the junction of the Tianjin–Pukou railway and the Yanzhou–Shijiu line, from which Japanese forces moved south toward Jining and Tengxian. The date follows the Jining account and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年1月4日，日军占领曲阜。
summary.en: On 4 January 1938 Japanese forces occupied Qufu.

description.zh: 1月4日，日军前锋占领兖州、曲阜。曲阜是孔子故里，日军占领后对孔庙、孔府等文物造成破坏。日期据《日军侵占济宁及其暴行》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 4 January the Japanese advance guard occupied Yanzhou and Qufu. Qufu, the hometown of Confucius, suffered damage to the Temple and Mansion of Confucius after occupation. The date follows the Jining account and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年1月5日，日军占领邹县。
summary.en: On 5 January 1938 Japanese forces occupied Zouxian.

description.zh: 1月5日，日军占领邹县。邹县是津浦路南段要点，日军由此继续南下滕县。日期据《日军侵占济宁及其暴行》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 5 January Japanese forces occupied Zouxian. A key point on the southern Tianjin–Pukou railway, it was used for the continued advance south toward Tengxian. The date follows the Jining account and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年1月11日，日军第10师团占领济宁。
summary.en: On 11 January 1938 the Japanese 10th Division occupied Jining.

description.zh: 1月11日凌晨，日军兵临济宁城下，中国抗日军民激烈抵抗，终因兵力悬殊失守；日军第10师团占领济宁。济宁是鲁西南运河重镇。日期据《日军侵占济宁及其暴行》，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the early hours of 11 January Japanese forces reached Jining. Chinese troops and civilians resisted fiercely but were overwhelmed, and the Japanese 10th Division occupied the city. Jining was a key Grand Canal town in southwestern Shandong. The date follows the Jining account and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年1月11日，日军占领泗水。
summary.en: On 11 January 1938 Japanese forces occupied Sishui.

description.zh: 1月11日，日军占领济宁、泗水。泗水位于鲁中南部，是日军由兖州、曲阜南下临沂、滕县的通道。日期据《日军侵占济宁及其暴行》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 11 January Japanese forces occupied Jining and Sishui. Sishui, in south-central Shandong, was a corridor from Yanzhou and Qufu toward Linyi and Tengxian. The date follows the Jining account and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年1月16日，日军占领汶上。
summary.en: On 16 January 1938 Japanese forces occupied Wenshang.

description.zh: 1月16日，日军占领汶上。汶上位于济宁西北，是日军控制鲁西南、进逼郓城的要点。日期据《日军侵占济宁及其暴行》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 16 January Japanese forces occupied Wenshang. Northwest of Jining, it was a key point for controlling southwestern Shandong and advancing on Yuncheng. The date follows the Jining account and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年1月17日，日军侵占即墨城。
summary.en: On 17 January 1938 Japanese forces occupied Jimo.

description.zh: 1月10日青岛沦陷后，日军沿青烟公路和胶济铁路向东、西两个方向进犯即墨、胶县、平度、莱阳。1月17日，日军侵占即墨城。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与青岛地方史，待页码级核对。
description.en: After Qingdao fell on 10 January, Japanese forces advanced east and west along the Qingdao–Yantai road and the Jiaoji railway into Jimo, Jiaoxian, Pingdu and Laiyang. On 17 January they occupied Jimo. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and Qingdao local history and awaits page-level verification.

sources.title: 《日军进攻山东》
sources.author: 中共山东省委党史研究室，山东抗战纪念网
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；德州、济南、青岛、山东全境沦陷、伪山东省公署

summary.zh: 1938年2月3日，日军占领烟台。
summary.en: On 3 February 1938 Japanese forces occupied Yantai.

description.zh: 2月3日，侵华日军第二军第五师团3000余人，自青岛沿烟青公路北犯，在海上6艘舰艇配合下占领烟台。烟台是胶东半岛重要港口。日期据《烟台抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 3 February more than 3,000 troops of the Japanese 2nd Army's 5th Division advanced north from Qingdao along the Qingdao–Yantai road, supported by six naval vessels, and occupied Yantai. Yantai was the main port of the Jiaodong peninsula. The date follows the Yantai war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年2月5日，日军占领黄县。
summary.en: On 5 February 1938 Japanese forces occupied Huangxian.

description.zh: 2月3日烟台沦陷后，日军分兵东攻蓬莱、黄县、掖县，西占牟平、威海。2月5日，日军占领黄县。日期据胶东地方史与《山东抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: After Yantai fell on 3 February, Japanese forces moved east against Penglai, Huangxian and Yexian and west against Muping and Weihai. On 5 February they occupied Huangxian. The date follows Jiaodong local history and the Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

sources.title: 《日军进攻山东》
sources.author: 中共山东省委党史研究室，山东抗战纪念网
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；德州、济南、青岛、山东全境沦陷、伪山东省公署

summary.zh: 1938年3月7日，日本海军陆战队占领威海卫。
summary.en: On 7 March 1938 Japanese marines occupied Weihaiwei.

description.zh: 3月7日下午，日本海军陆战队500多人在军舰、飞机护卫下占领威海卫。威海卫是北洋海军基地，沦陷后成为日军控制胶东东端的据点。日期据威海市档案馆，待页码级核对。
description.en: On the afternoon of 7 March more than 500 Japanese marines, escorted by warships and aircraft, occupied Weihaiwei. The former Beiyang naval base became a Japanese strongpoint at the eastern tip of Jiaodong. The date follows the Weihai municipal archives and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年3月17日，日军攻占滕县。
summary.en: On 17 March 1938 Japanese forces captured Tengxian.

description.zh: 3月中旬，日军第10师团濑谷支队进攻滕县，中国守军第22集团军第122师等部顽强抵抗；3月17日下午，日军步兵第10联队完全占领滕县。滕县保卫战为台儿庄战役争取了时间。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与台儿庄战役史料，待页码级核对。
description.en: In mid-March the Japanese 10th Division's Segawa detachment attacked Tengxian, defended stubbornly by the Chinese 122nd Division of the 22nd Group Army. On the afternoon of 17 March the Japanese 10th Infantry Regiment completed the occupation of Tengxian. The defence bought time for the Battle of Taierzhuang. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and Taierzhuang sources and awaits page-level verification.

sources.title: 《日军进攻山东》
sources.author: 中共山东省委党史研究室，山东抗战纪念网
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；德州、济南、青岛、山东全境沦陷、伪山东省公署

summary.zh: 1938年3月17日，日军攻陷临城。
summary.en: On 17 March 1938 Japanese forces captured Lincheng.

description.zh: 3月17日，日军步兵第63联队以30余辆战车及空军优势猛攻官桥阵地，官桥、临城相继失守。临城（今薛城）是津浦铁路与临枣支线交会处，为日军南下峄县、台儿庄的要点。日期据台儿庄战役史料，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 17 March the Japanese 63rd Infantry Regiment, with more than 30 tanks and air support, attacked the Guanqiao positions; Guanqiao and Lincheng fell in succession. Lincheng (now Xuecheng) was the junction of the Tianjin–Pukou railway and the Lincheng–Zaozhuang branch, a key point for the advance on Yixian and Taierzhuang. The date follows Taierzhuang campaign sources and awaits page-level verification.

sources.title: 《日军进攻山东》
sources.author: 中共山东省委党史研究室，山东抗战纪念网
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；德州、济南、青岛、山东全境沦陷、伪山东省公署

summary.zh: 1938年3月18日，日军占领峄县。
summary.en: On 18 March 1938 Japanese forces occupied Yixian.

description.zh: 3月18日，日军兵分两路，直赴韩庄、峄县，峄县沦陷。峄县是台儿庄战役的核心地区，日军由此南下台儿庄。日期据台儿庄战役史料，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 18 March Japanese forces split into two columns toward Hanzhuang and Yixian, and Yixian fell. The county was at the heart of the Taierzhuang campaign; from there Japanese forces moved south on Taierzhuang. The date follows Taierzhuang campaign sources and awaits page-level verification.

sources.title: 《日军进攻山东》
sources.author: 中共山东省委党史研究室，山东抗战纪念网
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；德州、济南、青岛、山东全境沦陷、伪山东省公署

summary.zh: 1938年3月18日，日军占领枣庄。
summary.en: On 18 March 1938 Japanese forces occupied Zaozhuang.

description.zh: 3月18日，日军占领枣庄，抢占中兴煤矿，屠杀百姓，并在关键设施部署兵力。枣庄是鲁南煤海，沦陷后成为日军掠夺煤炭的据点。日期据枣庄地方史与台儿庄战役史料，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 18 March Japanese forces occupied Zaozhuang, seized the Zhongxing coal mines, massacred civilians and garrisoned key installations. Zaozhuang was the coal centre of southern Shandong and became a base for Japanese coal extraction. The date follows Zaozhuang local history and Taierzhuang campaign sources and awaits page-level verification.

sources.title: 《日军进攻山东》
sources.author: 中共山东省委党史研究室，山东抗战纪念网
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；德州、济南、青岛、山东全境沦陷、伪山东省公署

summary.zh: 1938年4月21日，日军占领临沂。
summary.en: On 21 April 1938 Japanese forces occupied Linyi.

description.zh: 3月至4月，中国军队在临沂与日军第5师团激战，取得临沂阻击战胜利。4月21日，由于台儿庄战役吃紧，张自忠、庞炳勋两军相继撤离，临沂遂被日军占领。日军进城后屠杀平民2840余人。日期据临沂市政府与《山东抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: From March to April Chinese forces fought the Japanese 5th Division at Linyi and won the Linyi blocking battle. On 21 April, as the Taierzhuang front became critical, the armies of Zhang Zizhong and Pang Bingxun withdrew and Linyi was occupied. Japanese troops killed more than 2,840 civilians after entering the city. The date follows the Linyi municipal government and the Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年5月9日，日军进攻郓城，郓城失陷。
summary.en: On 9 May 1938 Japanese forces attacked Yuncheng and the county fell.

description.zh: 5月9日，日军第16师团进攻郓城，中国守军第69旅死守不力，郓城失陷。随后日军重兵进逼菏泽。日期据《徐州会战》与《山东抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 9 May the Japanese 16th Division attacked Yuncheng; the Chinese 69th Brigade failed to hold and the county fell. Japanese forces then closed on Heze. The date follows the Xuzhou campaign account and the Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年5月14日，日军攻破金乡城，制造金乡惨案。
summary.en: On 14 May 1938 Japanese forces broke into Jinxiang and carried out the Jinxiang massacre.

description.zh: 5月11日起，日军飞机连续轰炸金乡县城；5月13日至14日，日军在城郊王楼、大义等村屠杀平民；5月14日破城后，对未撤离的3000余名居民进行屠杀。金乡惨案是徐州会战期间日军在鲁西南的重大暴行。日期据《金乡惨案》，待页码级核对。
description.en: From 11 May Japanese aircraft repeatedly bombed Jinxiang. On 13–14 May Japanese troops massacred civilians in Wanglou, Dayi and other suburban villages; after breaking into the city on 14 May they killed more than 3,000 residents who had not fled. The Jinxiang massacre was a major atrocity in southwestern Shandong during the Xuzhou campaign. The date follows the Jinxiang massacre account and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年11月15日，日军攻破聊城，范筑先殉国。
summary.en: On 15 November 1938 Japanese forces broke into Liaocheng; Fan Zhuxian died in the defence.

description.zh: 11月14日至15日，日军分3路进犯鲁西北地区，聊城被围。范筑先率部与日军英勇战斗，终因敌众我寡，被日军攻破城门，范筑先等近700名将士壮烈殉国。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与《日军进攻山东》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 14–15 November Japanese forces advanced into northwestern Shandong in three columns and surrounded Liaocheng. Fan Zhuxian and his troops fought bravely but were overwhelmed; the gates were breached and Fan and nearly 700 officers and men died. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and the provincial party history and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Establishment of the Puppet Shandong Provincial Government

summary.zh: 1938年3月5日，伪山东省公署在济南成立。
summary.en: On 5 March 1938 the puppet Shandong provincial government was established in Jinan.

description.zh: 3月5日，伪山东省公署在济南成立，马良任伪省长；1939年1月唐仰杜接任，1943年8月改为伪山东省政府，1945年2月杨毓珣出任最后一任伪省长。伪政权是日军控制山东的统治工具。政治事件，不绘路线。
description.en: On 5 March the puppet Shandong provincial government was established in Jinan with Ma Liang as governor. Tang Yangdu succeeded him in January 1939; the body became the puppet Shandong provincial government in August 1943, and Yang Yuxun became its last governor in February 1945. The puppet regime was a tool of Japanese control. This political event is not drawn as a route.

summary.zh: 1940年2月22日，日军占领荣成，山东107县全部沦陷。
summary.en: On 22 February 1940 Japanese forces occupied Rongcheng, completing the occupation of all 107 counties in Shandong.

description.zh: 1940年2月22日，日军占领荣成县。至此，山东全省107个县全部沦陷。荣成是山东最后一个沦陷的县城，此后山东抗战进入全境敌后阶段。日期据《抗战期间沦陷的县城》与《山东抗日战争大事记（1939-1945）》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 22 February 1940 Japanese forces occupied Rongcheng, the last county town in Shandong to fall; all 107 counties were now occupied. The war in Shandong then entered an entirely behind-the-lines phase. The date follows the occupied-county list and the 1939–1945 Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.
