sources.author: 山东抗战纪念网
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；1939 年后扫荡与根据地

name.en: Japanese "Iron Wall" Sweep in the Yimeng Mountains

summary.zh: 1941年11月2日，日军集中5万余人对沂蒙山区发动「铁壁合围」大扫荡。
summary.en: On 2 November 1941 more than 50,000 Japanese troops launched an "iron wall" sweep in the Yimeng Mountains.

description.zh: 1941年9月至10月，驻山东日军集中5万余人，在第12军司令官土桥一次指挥下，准备对沂蒙山区发动「铁壁合围」大扫荡。11月2日，八路军鲁中军区部队开始沂蒙山反「扫荡」作战。日军在根据地内烧杀抢夺，群众被害和被抓走1.4万余人，被抢走粮食160余万斤。此为多路合围，不绘单一路线。
description.en: From September to October 1941 the Japanese forces in Shandong massed more than 50,000 troops under the 12th Army for an "iron wall" sweep of the Yimeng Mountains. On 2 November the Eighth Route Army's central Shandong military district began counter-sweep operations. Japanese troops burned, killed and looted in the base area; more than 14,000 people were killed or abducted and over 800 tons of grain seized. As a multi-column encirclement, it is not drawn as a single route.

sources.author: 山东抗战纪念网
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；1939 年后扫荡与根据地

summary.zh: 1942年11月，日军围攻淄川马鞍山，八路军伤病员与守军坚守后失守。
summary.en: In November 1942 Japanese forces attacked Ma'anshan in Zichuan; Eighth Route Army wounded, civilians and defenders held out before the position fell.

description.zh: 1942年11月，日军对沂蒙山区发动「扫荡」，并出动大批兵力围攻淄川马鞍山。山上八路军伤病员、家属和守军凭险坚守，最终失守。马鞍山是扼沂蒙山区入清河区的门户，此战为日军扫荡中的山地攻防战，不绘单一路线。
description.en: In November 1942 Japanese forces swept the Yimeng Mountains and sent a large force against Ma'anshan in Zichuan. Eighth Route Army wounded, family members and defenders held the mountain position before it fell. Ma'anshan was the gateway from the Yimeng Mountains into the Qinghe area; this mountain battle during the Japanese sweep is not drawn as a single route.

name.zh: 济南、青岛、德州地区受降
name.en: Surrender of Japanese Forces in Jinan, Qingdao and Dezhou

summary.zh: 1945年12月27日，济南、青岛、德州地区受降典礼在济南举行。
summary.en: On 27 December 1945 the surrender ceremony for the Jinan, Qingdao and Dezhou areas was held in Jinan.

description.zh: 12月27日，济南、青岛、德州地区受降典礼在山东省立图书馆「奎虚书藏」举行，由第十一战区副司令长官李延年中将主持，日军第43军司令官细川忠康等代表签降。山东区受降主官为李延年，日军投降代表为第43军司令官细川忠康。受降事件，不绘路线。
description.en: On 27 December the surrender ceremony for the Jinan, Qingdao and Dezhou areas was held at the Kui Xu Shu Cang building of the Shandong Provincial Library, presided over by Lieutenant General Li Yannian, deputy commander of the 11th War Zone. Lieutenant General Hosokawa Tadamasa, commander of the Japanese 43rd Army, and other representatives signed. The surrender is not drawn as a route.

summary.zh: 1937年11月19日，嘉兴城沦陷。
summary.en: On 19 November 1937 the city of Jiaxing fell.

description.zh: 淞沪会战结束后，日军沿沪杭铁路西进。11月19日，嘉兴城沦陷，日军所到之处烧杀淫掠。嘉兴是沪杭铁路与杭嘉湖水网的枢纽，沦陷后成为日军控制浙北的据点。日期据南湖区政府与《浙江抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: After the Battle of Shanghai, Japanese forces advanced west along the Shanghai–Hangzhou railway. Jiaxing fell on 19 November; Japanese troops burned, killed and looted. At the junction of the railway and the Hangzhou–Jiaxing–Huzhou water network, Jiaxing became a Japanese base for controlling northern Zhejiang. The date follows the Nanhu district government and the Zhejiang war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年11月24日，日军攻陷吴兴（湖州）。
summary.en: On 24 November 1937 Japanese forces captured Wuxing (Huzhou).

description.zh: 11月24日，日军攻陷吴兴（今湖州市），大片民房被烧毁，沿公路尸积盈野，县城内被杀平民尸体达300余具，南浔镇有400余名平民被杀、4993间民房被毁。日期据南京大屠杀纪念馆与《浙江抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 24 November Japanese forces captured Wuxing (present-day Huzhou). Large areas of housing were burned, bodies lay along the roads, more than 300 civilian bodies were counted in the county town, and in Nanxun 400 civilians were killed and 4,993 houses destroyed. The date follows the Nanjing memorial and the Zhejiang war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年11月25日，日军攻陷长兴。
summary.en: On 25 November 1937 Japanese forces captured Changxing.

description.zh: 11月25日，日军攻陷长兴，杀害平民200余人。长兴是太湖南岸通往安徽广德、江苏宜兴的节点，日军由此继续西进。日期据南京大屠杀纪念馆与《浙江抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 25 November Japanese forces captured Changxing and killed more than 200 civilians. Changxing was a node on the southern shore of Taihu connecting Guangde in Anhui and Yixing in Jiangsu, from which Japanese forces continued west. The date follows the Nanjing memorial and the Zhejiang war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年2月18日，日军在余杭乔司镇连续烧杀3天，杀害平民1300余人。
summary.en: From 18 February 1938 Japanese troops burned and killed in Qiaosi, Yuhang, for three days, killing more than 1,300 civilians.

description.zh: 2月18日，日军疯狂屠杀余杭乔司镇居民，施放火枪烧房子，用步枪和机枪扫射群众。日军连续烧杀3天，被害平民达1300余人，烧毁房屋7000余间，整个乔司镇成为一片废墟。事后人们收集遗骸建公墓，立碑为「戊寅公墓」，俗称「千人坑」。惨案不绘路线。
description.en: On 18 February Japanese troops massacred residents of Qiaosi in Yuhang, setting houses on fire and machine-gunning civilians. The killing and burning continued for three days: more than 1,300 civilians died and over 7,000 houses were destroyed, leaving the town in ruins. Survivors later collected the remains and built the Wuyin cemetery, known locally as the "thousand-person pit". The massacre is not drawn as a route.

sources.title: 《杭州抗战大事记》
sources.author: 杭州网/杭州日报
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；杭州湾登陆、12/24 杭州、乔司、午朝庙、龙溪、9/6 富阳受降

summary.zh: 1938年3月4日，日军在富阳午朝庙屠杀难民300余人。
summary.en: On 4 March 1938 Japanese troops massacred more than 300 refugees at Wuchaomiao in Fuyang.

description.zh: 3月4日，日军包围富阳受降乡东坞山村后的午朝庙，将在那里避难的300余难民集中起来，分年龄将各人的拇指连拴在一起，令其下跪，然后架起机枪扫射。此次屠杀后的幸存者仅5—6人。惨案不绘路线。
description.en: On 4 March Japanese troops surrounded Wuchaomiao behind Dongwu village in Fuyang's Shouxiang township, gathered more than 300 refugees, tied their thumbs together by age group, forced them to kneel and machine-gunned them. Only five or six survived. The massacre is not drawn as a route.

sources.title: 《杭州抗战大事记》
sources.author: 杭州网/杭州日报
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；杭州湾登陆、12/24 杭州、乔司、午朝庙、龙溪、9/6 富阳受降

summary.zh: 1938年3月26日，日军对龙溪沿岸村镇烧杀，焚毁近150个村庄。
summary.en: On 26 March 1938 Japanese troops burned and killed along the Longxi, destroying nearly 150 villages.

description.zh: 3月26日，1000多名日军对龙溪沿岸村镇进行烧杀。龙溪南段与京杭大运河相接，北段通往吴兴汇入太湖，是日军运送军火物资的要道。日军为确保杭湖水道安全，制造了火烧百里龙溪的惨案：120里龙溪两岸近150个村庄成为火海，仅德清境内就有110个村被烧毁、7700多间房舍被焚、580余人死亡。惨案不绘路线。
description.en: On 26 March more than 1,000 Japanese troops burned and killed along the Longxi. Its southern section joined the Grand Canal and its northern section ran to Wuxing and Taihu, making it a key route for Japanese military supplies. To secure the Hangzhou–Huzhou waterway, Japanese troops burned nearly 150 villages along 120 li of the Longxi; in Deqing alone 110 villages, more than 7,700 houses and over 580 people were destroyed or killed. The massacre is not drawn as a route.

summary.zh: 1940年1月22日，日军趁大雪偷渡钱塘江，攻占萧山县城。
summary.en: On 22 January 1940 Japanese forces crossed the Qiantang River in heavy snow and captured Xiaoshan.

description.zh: 1月22日，日军趁大雪天偷渡钱塘江，攻占萧山县城。萧山是钱塘江南岸门户，日军由此打破与浙江守军隔江对峙的局面。日期据《杭州大事记（1940－1945）》与《杭州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 22 January Japanese forces crossed the Qiantang River during heavy snow and captured Xiaoshan. As the gateway on the south bank, Xiaoshan ended the standoff in which Chinese and Japanese forces faced each other across the river. The date follows the Hangzhou chronicles and awaits page-level verification.

sources.title: 《杭州抗战大事记》
sources.author: 杭州网/杭州日报
sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；杭州湾登陆、12/24 杭州、乔司、午朝庙、龙溪、9/6 富阳受降

summary.zh: 1940年7月17日，日军侵占镇海，7月22日被中国军队收复。
summary.en: On 17 July 1940 Japanese forces occupied Zhenhai; Chinese troops recovered it on 22 July.

description.zh: 7月17日，日军侵占镇海城关、小港、江南等地。18日，国民党守军第194师在第16师48团增援下反击，师长陈德法亲临前线指挥，经五昼夜血战，于22日晨击退日军，收复失地，共击毙日军近400名。此役是浙东抗战的重要胜利。日期据《宁波抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 17 July Japanese forces occupied Zhenhai's city area, Xiaogang and Jiangnan. On 18 July the Chinese 194th Division, reinforced by the 48th Regiment of the 16th Division and commanded personally by divisional commander Chen Defa, counter-attacked. After five days and nights of fighting they drove the Japanese back on the morning of 22 July, recovering the lost ground and killing nearly 400 Japanese troops. The date follows the Ningbo war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1941年4月22日，慈溪沦陷。
summary.en: On 22 April 1941 Cixi fell.

description.zh: 4月22日，慈溪沦陷。日期据《宁波抗战大事记》与《绍兴抗战大事纪》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Cixi fell on 22 April. The date follows the Ningbo and Shaoxing chronicles and awaits page-level verification.

sources.note: 2026-11-21 访问；1940 镇海、宁波细菌战、1941 镇海/宁波/慈溪/奉化/余姚、大皎、象山茅洋

summary.zh: 1941年4月23日，奉化沦陷。
summary.en: On 23 April 1941 Fenghua fell.

summary.en: On 30 May 1941 Japanese troops burned and killed in Dajiao village in western Yin county, destroying more than 1,600 houses.

description.en: On 30 May more than 400 Japanese troops attacked Dajiao village in western Yin county, burning over 1,600 houses, burning three people to death, shooting 11, raping more than 40 women and looting extensively. The massacre is not drawn as a route.

name.en: Seizure of the Maoyang Fluorite Mine

summary.zh: 1941年5月，日军侵占象山茅洋，设华中矿业公司掠夺砩矿。
summary.en: In May 1941 Japanese forces occupied Maoyang in Xiangshan and set up the Central China Mining Company to extract fluorite.

description.zh: 1941年5月，日军侵占象山茅洋后，设立「华中矿业公司」，4年内掠夺五狮山砩矿资源10万吨（有5万吨来不及运走），被屠杀或迫害致死的矿工达2700余人。日期只有月份，标 `datePrecision: month`，不绘路线。
description.en: In May 1941 Japanese forces occupied Maoyang in Xiangshan and set up the Central China Mining Company. Within four years they extracted 100,000 tons of fluorite from the Wushi mountain mine (50,000 tons were left behind), and more than 2,700 miners were killed or worked to death. Only the month is known, so the event is marked datePrecision: month and no route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1942年5月17日，诸暨沦陷。
summary.en: On 17 May 1942 Zhuji fell.

description.zh: 5月17日，诸暨沦陷。日军由萧山、绍兴方向南犯，诸暨是浙赣战役中金华方向的必经之地。日期据《浙赣会战》与《衢州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Zhuji fell on 17 May. Japanese forces advanced south from Xiaoshan and Shaoxing; Zhuji was on the route to Jinhua during the Zhejiang–Jiangxi campaign. The date follows the Zhejiang–Jiangxi campaign account and the Quzhou chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1942年5月28日，金华沦陷。
summary.en: On 28 May 1942 Jinhua fell.

description.zh: 5月28日，金华、兰溪同日沦陷。仅据1942年年底统计，金华全县被强奸的妇女就有1370人。日期据《浙赣会战》与《衢州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Jinhua and Lanxi fell on the same day, 28 May. By the end of 1942, 1,370 women had been raped in Jinhua county alone. The date follows the Zhejiang–Jiangxi campaign account and the Quzhou chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1942年5月28日，兰溪沦陷。
summary.en: On 28 May 1942 Lanxi fell.

description.zh: 5月28日，兰溪城沦陷。当天日军窜进排岭村，纵火烧毁村民吴连根、吴金朝、吴有根等房屋20余间。日期据《浙赣会战》与《衢州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Lanxi fell on 28 May. That day Japanese troops entered Painling village and burned more than 20 houses belonging to Wu Liangen, Wu Jinchao, Wu Yougen and others. The date follows the Zhejiang–Jiangxi campaign account and the Quzhou chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1942年6月24日，日军侵占丽水县城。
summary.en: On 24 June 1942 Japanese forces occupied Lishui.

description.zh: 6月24日，日军侵占丽水县城，飞机场被毁。8月28日，丽水县城克复。日期据《丽水抗战》与《浙赣会战》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 24 June Japanese forces occupied Lishui and destroyed the airfield. The county town was recovered on 28 August. The date follows the Lishui chronicle and the Zhejiang–Jiangxi campaign account and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1942年7月14日，嵊县沦陷。
summary.en: On 14 July 1942 Shengxian fell.

description.zh: 7月14日，嵊县沦陷。同日新昌亦告失守。日期据《绍兴抗战大事纪》与《温州抗战大事纪》，待页码级核对。
description.en: Shengxian fell on 14 July; Xinchang also fell the same day. The date follows the Shaoxing and Wenzhou chronicles and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1944年8月26日，日军再次攻陷丽水县城。
summary.en: On 26 August 1944 Japanese forces again captured Lishui.

description.zh: 8月26日，日军第70师团和梨冈支队3000余人进犯丽水县城，国军新编第11师63团与日军激战彻夜，团长彭孝儒及大部官兵阵亡，县城沦陷。9月16日，国军新编第11师62团攻克县城。日期据《丽水抗战》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 26 August more than 3,000 troops of the Japanese 70th Division and the Rioka detachment attacked Lishui. The Chinese New 11th Division's 63rd Regiment fought all night; its commander Peng Xiaoru and most of his men died and the county town fell. On 16 September the 62nd Regiment retook the town. The date follows the Lishui chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Establishment of the Puppet Zhejiang Government

summary.zh: 1938年6月19日，伪浙江省暨杭州市政府成立。
summary.en: On 19 June 1938 the puppet Zhejiang provincial and Hangzhou municipal governments were established.

description.zh: 6月19日，日军扶植的伪浙江省暨杭州市政府成立。日军占领浙江后，在沦陷区扶植伪政权，作为「以华制华」的傀儡。1938年1月，日军先建立伪杭州市治安维持会，后改为伪杭州市自治会，6月由伪杭州市政府接收。政治事件，不绘路线。
description.en: On 19 June the Japanese-sponsored puppet Zhejiang provincial and Hangzhou municipal governments were established. After occupying Zhejiang, Japan set up puppet regimes in the occupied areas as instruments of "using Chinese to control Chinese". A puppet Hangzhou maintenance association was created in January 1938, later replaced by a puppet self-government association and taken over by the puppet municipal government in June. This political event is not drawn as a route.

summary.zh: 1945年9月4日，侵浙日军在富阳宋殿村洽降。
summary.en: On 4 September 1945 the Japanese forces in Zhejiang attended surrender talks at Songdian in Fuyang.

description.zh: 9月4日，侵浙日军投降仪式在富阳宋殿村举行，第三战区副司令长官韩德勤代表中国政府主持接受日军投降仪式；侵杭日军最高指挥官、第133师团长野地嘉平代表日方呈交投降日军的兵力、驻地、指挥系统、官长姓名等图表。富阳人民后来把宋殿村改为受降村。受降事件，不绘路线。
description.en: On 4 September the surrender ceremony for Japanese forces in Zhejiang was held at Songdian in Fuyang. Lieutenant General Han Deqin, deputy commander of the Third War Zone, presided for China; the senior Japanese commander in Hangzhou, Lieutenant General Noji Kahei of the 133rd Division, submitted charts of Japanese strength, dispositions, command system and officers. The village was later renamed Shouxiang (Surrender) village. This surrender event is not drawn as a route.

name.en: Disarmament of Japanese Troops in Hangzhou

summary.zh: 1945年9月18日，驻杭日军全部缴械。
summary.en: On 18 September 1945 all Japanese troops in Hangzhou were disarmed.

description.zh: 9月7日，陈纯白率部进入杭州市区，从伪市长吴念中处接收伪杭州市政府；9月18日，驻杭日军全部缴械。月底，杭州周围的新四军部队和各县抗日民主政府干部开始北撤，省政府各机关迁回杭州。受降事件，不绘路线。
description.en: On 7 September Chen Chunbai led troops into Hangzhou and took over the puppet municipal government from mayor Wu Nianzhong; on 18 September all Japanese troops in Hangzhou were disarmed. At the end of the month New Fourth Army units around Hangzhou and county democratic government cadres began withdrawing north, and provincial government offices returned to the city. This surrender event is not drawn as a route.

summary.en: On 14 July 1942 Xinchang fell.

description.en: Xinchang fell on 14 July, the same day as Shengxian. The date follows the Shaoxing and Wenzhou chronicles and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年10月26日，日军在料罗湾登陆，进攻金门县城。
summary.en: On 26 October 1937 Japanese forces landed at Liaoluo Bay and attacked the Kinmen county town.

description.zh: 10月26日12时，日军攻占金门县城。日军在料罗湾登陆后向金门城推进，金门县长邝汉未待日军登陆即擅离职守，率家属和公务人员先逃往大嶝岛，然后转逃漳州。日期据《泉州抗日战争大事记》与《漳州抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: At noon on 26 October Japanese forces captured the Kinmen county town. After landing at Liaoluo Bay they advanced on the town; county magistrate Kuang Han abandoned his post before the landing, fleeing with his family and staff first to Dadeng island and then to Zhangzhou. The date follows the Quanzhou and Zhangzhou chronicles and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年10月26日，金门县城沦陷。
summary.en: On 26 October 1937 the Kinmen county town fell.

description.zh: 10月26日，日军攻占金门县城，金门沦陷。金门县政府退至大嶝岛，改设办事处。金门是福建最早沦陷的县份之一。日期据《泉州抗日战争大事记》与《漳州抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 26 October Japanese forces captured the Kinmen county town and Kinmen fell. The county government withdrew to Dadeng island and set up an office there. Kinmen was one of the earliest counties in Fujian to fall. The date follows the Quanzhou and Zhangzhou chronicles and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年9月3日，日舰炮击厦门，屿仔尾炮台击沉日舰若竹号。
summary.en: On 3 September 1937 Japanese warships shelled Xiamen; the Yuzaiwei battery sank the Japanese destroyer Waketake.

description.zh: 9月3日凌晨4时3分，日本海军驱逐舰「羽风」「若竹」号等3艘入侵厦门与海澄交界海域，向白石头炮台及曾厝垵海军飞机场发炮轰击，猛攻胡里山总台。驻守屿仔尾南炮台部队立即开炮迎击，开炮3发，两中若竹号艏艉；羽风等二舰遁逃，若竹舰沉没海中。此为海战，不绘地面路线。
description.en: At 4:03 a.m. on 3 September three Japanese destroyers, including Hagikaze and Waketake, entered the waters between Xiamen and Haicheng and shelled the Baishitou battery, the Zengcuoan naval airfield and the Huli Shan main fort. The Yuzaiwei battery opened fire with three rounds, hitting Waketake fore and aft; the other two ships fled and Waketake sank. As a naval engagement, it is not drawn as a ground route.

summary.zh: 1941年4月21日，长乐沦陷。
summary.en: On 21 April 1941 Changle fell.

description.zh: 4月18日，日军登陆运输舰艇在闽江口海域集结，出动30架飞机对福州及闽江口两岸轮番轰炸。4月19日日军登陆，4月21日长乐、连江、福州相继沦陷。日期据《福州沦陷日》与《福州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 18 April Japanese transports massed off the Min River estuary and 30 aircraft bombed Fuzhou and both banks of the river. Japanese forces landed on 19 April; Changle, Lianjiang and Fuzhou fell in succession on 21 April. The date follows the Fuzhou occupation-day account and chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 21 April 1941 Lianjiang fell.

description.zh: 4月19日日军在闽江口登陆后，分路进犯长乐、连江；4月21日连江与长乐、福州同日沦陷。日期据《福州沦陷日》与《福州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。

summary.zh: 1939年7月11日，日伪军进犯东山，在港口登陆。
summary.en: On 11 July 1939 Japanese and puppet forces attacked Dongshan and landed at the port.

description.zh: 7月11日至16日，日伪军进犯东山，守军第75师史克勤旅和县长楼胜利率领地方武装进行反击，日军败退。日期据《漳州抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: From 11 to 16 July Japanese and puppet forces attacked Dongshan. The defending 75th Division's Shi Keqin brigade and county magistrate Lou Shengli led local forces in a counter-attack and drove the Japanese back. The date follows the Zhangzhou war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1939年7月16日，东山守军击退登陆的日伪军。
summary.en: On 16 July 1939 the Dongshan garrison drove off the Japanese and puppet landing force.

description.zh: 7月11日至16日，日伪军进犯东山，守军第75师史克勤旅和县长楼胜利率领地方武装进行反击，日军败退。东山保卫战是福建沿海少数成功的抗登陆作战之一。日期据《漳州抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: From 11 to 16 July Japanese and puppet forces attacked Dongshan; the 75th Division's Shi Keqin brigade and county magistrate Lou Shengli counter-attacked and drove them back. The defence of Dongshan was one of the few successful anti-landing actions on the Fujian coast. The date follows the Zhangzhou war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1939年8月23日，日伪军再犯东山，占领陈城等15个村落，9月4日退出。
summary.en: On 23 August 1939 Japanese and puppet forces again attacked Dongshan, occupying 15 villages including Chencheng, and withdrew on 4 September.

description.zh: 8月23日，日本指挥官涩谷部和伪军郑天福部，在8架飞机掩护下进犯东山，占领陈城、港口、亲营、古雷庄、岐下等15个村落。8月26日、27日，守军第75师449团和保安第9团奋起抵抗，449团张润生副团长夜战中阵亡。在军民顽强抗击下，日伪军于9月4日退出东山。此为反复争夺，不绘单一路线。
description.en: On 23 August the Japanese commander Shibuya and the puppet Zheng Tianfu force, covered by eight aircraft, attacked Dongshan and occupied 15 villages including Chencheng, Gangkou, Qinying, Guleizhuang and Qixia. On 26–27 August the 449th Regiment of the 75th Division and the 9th Security Regiment counter-attacked; Lieutenant Colonel Zhang Runsheng of the 449th was killed in night fighting. Under sustained resistance the Japanese and puppet forces withdrew on 4 September. As repeated fighting, it is not drawn as a single route.

summary.zh: 1940年7月16日，日军进犯永宁，焚毁船舶近300艘、房屋90多座，杀害村民80多人。
summary.en: On 16 July 1940 Japanese forces attacked Yongning, burning nearly 300 boats and more than 90 houses and killing over 80 villagers.

description.zh: 7月16日，日本侵略军300多人在飞机、军舰掩护下，分3路进犯永宁。驻外高村20多名海防战士浴血奋战。日军占领永宁，大肆烧杀掠夺，十几个村庄惨遭其害，焚毁船舶近300艘、房屋90多座、学校3所，杀害村民80多人，财物被抢劫一空。史称「永宁惨案」。
description.en: On 16 July more than 300 Japanese troops, covered by aircraft and warships, attacked Yongning in three columns. More than 20 coastal defence soldiers at Waigao village fought to the death. The Japanese occupied Yongning and burned, killed and looted across more than a dozen villages, destroying nearly 300 boats, over 90 houses and three schools, killing more than 80 villagers and seizing property. It is known as the Yongning massacre.

summary.zh: 1940年7月16日，日军登陆崇武，杀害民众93人，焚毁渔船商船521艘。
summary.en: On 16 July 1940 Japanese forces landed at Chongwu, killing 93 people and burning 521 fishing and merchant boats.

description.zh: 7月16日，日机6架分2批侵入惠安崇武、獭窟等地轰炸，日舰同时向陆上开炮。稍后，日军500多人从后海、三屿、港墘等处登陆，窜入崇武城；另一支日军200多人从獭窟登陆。仅崇武一地民众死93人、伤40人，被烧毁渔、商船521艘，烧毁房屋566间、庙宇1座，其他财产损失无数。史称「崇武惨案」。
description.en: On 16 July six Japanese aircraft in two waves bombed Chongwu and Taku in Hui'an while warships shelled the coast. More than 500 Japanese troops then landed at Houhai, Sanyu and Gangqian and entered Chongwu, while another 200 landed at Taku. In Chongwu alone 93 civilians were killed and 40 wounded, 521 fishing and merchant boats and 566 houses were burned, along with a temple, and other property was lost. It is known as the Chongwu massacre.

summary.zh: 1945年9月28日，驻厦日军在鼓浪屿海滨饭店签署投降书。
summary.en: On 28 September 1945 the Japanese garrison in Xiamen signed the instrument of surrender at the Gulangyu seaside hotel.

description.zh: 9月28日，国民党海军第二舰队司令李世甲、厦门要港司令刘德浦在鼓浪屿海滨饭店举行驻厦日军受降仪式，驻厦日军司令官原田清一海军中将在投降书上签字。受降事件，不绘路线。
description.en: On 28 September the Chinese navy's 2nd Fleet commander Li Shijia and Xiamen port commander Liu Depu held the surrender ceremony for the Japanese garrison at the Gulangyu seaside hotel; Vice Admiral Harada Seiichi, commander of the Xiamen garrison, signed the instrument of surrender. This surrender event is not drawn as a route.

summary.zh: 1938年6月26日，日军波田支队攻占马当要塞。
summary.en: On 26 June 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment captured the Madang fortress.

description.zh: 马当要塞位于江西彭泽县长江弯道，江面狭窄，是武汉会战前长江下游的重要封锁线。6月23日起，日军波田支队在巡洋舰、驱逐舰支援下猛攻马当；6月26日马当要塞失守，长江封锁线被突破。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与《抗战实录丨马当要塞失陷记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: The Madang fortress stood on a narrow bend of the Yangtze in Pengze county, Jiangxi, and was a key blocking position on the lower Yangtze before the Wuhan campaign. From 23 June the Japanese Wada detachment, supported by cruisers and destroyers, attacked Madang; the fortress fell on 26 June and the river blockade was broken. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the Madang account and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年6月29日，彭泽沦陷。
summary.en: On 29 June 1938 Pengze fell.

description.zh: 马当要塞失守后，日军波田支队沿长江南岸西进，6月29日攻占彭泽县城。彭泽是马当要塞的后方依托，失守后日军直逼湖口。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与《抗战实录丨马当要塞失陷记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: After Madang fell, the Japanese Wada detachment advanced west along the south bank of the Yangtze and captured Pengze on 29 June. Pengze was the rear support of the Madang fortress; its fall opened the way to Hukou. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the Madang account and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年7月4日，湖口沦陷。
summary.en: On 4 July 1938 Hukou fell.

description.zh: 7月4日，日军攻占湖口。湖口位于鄱阳湖入长江口，是九江的东面屏障；失守后日军沿江直逼九江。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与《抗战实录丨马当要塞失陷记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 4 July Japanese forces captured Hukou. At the mouth of Poyang Lake where it joins the Yangtze, Hukou was the eastern shield of Jiujiang; its fall opened the river route to Jiujiang. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the Madang account and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年8月20日，星子沦陷。
summary.en: On 20 August 1938 Xingzi fell.

description.zh: 8月，日军第101师团等部沿鄱阳湖西岸南犯，8月20日攻占星子县城。星子是庐山南麓、鄱阳湖西岸的要点，失守后日军向德安方向推进。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与央广网江西抗战专题，待页码级核对。
description.en: In August the Japanese 101st Division and other units advanced south along the western shore of Poyang Lake and captured Xingzi on 20 August. Xingzi was a key point south of Mount Lu on the lake's western shore; its fall opened the advance toward De'an. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the CNR Jiangxi campaign feature and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年8月24日，瑞昌沦陷。
summary.en: On 24 August 1938 Ruichang fell.

description.zh: 8月24日，日军攻占瑞昌。瑞昌位于九江以西、幕阜山东北麓，是日军由赣北迂回武汉的通道。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与央广网江西抗战专题，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 24 August Japanese forces captured Ruichang. West of Jiujiang on the northeastern slope of the Mufu Mountains, Ruichang was a corridor for the Japanese flanking move toward Wuhan through northern Jiangxi. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the CNR Jiangxi campaign feature and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年10月27日，德安沦陷。
summary.en: On 27 October 1938 De'an fell.

description.zh: 10月27日，日军攻占德安。德安位于南浔铁路中段，是万家岭战役的核心地区；日军第106师团在万家岭遭中国军队重创后，主力仍于10月底攻占德安。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与央广网江西抗战专题，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 27 October Japanese forces captured De'an. On the central section of the Nanchang–Jiujiang railway, De'an was at the heart of the Wanjialing battle; the Japanese 106th Division was mauled at Wanjialing, but the main force still took De'an in late October. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the CNR Jiangxi campaign feature and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1939年3月22日，永修沦陷。
summary.en: On 22 March 1939 Yongxiu fell.

description.zh: 3月20日，日军第11军强渡修河，突破中国军队修河防线；3月22日攻占永修。永修是南昌西北门户，失守后日军沿南浔铁路南下，直逼南昌。日期为通行说法，据《江西抗日战争史》与《南昌会战》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 20 March the Japanese 11th Army crossed the Xiu River and broke the Chinese defence line; Yongxiu fell on 22 March. Northwest of Nanchang, Yongxiu was the city's gateway; its fall opened the Japanese advance south along the Nanchang–Jiujiang railway. The date is the common account, follows the Jiangxi war history and the Nanchang campaign, and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1939年3月29日，高安沦陷。
summary.en: On 29 March 1939 Gao'an fell.

description.zh: 南昌会战期间，日军第11军一部沿湘赣公路西进，3月29日攻占高安。高安是南昌以西、锦江中游的要点，失守后中国军队第74军等部多次反攻。日期为通行说法，据《南昌会战》与《江西抗日战争史》，待页码级核对。
description.en: During the Nanchang campaign a Japanese 11th Army column advanced west along the Hunan–Jiangxi road and captured Gao'an on 29 March. West of Nanchang on the middle Jin River, Gao'an was a key point; Chinese forces including the 74th Army counter-attacked repeatedly after its fall. The date is the common account, follows the Nanchang campaign and the Jiangxi war history, and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1939年4月2日，奉新沦陷。
summary.en: On 2 April 1939 Fengxin fell.

description.zh: 4月2日，日军攻占奉新。奉新位于南昌以西、潦河中游，是南昌会战中西路的要点。日期为通行说法，据《南昌会战》与《江西抗日战争史》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 2 April Japanese forces captured Fengxin. West of Nanchang on the middle Liao River, Fengxin was a key point on the western axis of the Nanchang campaign. The date is the common account, follows the Nanchang campaign and the Jiangxi war history, and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1945年2月6日，南康沦陷。
summary.en: On 6 February 1945 Nankang fell.

description.zh: 1945年2月，日军为打通赣南、摧毁遂川和赣州机场，向赣州、南康、大余推进。2月5日赣州、大余沦陷，2月6日南康沦陷。南康是赣州西南门户。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与《江西抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。
description.en: In February 1945 Japanese forces advanced on Ganzhou, Nankang and Dayu to open the way through southern Jiangxi and destroy the Suichuan and Ganzhou airfields. Ganzhou and Dayu fell on 5 February and Nankang on 6 February. Nankang was the southwestern gateway to Ganzhou. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the Jiangxi war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年7月27日，日军攻占廊坊。
summary.en: On 27 July 1937 Japanese forces captured Langfang.

description.zh: 卢沟桥事变后，日军从北平、天津两个方向夹击平津铁路。7月27日，日军攻占廊坊，切断北平与天津之间的铁路联系。日期据《河北抗日战争史》与《中国抗日战争史》，待页码级核对。
description.en: After the Lugouqiao Incident, Japanese forces attacked the Beiping–Tianjin railway from both ends. On 27 July they captured Langfang, cutting the rail link between Beiping and Tianjin. The date follows the Hebei war history and the Chinese war history and awaits page-level verification.

description.zh: 7月29日，日军占领通州。通州是北平东面的门户，冀东伪政权所在地；通州沦陷后，日军完成对北平的合围。日期据《河北抗日战争史》与《中国抗日战争史》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 29 July Japanese forces occupied Tongzhou. As the eastern gateway to Beiping and seat of the East Hebei puppet regime, its fall completed the encirclement of Beiping. The date follows the Hebei war history and the Chinese war history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 24 September 1937 Japanese forces captured Cangzhou.

description.zh: 9月，日军沿津浦铁路南犯。9月24日，日军攻占沧州。沧州是津浦线北段重镇，失守后日军继续南犯德州、济南。日期据《河北抗日战争史》与《河北省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: In September Japanese forces advanced south along the Tianjin–Pukou railway and captured Cangzhou on 24 September. A key town on the northern section of the line, its fall opened the way south toward Dezhou and Jinan. The date follows the Hebei war history and the provincial military gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年10月17日，日军攻占邯郸。
summary.en: On 17 October 1937 Japanese forces captured Handan.

description.zh: 10月17日，日军攻占邯郸。邯郸是平汉线南段与冀南门户，失守后日军继续南犯磁县、安阳。日期据《中国抗日战争史》与《河北省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 17 October Japanese forces captured Handan. At the southern section of the Beiping–Hankou railway and the gateway to southern Hebei, its fall opened the way to Cixian and Anyang. The date follows the Chinese war history and the provincial military gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年10月18日，日军攻占磁县。
summary.en: On 18 October 1937 Japanese forces captured Cixian.

description.zh: 10月18日，日军攻占磁县。磁县是河北南端、平汉线入豫前的最后一站，失守后日军进入河南安阳。日期据《中国抗日战争史》与《河北省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 18 October Japanese forces captured Cixian. At the southern tip of Hebei and the last station on the Beiping–Hankou railway before Henan, its fall opened the way into Anyang. The date follows the Chinese war history and the provincial military gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年11月12日，日军攻占大名。
summary.en: On 12 November 1937 Japanese forces captured Daming.

description.zh: 11月12日，日军攻占大名。大名是冀南重镇，失守后日军控制冀南、豫北交界。日期据《河北抗日战争史》与《河北省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 12 November Japanese forces captured Daming. A key town in southern Hebei, its fall gave the Japanese control of the Hebei–Henan border area. The date follows the Hebei war history and the provincial military gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1945年10月6日，天津举行日军受降仪式。
summary.en: On 6 October 1945 a Japanese surrender ceremony was held in Tianjin.

description.zh: 10月6日，天津举行日军受降仪式，接收天津地区日军。天津是华北重要港口和日军华北方面军的重要据点。受降事件，不绘路线。日期据中国受降档案与《中国抗日战争史》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 6 October a surrender ceremony was held in Tianjin to receive the Japanese forces in the Tianjin area. Tianjin was a major North China port and an important base of the Japanese North China Area Army. This surrender event is not drawn as a route. The date follows the Chinese surrender archives and the Chinese war history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1945年10月10日，北平太和殿举行日军受降仪式。
summary.en: On 10 October 1945 the Japanese surrender ceremony was held at the Hall of Supreme Harmony in Beiping.

description.zh: 10月10日，北平太和殿举行日军受降仪式，第十一战区司令长官孙连仲代表中国政府受降，日军华北方面军司令官根本博在投降书上签字。受降事件，不绘路线。日期据中国受降档案与《中国抗日战争史》，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 10 October the surrender ceremony was held at the Hall of Supreme Harmony in Beiping. Sun Lianzhong, commander of the 11th War Zone, received the surrender for China, and General Nemoto Hiroshi, commander of the Japanese North China Area Army, signed the instrument of surrender. This surrender event is not drawn as a route. The date follows the Chinese surrender archives and the Chinese war history and awaits page-level verification.

sources.author: 军事科学院

summary.zh: 1937年9月9日，日军攻占阳高县城。
summary.en: On 9 September 1937 Japanese forces captured Yanggao.

description.zh: 9月初，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团突破天镇盘山防线，9月8日围攻阳高。守军第61军第414团据城抵抗，9日拂晓日军由东南城墙登城，阳高失守，守军由南门撤退。城破后日军在瓮城屠杀欢迎民众及青壮年五百余人。日期据《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（阳高县政协稿）与《太原会战》逐日记载。
description.en: In early September the Kwantung Army’s Chahar force broke the Panshan line at Tianzhen and besieged Yanggao on 8 September. The 414th Regiment of the 61st Corps held the town until Japanese troops mounted the southeast wall at dawn on the 9th; Yanggao fell and the defenders withdrew through the south gate. After the capture the Japanese massacred more than 500 people in the barbican. Dates follow the Shanxi county gazetteer compilation and the day-by-day Taoyuan campaign account.

sources.title: 山西县城沦陷及光复概况
sources.author: 太原道汇编（各县政协、县志办稿）

summary.zh: 1937年9月12日，日军攻占天镇县城。
summary.en: On 12 September 1937 Japanese forces captured Tianzhen.

description.zh: 日军自9月3日起进攻天镇盘山防线，守军第61军苦战。9月7日守军主力后撤，仅留第399团守城；9月11日夜守军突围，12日天镇县城失守。天镇是晋北门户，失守后日军直趋大同。天镇日期另有9月11日说（《太原会战》逐日条记“九月十一日占领天镇县城”），此处取各县政协稿与同文正文的9月12日。
description.en: Japanese forces attacked the Panshan line at Tianzhen from 3 September. The 61st Corps’ main force withdrew on the 7th, leaving the 399th Regiment in the town; the garrison broke out on the night of the 11th and Tianzhen fell on the 12th, opening the road to Datong. One day-by-day account gives 11 September for the town’s capture; this entry follows the county gazetteer compilation and the same account’s narrative of the 12th.

sources.title: 山西县城沦陷及光复概况
sources.author: 太原道汇编（各县政协、县志办稿）

summary.zh: 1937年9月14日，日军未经战斗占领怀仁县城。
summary.en: On 14 September 1937 Japanese forces occupied Huairen without a fight.

description.zh: 9月13日大同失守后，怀仁守军与县政府弃城南撤。9月14日，当地士绅出城迎接，日军独立混成第15旅团未发一枪占领怀仁县城。日期据《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（怀仁县政协稿）与《太原会战》逐日记载。
description.en: After Datong fell on 13 September, the garrison and county government at Huairen withdrew south. On the 14th local gentry went out to welcome the Japanese, and the Independent Mixed 15th Brigade occupied the town without firing a shot. Dates follow the county gazetteer compilation and the day-by-day Taoyuan campaign account.

sources.title: 山西县城沦陷及光复概况
sources.author: 太原道汇编（各县政协、县志办稿）

summary.zh: 1937年9月14日，日军第5师团攻占广灵县城。
summary.en: On 14 September 1937 the Japanese 5th Division captured Guangling.

description.zh: 9月13日，日军第5师团第21旅团进攻广灵洗马庄一带，中国军队第73师防线被突破，师长刘奉滨负伤。9月14日广灵县城失守，第73师向平型关转进。此后八路军杨成武支队曾在月内四次收复县城，11月初日军再次侵占并长期盘踞。日期据《太原会战》逐日记载与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（广灵县政协稿）。
description.en: On 13 September the Japanese 5th Division’s 21st Brigade attacked the Chinese 73rd Division’s line at Ximazhuang and broke it, wounding divisional commander Liu Fengbin. Guangling fell on the 14th and the 73rd Division retired toward Pingxingguan. Yang Chengwu’s detachment retook the town four times within a month before the Japanese reoccupied it in early November. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

sources.title: 山西县城沦陷及光复概况
sources.author: 太原道汇编（各县政协、县志办稿）

summary.zh: 1937年9月19日，日军混成第1旅团占领左云县城。
summary.en: On 19 September 1937 the Japanese 1st Mixed Brigade occupied Zuoyun.

description.zh: 9月17日，骑兵军孙长胜部数百人入左云守城，当晚日军攻城因雨停止。18日黄昏守军撤走，19日上午日军入城，随即屠杀居民287人。日期取《太原会战》逐日条“九月十九日……侵占左云”；《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》记18日黄昏守军撤走、次日入城，与此一致。
description.en: On 17 September several hundred men of Sun Changsheng’s cavalry entered Zuoyun; the Japanese attack that night was halted by rain. The defenders withdrew at dusk on the 18th and the Japanese entered on the morning of the 19th, then massacred 287 residents. The date follows the day-by-day campaign account, consistent with the county gazetteer compilation’s account of the defenders’ withdrawal on the 18th.

sources.title: 山西县城沦陷及光复概况
sources.author: 太原道汇编（各县政协、县志办稿）

name.en: Fall of Shuoxian and the Shuoxian Massacre

summary.zh: 1937年9月28日，日军攻破朔县县城，随后屠杀居民约三千人。
summary.en: On 28 September 1937 Japanese forces broke into Shuoxian and massacred some 3,000 residents.

description.zh: 9月27日傍晚，日军独立混成第1旅团进入朔县川。守军东北军何柱国部一个连与县长郭同仁、公安局长白生成率军民堵门守城。28日晨日军分两路包围县城，9时许以坦克破门，随即展开屠杀，持续三日，约三千人遇害，县长郭同仁殉难，是为“九二八惨案”。日期据《太原会战》逐日条“九月二十八日……占领朔县”与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（朔县政协稿）。
description.en: On the evening of 27 September the Japanese Independent Mixed 1st Brigade entered the Shuoxian basin. A company of He Zhuguo’s Northeast Army, county magistrate Guo Tongren and police chief Bai Shengcheng led civilians in barricading the gates. At dawn on the 28th the Japanese encircled the town and broke in with tanks around 9 a.m., beginning a three-day massacre in which about 3,000 people died and magistrate Guo was killed. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

sources.title: 山西县城沦陷及光复概况
sources.author: 太原道汇编（各县政协、县志办稿）

summary.zh: 1937年9月29日，日军混成第15旅团占领繁峙县城。
summary.en: On 29 September 1937 the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade occupied Fanshi.

description.zh: 9月28日，日军混成第15旅团攻占茹越口，中国守军第203旅旅长梁鉴堂力战殉国，日军越铁角岭南下。9月29日繁峙县城失守，平型关守军侧后受到威胁，第二战区随即下令全线后撤。日期据《太原会战》逐日记载与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（繁峙县政协、县志办稿）。
description.en: On 28 September the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade took Ruyuekou after killing Brig. Liang Jiantang of the 203rd Brigade, then crossed Tiejiaoling. Fanshi fell on the 29th, threatening the rear of the Pingxingguan defenders and prompting the Second War Zone to order a general withdrawal. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

sources.title: 山西县城沦陷及光复概况
sources.author: 太原道汇编（各县政协、县志办稿）

summary.zh: 1937年9月30日，日军混成第15旅团占领代县县城。
summary.en: On 30 September 1937 the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade occupied Daixian.

description.zh: 9月30日，日军由繁峙向代县进犯，晋绥军抵抗约半小时即退，日军当晚占领代县城。次日地方商会出面成立“代县治安维持会”。日期据《太原会战》逐日条“九月三十日……占领代县”与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（代县政协稿）。
description.en: On 30 September Japanese troops advanced from Fanshi toward Daixian; the Shanxi garrison resisted for about half an hour before withdrawing and the town fell that evening. The local chamber of commerce set up a “maintenance committee” the next day. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

sources.title: 山西县城沦陷及光复概况
sources.author: 太原道汇编（各县政协、县志办稿）

summary.zh: 1937年10月2日，日军混成第1旅团占领宁武县城，随后屠杀居民两千余人。
summary.en: On 2 October 1937 the Japanese 1st Mixed Brigade occupied Ningwu and massacred more than 2,000 residents.

description.zh: 10月2日，日军由朔县进攻宁武，晚九时占领县城。日军诱骗外逃群众回城，随后集中屠杀，遇害者两千二百余人。10月13日八路军第120师袭击县城，日军连夜撤离；1938年日军再次入侵。日期据《太原会战》逐日条与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（宁武县政协稿）。
description.en: On 2 October Japanese troops advanced from Shuoxian and took Ningwu at 9 p.m. They lured fleeing residents back and then massacred more than 2,200 people. On 13 October the 120th Division attacked the town and the Japanese withdrew overnight; they invaded again in 1938. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

sources.title: 山西县城沦陷及光复概况
sources.author: 太原道汇编（各县政协、县志办稿）

summary.zh: 1937年10月8日，日军混成第2旅团攻占崞县县城。
summary.en: On 8 October 1937 the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade captured Guoxian.

description.zh: 10月1日起，日军混成第2旅团由代县南下进攻崞县，第19军王靖国部苦战一周。10月8日晨守军撤出，崞县失守，团长刘良相、石成文阵亡，日军入城后屠杀居民与伤兵两千五百余人。崞县即今原平市崞阳镇，与南面的原平镇为忻口以北两处要点。日期据《太原会战》逐日条与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（原平县政协稿）。
description.en: From 1 October the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade advanced south from Daixian against Guoxian, where Wang Jingguo’s 19th Corps fought for a week. The defenders withdrew on the morning of the 8th; colonels Liu Liangxiang and Shi Chengwen were killed and the Japanese massacred more than 2,500 residents and wounded. Guoxian is today’s Guoyang town in Yuanping. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

sources.title: 山西县城沦陷及光复概况
sources.author: 太原道汇编（各县政协、县志办稿）

summary.zh: 1937年10月10日，日军混成第15旅团攻占原平镇，守军第196旅几乎全部殉国。
summary.en: On 10 October 1937 the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade captured Yuanping; the Chinese 196th Brigade was almost annihilated.

description.zh: 10月4日，日军混成第15旅团绕过崞县进攻原平，第34军第196旅旅长姜玉贞率部死守。原平掩护忻口布防，守军完成任务后于10日夜至11日晨突围，姜玉贞中弹殉国，全旅四千余人大部阵亡。日期取《太原会战》逐日条“十月十日……攻占原平”；姜玉贞突围殉国在11日，两说并不矛盾。
description.en: On 4 October the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade bypassed Guoxian and attacked Yuanping, defended by Brig. Jiang Yuzhen’s 196th Brigade of the 34th Corps. Covering the deployment at Xinkou, the brigade broke out on the night of the 10th; Jiang was mortally wounded and most of his 4,000 men died. The capture date follows the day-by-day campaign account; Jiang’s death during the breakout on the 11th is consistent with it.

sources.title: 山西县城沦陷及光复概况
sources.author: 太原道汇编（各县政协、县志办稿）

summary.zh: 1937年10月29日，日军第20师团侵占平定县城。
summary.en: On 29 October 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Pingding.

description.zh: 10月26日娘子关失守后，日军第20师团沿正太线西追。平定县长及公务人员先期弃城，守军炸毁阳泉五渡铁路桥后西撤。10月29日夜十时许日军先头部队进入平定城，翌日大队开进，30日占领阳泉。日期据《太原会战》逐日条“十月二十九日……侵占平定县城”与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（平定县政协稿）。
description.en: After Niangziguan fell on 26 October, the Japanese 20th Division pursued west along the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway. The Pingding magistrate and officials had fled and the garrison withdrew after blowing up the Wudu railway bridge at Yangquan. Japanese advance troops entered Pingding around 10 p.m. on the 29th, the main body followed next morning, and Yangquan was occupied on the 30th. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

sources.title: 山西县城沦陷及光复概况
sources.author: 太原道汇编（各县政协、县志办稿）

summary.zh: 1937年10月30日，日军第20师团占领阳泉镇。
summary.en: On 30 October 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Yangquan.

description.zh: 阳泉时为平定县属镇，是正太铁路与煤矿枢纽。娘子关失守后，日军第20师团以两纵队向阳泉平原追击，10月30日占领阳泉，随后西犯寿阳、榆次。日期据《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（平定县政协稿）与《抗日战争中的阳泉》。
description.en: Yangquan was then a town in Pingding county and a hub of the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway and coal mines. After Niangziguan fell, the Japanese 20th Division pursued in two columns onto the Yangquan plain and occupied the town on 30 October before advancing on Shouyang and Yuci. Dates follow the county gazetteer compilation and the Shanxi war-resistance account of Yangquan.

sources.title: 山西县城沦陷及光复概况
sources.author: 太原道汇编（各县政协、县志办稿）

sources.title: 抗日战争中的阳泉
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网（山西抗战）

summary.zh: 1937年11月2日，日军第20师团占领寿阳县城。
summary.en: On 2 November 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Shouyang.

description.zh: 日军第20师团自平定、阳泉西进，击退川军第41军阻击后于11月2日占领寿阳，随即逼近榆次、太原。八路军第115师、第129师先后在广阳伏击日军。寿阳日期取《太原会战》逐日条“十一月二日占寿阳”与《娘子关战役》所记同一日期；《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》寿阳县稿则记10月30日占领县城，异说并存，本条目从多数记载。
description.en: The Japanese 20th Division advanced west from Pingding and Yangquan, brushed aside the Sichuan 41st Corps and took Shouyang on 2 November, closing on Yuci and Taiyuan. The 115th and 129th Divisions ambushed Japanese columns at Guangyang. The date follows the day-by-day campaign account and the Niangziguan campaign account; the county gazetteer compilation gives 30 October as a variant, noted here.

summary.zh: 1937年11月9日，日军第20师团侵占平遥县城。
summary.en: On 9 November 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Pingyao.

description.zh: 太原失守后，日军第20师团沿同蒲线南下，11月9日侵占平遥城，半月后撤回祁县。1938年2月13日日军再犯平遥，第17军高桂滋部骑兵营与自卫队抵抗，营长史殿杰力战自尽，日军入城后杀害伤兵与居民千余人。日期取《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（平遥县稿）；《太原会战》逐日条记11月10日进占平遥，异说并存。
description.en: After Taiyuan fell the Japanese 20th Division moved south along the Tongpu railway and occupied Pingyao on 9 November, withdrawing to Qixian about a fortnight later. On 13 February 1938 the Japanese attacked again; a cavalry battalion of Gao Guizi’s 17th Corps and local militia resisted, battalion commander Shi Dianjie took his own life, and more than 1,000 wounded soldiers and residents were killed. The date follows the county gazetteer compilation; the campaign chronology gives 10 November as a variant.

summary.zh: 1938年2月20日，日军第108师团攻占长治。
summary.en: On 20 February 1938 the Japanese 108th Division captured Changzhi.

description.zh: 1938年2月，日军第1军向晋南、晋西发动攻势。平汉线日军第108师团第104旅团（苫米地旅团）由东阳关突破川军第47军防线，2月20日攻占长治，随后沿临屯公路西进，威胁临汾。日期据《第三军在太行山对日游击作战》与《陈赓大将的这个神来之笔》所引战史，均记2月20日进占长治。
description.en: In February 1938 the Japanese First Army attacked southern and western Shanxi. The 108th Division’s 104th Brigade (Tomekichi brigade) broke through the Sichuan 47th Corps at Dongyangguan and captured Changzhi on 20 February, then advanced west along the Linfen–Tunliu road toward Linfen. Both cited accounts give 20 February for the capture.

sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网

sources.title: 陈赓大将的这个神来之笔，被日军称为八路军的“典型游击战术”
sources.author: 红色文化网

summary.zh: 1938年2月26日，日军第一次占领晋城。
summary.en: On 26 February 1938 Japanese forces occupied Jincheng for the first time.

description.zh: 2月20日日军飞机轰炸高平。日军第108师团等部由长治南下，2月26日第一次占领晋城。八路军与决死队随后发起反九路围攻，4月23日收复晋城。此后日军又四次侵占晋城。日期据《日军先后五次侵占晋城》与《晋东南1938年战役》。
description.en: Japanese aircraft bombed Gaoping on 20 February. The 108th Division and other units moved south from Changzhi and occupied Jincheng for the first time on 26 February. The Eighth Route Army and the Sacrifice League then launched a counter-offensive against the nine-route encirclement and recovered the town on 23 April; the Japanese occupied it four more times. Dates follow the Jincheng occupation account and the 1938 southeastern Shanxi campaign article.

sources.title: 日军先后五次侵占晋城
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网

summary.zh: 1938年2月28日，日军占领临汾县城。
summary.en: On 28 February 1938 Japanese forces captured Linfen.

description.zh: 1938年2月中旬，日军第1军集结兵力向晋南、晋西进犯。2月28日，日军经洪洞曲亭镇进犯临汾县城，守军决死三纵队第九总队退往浮山，临汾失守。第二战区司令长官部此前已由临汾西移。临汾日期另有2月27日说（大同市政府纪念报道），此处取临汾各县沦陷概况与当时照片说明的2月28日。
description.en: In mid-February 1938 the Japanese First Army massed troops for an offensive into southern and western Shanxi. On 28 February Japanese troops advanced on Linfen via Quting in Hongtong; the Sacrifice League’s 9th Regiment withdrew to Fushan and the county town fell. The Second War Zone headquarters had already moved west from Linfen. A Datong municipal account gives 27 February as a variant; this entry follows the Linfen county survey and a contemporary photograph caption.

sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网

sources.title: 日军杂志美化侵略山西历史
sources.author: 新浪新闻（1938-02-28 日军进入临汾城照片说明）

summary.zh: 1938年3月5日，日军侵占运城。
summary.en: On 5 March 1938 Japanese forces occupied Yuncheng.

description.zh: 1938年3月初，日军沿同蒲线南下并自豫北入晋，3月5日侵占运城。随后3月6日陷曲沃、禹门口，3月7日侵占永济，3月8日陷芮城，进抵黄河风陵渡，与潼关隔河对峙。运城日军番号有异说：一记第14师团酒井支队，一记第108师团自博爱入晋，本条目只记“日军第1军一部”。日期据《中华民族抗日编年（1938年3月）》与黄力民《旧日本宪兵规制与侵华日军宪兵组织沿革》。
description.en: In early March 1938 Japanese forces advanced south along the Tongpu railway and entered Shanxi from northern Henan, occupying Yuncheng on 5 March. Quwo and Yumenkou fell on the 6th, Yongji on the 7th and Ruicheng on the 8th, bringing the Japanese to the Fenglingdu crossing opposite Tongguan. Sources differ on the unit (the 14th Division’s Sakai detachment or the 108th Division from Bo’ai), so this entry says only “part of the Japanese First Army.” Dates follow the March 1938 chronology and Huang Limin’s study of Japanese military police organization.

sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网

sources.title: 旧日本宪兵规制与侵华日军宪兵组织沿革

summary.zh: 1941年5月8日，日军在中条山会战中攻陷垣曲。
summary.en: On 8 May 1941 Japanese forces captured Yuanqu during the Zhongtiao Mountains campaign.

description.zh: 1941年5月7日傍晚，日军华北方面军第1军等部由东、西、北三面以中央突破方式进攻中条山。8日晨突破中国军队正面阵地，直指垣曲，垣曲当日失守。垣曲地处中条山腹地，第5集团军指挥部所在地，失守后中条山守军被分割。日期据《中条山会战》与台湾荣民文化网《晉南會戰過程》。
description.en: At dusk on 7 May 1941 the Japanese First Army attacked the Zhongtiao Mountains from east, west and north with a central breakthrough. On the morning of the 8th it broke the front and drove on Yuanqu, which fell that day. Yuanqu lay in the heart of the mountains and housed the 5th Group Army headquarters; its loss split the Chinese defenders. Dates follow the Zhongtiao campaign article and the Veterans Affairs Council account.

sources.title: 晉南會戰過程
sources.author: 榮民文化網（台湾退辅会）

summary.zh: 1945年9月13日，第二战区司令长官阎锡山在太原接受日军投降。
summary.en: On 13 September 1945 Yan Xishan, commander of the Second War Zone, accepted the Japanese surrender at Taiyuan.

description.zh: 1945年9月13日，日军第1军司令官澄田赉四郎在太原受领中国第二战区司令长官部第一号命令，开始部署投降事宜。第二战区共接受日军第1军及第114师团、第3、第10、第14独立旅团、第5独立骑兵团等部六万余人投降，并遣返日侨四万人。受降事件不绘制进攻路线。日期据国家档案局《伟大胜利——中国受降档案》与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》。
description.en: On 13 September 1945 Lt. Gen. Teita Raishiro, commander of the Japanese First Army, received Order No. 1 from the Chinese Second War Zone headquarters at Taiyuan and began arranging the surrender. The Second War Zone accepted over 60,000 Japanese troops of the First Army, the 114th Division and the 3rd, 10th and 14th Independent Brigades and 5th Independent Cavalry Regiment, and repatriated 40,000 Japanese civilians. No advance route is drawn for a surrender event. Dates follow the National Archives’ surrender records and the Shanxi county gazetteer compilation.

summary.zh: 1937年11月5日，日军第14师团攻占豫北重镇安阳（彰德）。
summary.en: On 5 November 1937 the Japanese 14th Division captured Anyang (Zhangde), the key city of northern Henan.

description.zh: 1937年11月3日，日军第14师团强渡漳河；4日凌晨攻占安阳火车站；5日下午2时由小西门突入城内，安阳（彰德）沦陷。日军入城后屠杀居民千余人、烧房两千余间。安阳是河南第一个沦陷的重要城市，此后成为日军进攻晋东南和豫北的出发点。日期据《抗战时期安阳地区大事记》与《河南的抗战历程》，两者均记11月5日城陷。
description.en: On 3 November 1937 the Japanese 14th Division forced the Zhang River; before dawn on the 4th it took Anyang railway station, and at 2 p.m. on the 5th it entered the city through the Small West Gate. Anyang (Zhangde) thus became the first major Henan city to fall, and later served as the Japanese base for operations into southeastern Shanxi and northern Henan. Both cited accounts give 5 November.

summary.zh: 1938年2月7日，日军第14师团馆支队自大名南犯，占领南乐。
summary.en: On 7 February 1938 the Kaneda detachment of the Japanese 14th Division advanced south from Daming and took Nanle.

description.zh: 1938年2月6日，日军第14师团分两路进犯豫北。馆支队（第27旅团）5个步兵大队、3个炮兵大队自大名南下，7日陷南乐，9日占清丰、内黄，10日攻陷濮阳。南乐仅驻地方保安团，未经激战即溃。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《新乡抗战·惨案》所引地方党史。
description.en: On 6 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division attacked northern Henan in two columns. The Kaneda (27th Brigade) detachment marched south from Daming, took Nanle on the 7th, Qingfeng and Neihuang on the 9th, and Puyang on the 10th. Nanle was held only by local security regiments, which collapsed without a serious fight.

summary.zh: 1938年2月9日，日军第14师团馆支队占领清丰。
summary.en: On 9 February 1938 the Kaneda detachment of the Japanese 14th Division occupied Qingfeng.

description.zh: 1938年2月7日日军陷南乐后继续南犯，9日占清丰、内黄，并围攻濮阳。清丰、南乐一带仅有地方保安团约四千人，接火即溃，日军得以长驱直入。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《新乡抗战·惨案》。
description.en: After taking Nanle on 7 February 1938 the Japanese pushed south, occupying Qingfeng and Neihuang on the 9th and investing Puyang. The area was defended only by about 4,000 local security troops, who broke on contact, allowing the Japanese to advance rapidly. Dates follow the 1938 Henan chronology and the Xinxiang wartime survey.

summary.zh: 1938年2月10日，日军第14师团馆支队攻陷濮阳。
summary.en: On 10 February 1938 the Kaneda detachment of the Japanese 14th Division captured Puyang.

description.zh: 濮阳扼道口、封丘、延津要冲，日军陷南乐、清丰后即围攻濮阳。第一战区急令第77军副军长张凌云率3个旅及骑兵第9师自东明、道口反击，但各部行动迟缓，日军增兵至五千余人，附炮20余门、坦克10余辆，在飞机、重炮掩护下于10日攻陷濮阳。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《新乡抗战·惨案》。
description.en: Puyang commanded the approaches to Daokou, Fengqiu and Yanjin. After taking Nanle and Qingfeng the Japanese invested the city. The First War Zone ordered Zhang Lingyun’s three brigades and the 9th Cavalry Division to counterattack from Dongming and Daokou, but they moved too slowly; reinforced to over 5,000 men with more than 20 guns and 10 tanks, the Japanese took Puyang on the 10th under air and artillery cover.

summary.zh: 1938年2月13日，日军第14师团进占汤阴。
summary.en: On 13 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division occupied Tangyin.

description.zh: 1938年2月6日起，日军第14师团主力自安阳沿平汉路南犯，在宝莲寺、汤阴附近与万福麟、高树勋部血战四昼夜。11日上午宝莲寺失守，12日晚万福麟以阵地被毁、两翼受围，擅自放弃汤阴退至淇河南岸，13日日军进占汤阴。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》；《新乡抗战·惨案》亦记2月中旬日军侵占汤阴。
description.en: From 6 February 1938 the main force of the Japanese 14th Division advanced south from Anyang along the Beiping–Hankou railway, fighting Wan Fulin and Gao Shuxun’s troops for four days around Baoliansi and Tangyin. Baoliansi fell on the morning of the 11th; on the night of the 12th Wan abandoned Tangyin and withdrew south of the Qi River, and the Japanese entered the city on the 13th.

summary.zh: 1938年2月13日，日军第14师团进占淇县。
summary.en: On 13 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division occupied Qi County.

description.zh: 1938年2月12日日军越过淇河逼近淇县，13日万福麟部退至平汉路西侧，日军轻易占据淇县，直接威胁道清铁路。淇县失守后，日军一部继续南犯汲县，一部转向浚县，制造浚县惨案。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《新乡抗战·惨案》。
description.en: On 12 February 1938 the Japanese crossed the Qi River toward Qi County; on the 13th Wan Fulin’s troops withdrew west of the Beiping–Hankou railway and the Japanese occupied the county town, threatening the Daoqing railway. Part of the force then moved south toward Jixian and part turned on Xunxian, where it carried out the Xunxian massacre.

summary.zh: 1938年2月14日，日军第14师团馆支队攻陷长垣。
summary.en: On 14 February 1938 the Kaneda detachment of the Japanese 14th Division captured Changyuan.

description.zh: 濮阳失守后，日军第14师团馆支队一部迅速南下，14日陷长垣，15日陷封丘，直逼新乡。长垣首次沦陷日期另有2月13日、2月23日/24日等说。3月25日日军攻入县城，制造黉学惨案，屠杀民众1700余人。日期取《1938年河南历史大事记》，异说据《新乡抗战·惨案》与长垣地方史料。
description.en: After Puyang fell, part of the Kaneda detachment drove south, taking Changyuan on 14 February and Fengqiu on the 15th, closing on Xinxiang. Local accounts give 13 February or 23/24 February for the first occupation. On 25 March the Japanese entered the city and carried out the Hongxue massacre, killing more than 1,700 civilians. The date follows the 1938 Henan chronology, with variants noted.

summary.zh: 1938年2月15日，日军第14师团馆支队攻陷封丘。
summary.en: On 15 February 1938 the Kaneda detachment of the Japanese 14th Division captured Fengqiu.

description.zh: 1938年2月14日长垣失守后，日军馆支队继续南下，15日攻陷封丘，随后直逼新乡。封丘失守使日军从东南方向威胁新乡，与自安阳南下的第14师团主力形成夹击。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《新乡抗战·惨案》，两源一致。
description.en: After Changyuan fell on 14 February 1938, the Kaneda detachment continued south and took Fengqiu on the 15th, then closed on Xinxiang. The loss of Fengqiu threatened Xinxiang from the southeast and allowed the Japanese to converge with the 14th Division’s main force advancing south from Anyang. Both sources agree on the date.

summary.zh: 1938年2月15日，日军第14师团侵占汲县（今卫辉）。
summary.en: On 15 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division occupied Jixian (present-day Weihui).

description.zh: 1938年2月14日晚，日军向汲县以北冯治安部阵地猛攻，守军稍作抵抗即退守新乡；宋哲元以“全军为上”下令放弃汲县，沿道清路西撤。15日日军侵占汲县（今卫辉）。河南省地方史志记2月14日占汲县，日期相差一日，正文并列。
description.en: On the night of 14 February 1938 the Japanese attacked Feng Zhian’s positions north of Jixian; the defenders offered little resistance and fell back on Xinxiang. Song Zheyuan ordered Jixian abandoned and withdrew west along the Daoqing railway. The Japanese occupied Jixian (modern Weihui) on the 15th. The Henan provincial gazetteer gives 14 February, a one-day variant noted here.

summary.zh: 1938年2月17日，日军第14师团攻占豫北重镇新乡。
summary.en: On 17 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division captured Xinxiang, the key city of northern Henan.

description.zh: 1938年2月14日日军沿道清路西追，如入无人之境，17日陷新乡。新乡为豫北重镇和平汉、道清两路交点，失守后黄河以北几乎全部沦陷。新乡城陷日期，《1938年河南历史大事记》与《河南的抗战历程》均记2月17日，《新乡抗战·惨案》记2月16日，正文并列。
description.en: On 14 February 1938 the Japanese pursued west along the Daoqing railway and entered Xinxiang on the 17th. Xinxiang was the key city of northern Henan and the junction of the Beiping–Hankou and Daoqing railways; with its fall almost all of the region north of the Yellow River was lost. The 1938 Henan chronology and the Henan campaign history give 17 February; the Xinxiang wartime survey gives 16 February.

summary.zh: 1938年2月18日，日军第14师团占领获嘉。
summary.en: On 18 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division occupied Huojia.

description.zh: 新乡失守后，日军沿道清铁路继续西犯，18日占领获嘉，随后陷修武、焦作。获嘉是日军从新乡西进焦作、济源的中间节点。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《新乡抗战·惨案》，两源一致。
description.en: After Xinxiang fell, the Japanese pushed west along the Daoqing railway, occupying Huojia on 18 February before taking Xiuwu and Jiaozuo. Huojia was the intermediate point on the Japanese advance from Xinxiang toward Jiaozuo and Jiyuan. Both sources agree on the date.

sources.author: 新乡日报 2016-08-26

summary.zh: 1938年2月19日，日军第14师团占领焦作。
summary.en: On 19 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division occupied Jiaozuo.

description.zh: 1938年2月18日日军陷修武，19日占领焦作。焦作煤矿与道清铁路由此落入日军之手，成为其掠夺煤炭、运输军用物资的基地。此后八路军第129师第386旅、第115师第344旅及道清游击支队在焦作地区六破道清铁路。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《焦作日报》抗战专题。
description.en: The Japanese took Xiuwu on 18 February 1938 and Jiaozuo on the 19th. The Jiaozuo coal mines and the Daoqing railway thus fell into Japanese hands, becoming a base for coal extraction and military transport. The 129th and 115th Divisions and the Daoqing guerrilla detachment subsequently sabotaged the railway six times.

sources.title: 阻断运输线 困兽进退难——焦作抗战印迹之道清铁路大破袭篇
sources.author: 焦作日报 2025-08

summary.zh: 1938年2月25日，日军第14师团酒井支队攻陷济源。
summary.en: On 25 February 1938 the Sakai detachment of the Japanese 14th Division captured Jiyuan.

description.zh: 1938年2月22日日军突破沁河防线，攻占沁阳、孟县；23日攻击济源，25日济源城陷。万福麟部退往山西晋城、阳城，宋哲元第一集团军总部退入济源王屋山。济源陷落后，豫北几乎全部被日军占领。济源党史记2月21日日军进逼、县长弃城，2月25日城陷，与《1938年河南历史大事记》一致。
description.en: On 22 February 1938 the Japanese broke the Qin River line and took Qinyang and Mengxian; they attacked Jiyuan on the 23rd and took the city on the 25th. Wan Fulin withdrew toward Jincheng and Yangcheng in Shanxi, while Song Zheyuan’s First Group Army headquarters retreated into the Wangwu Mountains. With Jiyuan’s fall almost all of northern Henan was occupied.

sources.title: 气壮太行的济源敌后抗战
sources.author: 济源党史

summary.zh: 1938年5月12日，日军华中派遣军第13师团占领永城。
summary.en: On 12 May 1938 the Japanese 13th Division of the Central China Expeditionary Army occupied Yongcheng.

description.zh: 徐州会战期间，日军华中派遣军第9、第13师团沿涡河、北淝河北进，5月9日占蒙城，12日占永城，13日占夏邑。永城、夏邑失守后，第13师团继续北上，经韩道口突袭黄口，切断陇海路，从西面包围徐州。永城城陷日期，《1938年河南历史大事记》记5月12日，《河南的抗战历程》记5月13日，正文并列。
description.en: During the Xuzhou campaign the Japanese 9th and 13th Divisions advanced north along the Guo and Bei Fei rivers, taking Mengcheng on 9 May, Yongcheng on the 12th and Xiayi on the 13th. The 13th Division then drove north via Handao to Huangkou, cut the Longhai railway and closed on Xuzhou from the west. The 1938 Henan chronology gives 12 May; the Henan campaign history gives 13 May.

summary.zh: 1938年5月29日，日军第16师团占领商丘（归德）。
summary.en: On 29 May 1938 the Japanese 16th Division occupied Shangqiu (Guide).

description.zh: 1938年5月25日日军第16师团自砀山进逼虞城、商丘，26日虞城失守。第一战区司令长官程潜令黄杰等部死守商丘，黄杰临阵脱逃，29日凌晨商丘“不战自退”，日军占领商丘。商丘失守使兰封附近中国军队侧背受敌，战局逆转。城陷日期，《1938年河南历史大事记》记5月29日，《河南的抗战历程》记5月28日，正文并列。
description.en: On 25 May 1938 the Japanese 16th Division advanced from Dangshan toward Yucheng and Shangqiu; Yucheng fell on the 26th. Cheng Qian ordered Huang Jie to hold Shangqiu to the death, but Huang fled, and the city was abandoned without a fight in the early hours of the 29th. The loss exposed the Chinese forces around Lanfeng and reversed the campaign. The 1938 Henan chronology gives 29 May; the Henan campaign history gives 28 May.

summary.zh: 1938年6月3日，日军第16师团攻占杞县。
summary.en: On 3 June 1938 the Japanese 16th Division captured Qi County (Qixian).

description.zh: 1938年5月底至6月初，日军第16师团一部连陷民权、宁陵、睢县、杞县，企图由杞县直指开封、郑州。6月3日，杞县、通许、陈留为日军第16师团攻占。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》；《河南的抗战历程》记6月1日起先后占领杞县、通许、尉氏、太康，未逐日。
description.en: From late May to early June 1938 elements of the Japanese 16th Division took Minquan, Ningling, Suixian and Qixian, aiming from Qixian at Kaifeng and Zhengzhou. On 3 June the 16th Division captured Qixian, Tongxu and Chenliu. The 1938 Henan chronology gives the day; the Henan campaign history says only that Qixian, Tongxu, Weishi and Taikang were taken from 1 June.

summary.zh: 1938年6月3日，日军第16师团攻占通许。
summary.en: On 3 June 1938 the Japanese 16th Division captured Tongxu.

description.zh: 1938年6月3日，日军第16师团在攻占杞县、陈留的同时攻占通许，打开了由豫东直指开封、郑州的通道。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》；《河南的抗战历程》记6月1日起先后占领杞县、通许等地。
description.en: On 3 June 1938 the Japanese 16th Division captured Tongxu together with Qixian and Chenliu, opening the route from eastern Henan toward Kaifeng and Zhengzhou. The 1938 Henan chronology gives the day; the Henan campaign history says only that these places were taken from 1 June.

summary.zh: 1938年6月4日，日军第16师团一部攻占尉氏。
summary.en: On 4 June 1938 a detachment of the Japanese 16th Division captured Weishi.

description.zh: 1938年6月4日，日军第16师团一部攻占尉氏、扶沟，锋镝西指，企图迂回郑州。尉氏失守与同日花园口决堤前的豫东溃败相衔接。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》；《河南的抗战历程》记6月1日起先后占领尉氏等地。
description.en: On 4 June 1938 a detachment of the Japanese 16th Division captured Weishi and Fugou and turned west in an attempt to outflank Zhengzhou. The loss of Weishi formed part of the collapse in eastern Henan immediately before the Huayuankou levee breach. The 1938 Henan chronology gives the day; the Henan campaign history gives only early June.

summary.zh: 1938年6月9日，日军第14师团攻占中牟，进逼郑州。
summary.en: On 9 June 1938 the Japanese 14th Division captured Zhongmou and closed on Zhengzhou.

description.zh: 开封沦陷后，日军第14师团于6月9日攻占中牟，进逼郑州；同日国民政府扒开花园口黄河大堤，以水代兵阻止日军西进。中牟失守是花园口决堤的直接背景之一。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《河南的抗战历程》。
description.en: After Kaifeng fell, the Japanese 14th Division captured Zhongmou on 9 June 1938 and closed on Zhengzhou. On the same day the Chinese government breached the Yellow River levee at Huayuankou to stop the Japanese advance. The fall of Zhongmou was one of the immediate circumstances behind the breach. Both cited accounts give 9 June.

summary.zh: 1938年9月6日，日军第10师团濑谷支队占领固始。
summary.en: On 6 September 1938 the Segu detachment of the Japanese 10th Division occupied Gushi.

description.zh: 武汉会战期间，日军第10师团濑谷支队自安徽叶家集北犯，9月6日晨与第59军激战，当夜占领固始。固始失守后，日军主力沿固潢公路西犯潢川。固始城陷日期，《1938年河南历史大事记》与潢川新闻网均记9月6日；《河南的抗战历程》把固始列入10月12日一并攻克，与逐日记载不符，正文并列。
description.en: During the Wuhan campaign the Segu detachment of the Japanese 10th Division advanced north from Yejiaji in Anhui, fought the 59th Corps on the morning of 6 September 1938 and occupied Gushi that night. The main force then drove west along the Gushi–Huangchuan road. The 1938 Henan chronology and the Huangchuan county history both give 6 September; the Henan campaign history groups Gushi with the 12 October captures, which conflicts with the daily record.

sources.title: 1938年河南历史大事记
sources.author: 中国历史网—追学网，抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-30 转载

sources.title: 红色潢川｜抗战中的潢川
sources.author: 潢川新闻网

summary.zh: 1938年9月18日，日军第10师团攻陷潢川。
summary.en: On 18 September 1938 the Japanese 10th Division captured Huangchuan.

description.zh: 1938年9月6日固始失守后，日军第10师团于7日西犯潢川。第五战区第27军团军团长兼第59军军长张自忠亲临阵地，指挥第38师阻击日军，巷战肉搏、迭行逆袭，日军伤亡惨重，但第59军伤亡亦重，18日潢川陷落。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与潢川新闻网（记9月7日西犯）。
description.en: After Gushi fell on 6 September 1938 the Japanese 10th Division attacked Huangchuan on the 7th. Zhang Zizhong, commander of the 27th Army and the 59th Corps, directed the 38th Division in street fighting and counterattacks, inflicting heavy losses, but the 59th Corps was also badly mauled and Huangchuan fell on the 18th. The 1938 Henan chronology gives the fall; the Huangchuan county history gives the start of the attack on 7 September.

summary.zh: 1938年9月20日，日军第10师团占领光山。
summary.en: On 20 September 1938 the Japanese 10th Division occupied Guangshan.

description.zh: 1938年9月18日潢川失守后，日军第10师团继续西犯，20日光山失守。光山位于潢川与罗山之间，失守后日军打开了沿信潢公路西进信阳的通道。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》；《河南的抗战历程》把光山列入10月12日一并攻克，正文并列。
description.en: After Huangchuan fell on 18 September 1938 the Japanese 10th Division pushed west and took Guangshan on the 20th. Lying between Huangchuan and Luoshan, Guangshan opened the way along the Xinyang–Huangchuan road toward Xinyang. The 1938 Henan chronology gives 20 September; the Henan campaign history groups Guangshan with the 12 October captures.

summary.zh: 1938年9月22日，日军第10师团占领罗山。
summary.en: On 22 September 1938 the Japanese 10th Division occupied Luoshan.

description.zh: 1938年9月22日，日军第10师团由潢川西犯罗山，经竹竿铺一战占领罗山。罗山是信阳以东最后一座县城，失守后日军直逼信阳。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》；《河南的抗战历程》把罗山列入10月12日一并攻克，正文并列。
description.en: On 22 September 1938 the Japanese 10th Division advanced west from Huangchuan and took Luoshan after the fight at Zhuganpu. Luoshan was the last county town east of Xinyang; its fall brought the Japanese to the gates of Xinyang. The 1938 Henan chronology gives 22 September; the Henan campaign history groups Luoshan with the 12 October captures.

sources.author: 中国历史网—追学网，抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-30 转载

summary.zh: 1938年10月12日，日军第3、第10师团攻占信阳。
summary.en: On 12 October 1938 the Japanese 3rd and 10th Divisions captured Xinyang.

description.zh: 1938年10月2日，日军第3、第10师团合攻信阳；11日胡宗南、孙连仲两部在柳林镇附近夹击日军第10师团，歼敌2000余人；12日胡宗南部因伤亡甚重放弃信阳。信阳失守后，日军完全控制豫南，与豫东、皖西连成一片，形成合围武汉之势。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《河南的抗战历程》。
description.en: On 2 October 1938 the Japanese 3rd and 10th Divisions attacked Xinyang. On the 11th Hu Zongnan and Sun Lianzhong’s forces ambushed the 10th Division near Liulin, killing more than 2,000, but on the 12th Hu’s badly mauled troops abandoned Xinyang. Its fall gave the Japanese full control of southern Henan and linked them with eastern Henan and western Anhui in the encirclement of Wuhan.

sources.title: 1938年河南历史大事记
sources.author: 中国历史网—追学网，抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-30 转载

sources.title: 河南的抗战历程
