summary.zh: 1941年1月26日，日军第11军攻占确山。
summary.en: On 26 January 1941 the Japanese 11th Army captured Queshan.

description.zh: 1941年1月，日军第11军为打通平汉铁路南段、解除中国军队对信阳日军的威胁，发动豫南会战。日军快速出击，26日攻占确山、邢店、高邑、泌阳一线，27日推进至驻马店、汝南、沙河店、龙王庙一线。日期据维基百科《豫南会战》与央视《抗战史上的今天》。
description.en: In January 1941 the Japanese 11th Army launched the Southern Henan campaign to open the southern Beiping–Hankou railway and remove the threat to its Xinyang garrison. Attacking rapidly, it took the Queshan–Xingdian–Gaoyi–Biyang line on the 26th and reached the Zhumadian–Runan–Shahedian–Longwangmiao line on the 27th.

sources.title: 抗战史上的今天：1941年1月24日豫南会战开始
sources.author: 央视新闻/新浪 2015-01-24

summary.zh: 1941年1月27日，日军第11军推进至驻马店。
summary.en: On 27 January 1941 the Japanese 11th Army advanced into Zhumadian.

description.zh: 1941年1月27日，日军第11军各路分别进至泌阳、高邑、确山、邢店、沙河店、驻马店和汝南等地。驻马店时为确山县辖镇，是平汉铁路南段重镇。日期据维基百科《豫南会战》与央视《抗战史上的今天》。
description.en: On 27 January 1941 the Japanese 11th Army’s columns reached Biyang, Gaoyi, Queshan, Xingdian, Shahedian, Zhumadian and Runan. Zhumadian was then a town under Queshan county and a key point on the southern Beiping–Hankou railway.

sources.title: 抗战史上的今天：1941年1月24日豫南会战开始
sources.author: 央视新闻/新浪 2015-01-24

summary.zh: 1941年1月26日，日军第11军攻占泌阳。
summary.en: On 26 January 1941 the Japanese 11th Army captured Biyang.

description.zh: 1941年1月26日，豫南会战中路日军攻陷确山，右翼攻陷正阳，左翼攻陷泌阳。中国第31集团军以第85军由临泉驰援，在泌阳、舞阳间侧击日军。日期据维基百科《豫南会战》与央视《抗战史上的今天》。
description.en: On 26 January 1941 the Japanese centre took Queshan, the right wing Zhengyang and the left wing Biyang. The Chinese 31st Group Army rushed the 85th Corps from Linquan and struck the Japanese flank between Biyang and Wuyang.

sources.title: 抗战史上的今天：1941年1月24日豫南会战开始
sources.author: 央视新闻/新浪 2015-01-24

summary.zh: 1944年4月18日，日军第37师团在中牟强渡新黄河，豫中会战爆发。
summary.en: On 18 April 1944 the Japanese 37th Division forced the New Yellow River at Zhongmou, opening the Central Henan campaign.

description.zh: 1944年4月17日夜至18日凌晨，日军第37师团配属独立混成第7旅团在中牟县强渡新黄河，突破暂编第15军阵地，中牟随即失守，豫中会战爆发。日军随后在郑州、新郑、尉氏、洧川等地与第28集团军激战。日期据《豫中会战经过》与《河南的抗战历程》。
description.en: On the night of 17–18 April 1944 the Japanese 37th Division with the 7th Independent Mixed Brigade crossed the New Yellow River at Zhongmou, broke the Provisional 15th Corps and took the town, opening the Central Henan campaign. The Japanese then fought the 28th Group Army at Zhengzhou, Xinzheng, Weishi and Weichuan.

sources.title: 河南的抗战历程
sources.author: 铁血网，抗日战争纪念网 2017-10-17 转载

summary.zh: 1944年4月23日，日军占领新郑。
summary.en: On 23 April 1944 the Japanese occupied Xinzheng.

description.zh: 1944年4月23日，日军占领郑州、新郑、广武、尉氏、洧川、鄢陵、密县等县，随后沿平汉铁路南犯，24日占领长葛。《豫中会战经过》则记4月21日新郑、尉氏被日军攻陷，正文并列。日期取《河南的抗战历程》与《重读抗战·河南》。
description.en: On 23 April 1944 the Japanese occupied Zhengzhou, Xinzheng, Guangwu, Weishi, Weichuan, Yanling and Mi counties, then advanced south along the Beiping–Hankou railway and took Changge on the 24th. The campaign narrative gives 21 April for Xinzheng and Weishi; that variant is noted in the text.

sources.title: 河南的抗战历程
sources.author: 铁血网，抗日战争纪念网 2017-10-17 转载

summary.zh: 1944年4月24日，日军占领长葛。
summary.en: On 24 April 1944 the Japanese occupied Changge.

description.zh: 1944年4月23日日军占领郑州、新郑等地后沿平汉铁路南犯，24日占领长葛。长葛失守后，日军直逼许昌。日期据《河南的抗战历程》与漯河日报《重温郾城受降历史》，两源一致。
description.en: After taking Zhengzhou and Xinzheng on 23 April 1944 the Japanese advanced south along the Beiping–Hankou railway and occupied Changge on the 24th, closing on Xuchang. Both cited accounts give 24 April.

sources.title: 河南的抗战历程
sources.author: 铁血网，抗日战争纪念网 2017-10-17 转载

summary.zh: 1944年5月2日，日军攻陷临颍。
summary.en: On 2 May 1944 the Japanese captured Linying.

description.zh: 1944年5月1日许昌陷落后，日军一部沿平汉铁路南下。5月2日日军攻陷临颍县城，随后进攻郾城、漯河。日期据漯河日报《重温郾城受降历史》与《漯河保卫战》。
description.en: After Xuchang fell on 1 May 1944 part of the Japanese force drove south along the Beiping–Hankou railway. Linying fell on the 2nd, after which the Japanese attacked Yancheng and Luohe. Both cited accounts give 2 May.

summary.zh: 1944年5月5日，日军攻陷郾城、漯河。
summary.en: On 5 May 1944 the Japanese captured Yancheng and Luohe.

description.zh: 1944年5月5日，日军攻破五里庙，沙河北岸中国军队阵地崩溃，南撤部队遭日军南北夹击。下午1时日军侵占郾城、突入漯河，守军顾锡九部突围，漯河陷落。漯河时为郾城县辖镇，是平汉铁路南段重镇。日期据《漯河保卫战》与漯河日报。
description.en: On 5 May 1944 the Japanese broke the Wulimiao position and the Chinese line north of the Sha River collapsed, with the withdrawing troops caught in a double envelopment. At 1 p.m. the Japanese took Yancheng and entered Luohe; Gu Xijiu’s force broke out and the town fell. Luohe was then a town under Yancheng county and a key point on the southern Beiping–Hankou railway.

summary.zh: 1944年5月8日，南北两路日军夹击攻占西平，打通平汉线南段。
summary.en: On 8 May 1944 Japanese columns from north and south converged on Xiping, opening the southern Beiping–Hankou railway.

description.zh: 1944年5月8日，沿平汉铁路南下的日军与自信阳北上的日军第11军宫下旅团南北夹击，攻占西平，打通河南境内平汉线。西平失守后，日军集中主力进攻洛阳。日期据《豫中会战经过》《洛阳保卫战》与《民国百年》。
description.en: On 8 May 1944 the Japanese force advancing south along the Beiping–Hankou railway and the Miyashita brigade of the 11th Army moving north from Xinyang converged on Xiping, opening the line through Henan. The Japanese then concentrated on Luoyang.

sources.title: 民国百年（六）：对日作战的艰苦八年（18）——1944年的大失败
sources.author: 战史整理

summary.zh: 1944年5月3日，日军第62师团攻占禹县。
summary.en: On 3 May 1944 the Japanese 62nd Division captured Yu County (Yuzhou).

description.zh: 1944年5月3日，日军第62师团向禹县发动攻击，击溃守军第29军，禹县、郏县同日沦入敌手。禹县失守后，部分守军退入禹西山区，日军自5月4日起在文殊、方山、神垕、大雄山等地围剿。日期据《中华民族抗日编年（1944年5月）》与《抗日战争中的平顶山》。
description.en: On 3 May 1944 the Japanese 62nd Division attacked Yu County, routed the 29th Corps and took both Yu County and Jiaxian the same day. Part of the Chinese force withdrew into the western hills, where the Japanese hunted them from 4 May around Wenshu, Fangshan, Shenhou and Daxiongshan.

sources.title: 中华民族抗日编年（1944年5月）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网

summary.zh: 1944年5月3日，日军第62师团攻占郏县。
summary.en: On 3 May 1944 the Japanese 62nd Division captured Jiaxian.

description.zh: 1944年5月3日，日军第62师团在攻占禹县的同时攻占郏县。5月1日至4日，许昌、临颍、郏县、禹县、临汝相继失守。日期据《中华民族抗日编年（1944年5月）》与《豫中会战经过》。
description.en: On 3 May 1944 the Japanese 62nd Division took Jiaxian together with Yu County. Between 1 and 4 May Xuchang, Linying, Jiaxian, Yu County and Linru fell in succession. Both cited accounts support the date.

sources.title: 中华民族抗日编年（1944年5月）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网

summary.zh: 1944年5月4日，日军攻占临汝。
summary.en: On 4 May 1944 the Japanese captured Linru.

description.zh: 1944年5月1日至4日，许昌、临颍、郏县、禹县、临汝相继失守。日军战车第3师团向西迂回，席卷襄城、郏县、临汝，一部快速逼近洛阳外围龙门。日期据《豫中会战经过》与《河南的抗战历程》。
description.en: Between 1 and 4 May 1944 Xuchang, Linying, Jiaxian, Yu County and Linru fell in succession. The Japanese 3rd Tank Division swept west through Xiangcheng, Jiaxian and Linru, with part of it driving quickly toward the Longmen approaches to Luoyang.

sources.title: 河南的抗战历程
sources.author: 铁血网，抗日战争纪念网 2017-10-17 转载

summary.zh: 1944年5月6日，日军攻占登封。
summary.en: On 6 May 1944 the Japanese captured Dengfeng.

description.zh: 至1944年5月6日，日军先后攻占许昌、登封、禹县、郏县、襄城、临汝、宝丰、鲁山等地，一部直抵洛阳龙门附近。登封失守后，日军从东南方向逼近洛阳。日期据《豫中会战经过》与《河南的抗战历程》。
description.en: By 6 May 1944 the Japanese had taken Xuchang, Dengfeng, Yu County, Jiaxian, Xiangcheng, Linru, Baofeng and Lushan, with part of their force reaching the vicinity of Longmen. The fall of Dengfeng brought the Japanese toward Luoyang from the southeast.

sources.title: 河南的抗战历程
sources.author: 铁血网，抗日战争纪念网 2017-10-17 转载

summary.zh: 1944年5月7日，日军占领鲁山。
summary.en: On 7 May 1944 the Japanese occupied Lushan.

description.zh: 1944年5月7日，日军占领鲁山，随后占领第一战区储备基地下汤。鲁山时为河南省政府驻地之一，失守后省政府迁至内乡丹水镇。日期据《抗日战争中的平顶山》与《豫中会战经过》；后者记5月6日，正文并列。
description.en: On 7 May 1944 the Japanese occupied Lushan and then the First War Zone supply base at Xiatang. Lushan was then one of the seats of the Henan provincial government, which moved to Danshui in Neixiang after its fall. The Pingdingshan history gives 7 May; the campaign narrative gives 6 May.

summary.zh: 1944年5月9日，日军“菊兵团”攻占巩县。
summary.en: On 9 May 1944 the Japanese Kiku detachment captured Gong County (Gongyi).

description.zh: 1944年5月9日，自郑州沿陇海铁路西犯的日军“菊兵团”攻占巩县，11日占领偃师，迫近洛阳城东。巩县失守后，日军完成对洛阳东西两面的合围。日期据《河南的抗战历程》与《豫中会战经过》。
description.en: On 9 May 1944 the Japanese Kiku detachment, advancing west from Zhengzhou along the Longhai railway, took Gong County and on the 11th Yanshi, closing on Luoyang from the east. The fall of Gong County completed the Japanese encirclement of Luoyang from east and west.

sources.title: 河南的抗战历程
sources.author: 铁血网，抗日战争纪念网 2017-10-17 转载

summary.zh: 1944年5月12日，日军第69师团攻陷渑池。
summary.en: On 12 May 1944 the Japanese 69th Division captured Mianchi.

description.zh: 1944年5月9日，驻晋南垣曲的日军第69师团主力强渡黄河，向渑池进攻；12日攻陷渑池、新安，直逼洛阳城西。渑池附近第36集团军西移卢氏附近，洛阳守军陷于孤军苦战。日期据《河南的抗战历程》与《豫中会战经过》；后者记9日渡河、13日各路会合。
description.en: On 9 May 1944 the main force of the Japanese 69th Division crossed the Yellow River from Yuanqu in southern Shanxi and attacked Mianchi, taking Mianchi and Xin’an on the 12th and closing on Luoyang from the west. The Chinese 36th Group Army near Mianchi withdrew toward Lushi, leaving Luoyang isolated. The campaign narrative gives 9 May for the crossing and 13 May for the junction of columns.

sources.title: 河南的抗战历程
sources.author: 铁血网，抗日战争纪念网 2017-10-17 转载

summary.zh: 1944年5月12日，日军第69师团攻陷新安。
summary.en: On 12 May 1944 the Japanese 69th Division captured Xin’an.

description.zh: 1944年5月12日，日军第69师团在攻陷渑池的同时攻陷新安，进抵洛阳以西。新安失守后，陇海铁路洛阳至潼关段被日军控制，第一战区主力向西转移。日期据《河南的抗战历程》与《豫中会战经过》。
description.en: On 12 May 1944 the Japanese 69th Division took Xin’an together with Mianchi and reached the approaches west of Luoyang. With Xin’an lost the Japanese controlled the Longhai railway from Luoyang toward Tongguan, and the First War Zone’s main force shifted west.

sources.title: 河南的抗战历程
sources.author: 铁血网，抗日战争纪念网 2017-10-17 转载

summary.zh: 1945年4月1日，日军攻占南阳。
summary.en: On 1 April 1945 the Japanese captured Nanyang.

description.zh: 1945年3月22日，日军发动豫西鄂北战役，开始进袭南阳。4月1日南阳失守。日军第110师团、战车第3师团等部随后西进，攻击西峡口、淅川。日期据《河南的抗战历程》《豫西鄂北会战》与《抗战最伟大的省——河南》。
description.en: On 22 March 1945 the Japanese launched the Western Henan–Northern Hubei campaign and attacked Nanyang, which fell on 1 April. The Japanese 110th Division and 3rd Tank Division then drove west against Xixiakou and Xichuan. The cited accounts agree on 1 April.

sources.title: 河南的抗战历程
sources.author: 铁血网，抗日战争纪念网 2017-10-17 转载

summary.zh: 1945年3月30日，日军攻占西峡口。
summary.en: On 30 March 1945 the Japanese captured Xixiakou.

description.zh: 1945年3月30日拂晓，日军第110师团、战车第3师团等部向西峡口进犯，西峡口当日沦陷。中国守军退守重阳店，至4月7日击退日军进攻，歼敌四千余人。日期据《豫西鄂北会战》与光明网《西峡口之战》。
description.en: At dawn on 30 March 1945 the Japanese 110th Division and 3rd Tank Division attacked Xixiakou, which fell the same day. The Chinese defenders withdrew to Chongyangdian and by 7 April had beaten off the Japanese attack, killing more than 4,000. Both cited accounts give 30 March.

sources.title: 西峡口之战，日寇的妄想彻底破灭了
sources.author: 光明网 2026-01-26

summary.zh: 1945年4月1日，日军攻占淅川（老城）。
summary.en: On 1 April 1945 the Japanese captured Xichuan (Laocheng).

description.zh: 1945年3月30日西峡口失守后，日军第110师团继续西进，4月1日陷淅川（今老城镇），即向重阳店方向攻击。另有记载称淅川在1945年2月沦陷，为河南最后沦陷的县城，日期待考，正文并列。日期取《豫西鄂北会战》。
description.en: After Xixiakou fell on 30 March 1945 the Japanese 110th Division drove west and took Xichuan (modern Laocheng) on 1 April, then attacked toward Chongyangdian. Another account places the fall in February 1945 and calls Xichuan the last Henan county to fall; that variant remains unresolved and is noted here. The date follows the Western Henan–Northern Hubei campaign history.

sources.title: 河南的抗战历程
sources.author: 铁血网，抗日战争纪念网 2017-10-17 转载

summary.zh: 1945年9月22日，第一战区在郑州接受日军第12军投降。
summary.en: On 22 September 1945 the Chinese First War Zone accepted the surrender of the Japanese 12th Army at Zhengzhou.

description.zh: 1945年9月22日，第一战区在郑州前进指挥所举行受降仪式，由战区参谋长李昆岗主持，日军第12军司令官鹰森孝向胡宗南部投降，在郑州投降日军43334人。郑州受降区原定洛阳，后因日军第12军军部驻郑州而改在郑州。受降事件不绘制进攻路线。日期据《日军郑州投降纪实》与《重读抗战·河南》。
description.en: On 22 September 1945 the First War Zone held a surrender ceremony at its Zhengzhou advance headquarters, presided over by Chief of Staff Li Kungang; Lt. Gen. Takamori of the Japanese 12th Army surrendered to Hu Zongnan’s forces, with 43,334 Japanese troops laying down arms at Zhengzhou. The surrender site had originally been Luoyang but was moved to Zhengzhou because the 12th Army headquarters was there. No advance route is drawn for a surrender event.

sources.title: 重读抗战·抗战最伟大的省：河南
sources.author: 凤凰网 2016-05-13

summary.zh: 1945年9月20日，第五战区在郾城（漯河）接受日军投降。
summary.en: On 20 September 1945 the Chinese Fifth War Zone accepted the Japanese surrender at Yancheng (Luohe).

description.zh: 1945年9月20日，第五战区在郾城（漯河）山西会馆举行受降仪式，司令长官刘峙主持，日军第12军司令官鹰森孝在投降书上签字，在郾城投降日军31560人。漯河为全国16个受降区之一。受降事件不绘制进攻路线。日期据《日军郑州投降纪实》与《受降亭》。
description.en: On 20 September 1945 the Fifth War Zone held a surrender ceremony at the Shanxi Guild Hall in Yancheng (Luohe), presided over by commander Liu Zhi; Lt. Gen. Takamori of the Japanese 12th Army signed the instrument of surrender, and 31,560 Japanese troops surrendered at Yancheng. Luohe was one of the sixteen surrender zones in China. No advance route is drawn for a surrender event.

sources.title: 受降亭
sources.author: 维基百科；漯河中州抗战纪念馆

name.zh: 察哈尔派遣兵团设司令部于多伦

summary.zh: 1937年8月17日，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团在多伦设立战斗司令部，东条英机任司令官。
summary.en: On 17 August 1937 the Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar Detachment established its battle headquarters at Dolon under Lt. Gen. Tojo Hideki.

description.zh: 1937年8月9日日本参谋本部决定察哈尔作战，8月14日关东军编成察哈尔派遣兵团，以东条英机中将为司令官；17日在多伦设立战斗司令部，19日移至张北。兵团下辖独立混成第1、第2旅团、混成第15旅团及堤支队、大泉支队等部，自多伦、沽源、张北一线向张家口进攻。该事件为指挥机构设立，不绘制进攻路线。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与维基百科《察哈尔派遣兵团》。
description.en: On 9 August 1937 the Japanese General Staff decided on the Chahar operation. The Kwantung Army formed the Chahar Detachment on 14 August under Lt. Gen. Tojo Hideki, and on the 17th established its battle headquarters at Dolon, moving to Zhangbei on the 19th. The force comprised the 1st and 2nd Independent Mixed Brigades, the 15th Mixed Brigade, and the Tsutsumi and Oizumi detachments, advancing on Zhangjiakou from Dolon, Guyuan and Zhangbei. No advance route is drawn for a headquarters event.

sources.title: 1937察哈尔战役日方档案资料（《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2018-11-15

summary.zh: 1937年8月20日，日军混成第2旅团自张北出击，突破长城线。
summary.en: On 20 August 1937 the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade sortied from Zhangbei and broke the Great Wall line.

description.zh: 1937年8月，中国第29军第143师曾于8月20日攻占张北城外围玻璃彩村等要点，但日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团主力已集结张北。20日夜，日军混成第2旅团自张北二台出发，突破长城防御，占领神威台；中国军队于21日夜退守神威台，23日午夜神威台失陷。张北自1935年《秦土协定》后已为日军控制，本事件记日军自张北出击，不记“张北沦陷”。日期据《南口战役》与《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿。
description.en: In August 1937 the Chinese 143rd Division briefly took the glass-factory village outside Zhangbei on the 20th, but the Japanese Chahar Detachment had already concentrated at Zhangbei. On the night of the 20th the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade advanced from Er’tai, broke the Great Wall line and took Shenweitei; the Chinese fell back on the night of the 21st, and Shenweitei fell at midnight on the 23rd. Zhangbei had been under Japanese control since the 1935 Qin-Doihara agreement, so this entry records the Japanese sortie from Zhangbei, not a “fall of Zhangbei.”

sources.title: 1937察哈尔战役日方档案资料（《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2018-11-15

summary.zh: 1937年8月24日，日军混成第2旅团攻占万全。
summary.en: On 24 August 1937 the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade captured Wanquan.

description.zh: 1937年8月22日，日军混成第2旅团进攻旧万全，中国第143师抵抗后于23日退守张家口西南、平绥线上的孔家庄一线。24日晨，日军攻占万全县城，随即以步兵一联队、炮兵一营沿公路直趋张家口。日期据《张家口政协·烽火年代》与《南口战役》，两源一致。
description.en: On 22 August 1937 the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade attacked old Wanquan; the Chinese 143rd Division resisted and on the 23rd fell back on the Kongjiazhuang high ground southwest of Zhangjiakou. At dawn on the 24th the Japanese took Wanquan and pushed an infantry regiment and artillery battalion down the road toward Zhangjiakou. Both cited accounts give 24 August.

summary.zh: 1937年8月26日，日军大泉支队自沽源南进，占领独石口以西三间房。
summary.en: On 26 August 1937 the Japanese Oizumi detachment advanced south from Guyuan and took Sanjianfang west of Dushikou.

description.zh: 1937年8月13日，日军大泉支队抵达沽源，随后沿独石口、赤城、龙关一线南进，企图抢占宣化、截断平绥铁路。中国第17军高桂滋部在宁强堡—赤城—龙关一线防御，未能阻止日军。8月26日，大泉支队占领独石口以西之三间房。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与澎湃《卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？》。
description.en: The Japanese Oizumi detachment reached Guyuan on 13 August 1937 and advanced south through Dushikou, Chicheng and Longguan to seize Xuanhua and cut the Beiping–Suiyuan railway. Gao Guizi’s 17th Corps defended the Ningqiangpu–Chicheng–Longguan line but could not stop it. On 26 August the detachment took Sanjianfang west of Dushikou.

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第三编第十一章第四节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-18

sources.author: 澎湃/方志河北 2021-07-07

summary.zh: 1937年8月27日，日军第5师团占领怀来。
summary.en: On 27 August 1937 the Japanese 5th Division occupied Huailai.

description.zh: 1937年8月25日南口失守后，中国守军于26日退守怀来；日军第5师团与独立混成第11旅团分两路追击，26日占领怀来、27日占领延庆（一说27日占怀来）。怀来失守后，平绥铁路东段被日军打通。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与澎湃《卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？》；后者记27日怀来失陷。
description.en: After Nankou fell on 25 August 1937 the Chinese withdrew to Huailai on the 26th. The Japanese 5th Division and 11th Independent Mixed Brigade pursued in two columns, taking Huailai and Yanqing on 26–27 August (one account gives 27 August for Huailai). The fall of Huailai opened the eastern Beiping–Suiyuan railway.

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第三编第十一章第四节

sources.title: 卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？
sources.author: 澎湃/方志河北 2021-07-07

summary.zh: 1937年8月27日，日军独立混成第11旅团占领延庆。
summary.en: On 27 August 1937 the Japanese 11th Independent Mixed Brigade occupied Yanqing.

description.zh: 1937年8月27日，日军独立混成第11旅团在占领居庸关后进攻延庆，当日占领延庆；中国第17军高桂滋部在延庆与日军激战后向桑干河右岸撤退。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿，两源一致。
description.en: On 27 August 1937 the Japanese 11th Independent Mixed Brigade, after taking Juyongguan, attacked and occupied Yanqing. Gao Guizi’s 17th Corps fought at Yanqing and then withdrew to the south bank of the Sanggan River. Both cited accounts give 27 August.

summary.zh: 1937年8月27日，日军大泉支队攻占赤城。
summary.en: On 27 August 1937 the Japanese Oizumi detachment captured Chicheng.

description.zh: 1937年8月，日军大泉支队自沽源经独石口南下，连陷龙关、赤城，企图抢占宣化。8月27日攻占赤城，28日攻占宣化。赤城失守后，中国第17军高桂滋部向桑干河右岸撤退。日期据澎湃《卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？》与《张家口政协·烽火年代》。
description.en: In August 1937 the Japanese Oizumi detachment advanced south from Guyuan through Dushikou, took Longguan and Chicheng, and drove on Xuanhua. Chicheng fell on 27 August and Xuanhua on the 28th. Gao Guizi’s 17th Corps then withdrew to the south bank of the Sanggan River.

sources.title: 卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？
sources.author: 澎湃/方志河北 2021-07-07

summary.zh: 1937年8月28日，日军攻占宣化。
summary.en: On 28 August 1937 the Japanese captured Xuanhua.

description.zh: 1937年8月27日张家口失陷后，日军大泉支队自赤城、龙关方向南下，28日攻占宣化，与由张家口东进的混成第2旅会合；29日日军第5师亦进至宣化。宣化失守后，日军控制张家口以南整个平绥路东段。日期据澎湃《卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？》与《南口战役》；《中国抗日战争全史》记27日占宣化，正文并列。
description.en: After Zhangjiakou fell on 27 August 1937, the Japanese Oizumi detachment came south from Chicheng and Longguan and took Xuanhua on the 28th, joining the 2nd Mixed Brigade advancing east from Zhangjiakou; the 5th Division reached Xuanhua on the 29th. The Japanese thus controlled the entire eastern Beiping–Suiyuan railway south of Zhangjiakou. The campaign history gives 27 August; that variant is noted.

sources.title: 卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？
sources.author: 澎湃/方志河北 2021-07-07

summary.zh: 1937年8月29日，日军独立混成第1旅团占领柴沟堡。
summary.en: On 29 August 1937 the Japanese 1st Independent Mixed Brigade occupied Chaigoubu.

description.zh: 1937年8月29日，日军独立混成第1旅团占领张家口以西的柴沟堡，切断平绥铁路西段；中国第2战区防守平绥路的部队分头向天镇、蔚县方向撤退。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿；中国日报网《我所亲历的怀安两大惨案》记8月28日日军侵占柴沟堡，正文并列。
description.en: On 29 August 1937 the Japanese 1st Independent Mixed Brigade took Chaigoubu west of Zhangjiakou, cutting the western Beiping–Suiyuan railway; the Chinese Second War Zone forces withdrew toward Tianzhen and Yu County. The China Daily account gives 28 August for Chaigoubu; that variant is noted.

summary.zh: 1937年9月11日，日军第5师团骑兵第5联队占领蔚县。
summary.en: On 11 September 1937 the 5th Cavalry Regiment of the Japanese 5th Division occupied Yu County.

description.zh: 1937年9月6日，日军第5师团自宣化、新保安、怀来分三路南下，进攻蔚县；中国第68军刘汝明部未与日军接触即行后撤。9月11日，日军骑兵第5联队占领蔚县；随后第5师团经蔚县、广灵向灵丘方向进攻。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与《每日新闻社：日军侵华记录（八）》，两者均记9月11日。
description.en: On 6 September 1937 the Japanese 5th Division advanced south from Xuanhua, Xinbao’an and Huailai against Yu County; Liu Ruming’s 68th Corps withdrew without contact. On 11 September the 5th Cavalry Regiment occupied Yu County, and the 5th Division then moved through Yu County and Guangling toward Lingqiu. Both cited accounts give 11 September.

sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2018-11-15

sources.title: 每日新闻社：日军侵华记录（八）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2018-06-11

summary.zh: 1937年9月17日，日军独立步兵第11联队占领丰镇。
summary.en: On 17 September 1937 the Japanese 11th Independent Infantry Regiment occupied Fengzhen.

description.zh: 1937年9月13日日军占领大同后，独立步兵第11联队沿平绥路向北推进，17日占领丰镇。丰镇为大同以北的平绥线要地，失守后日军打开进攻集宁、归绥的通道。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与《中国抗日战争全史》；《内蒙古区情网》记9月23日占丰镇县城，正文并列。
description.en: After taking Datong on 13 September 1937, the Japanese 11th Independent Infantry Regiment advanced north along the Beiping–Suiyuan railway and took Fengzhen on the 17th. Fengzhen was the key railway town north of Datong; its fall opened the way to Jining and Guisui. The Inner Mongolia gazetteer gives 23 September for the county town; that variant is noted.

summary.zh: 1937年9月19日，日军河村支队占领兴和。
summary.en: On 19 September 1937 the Japanese Kawamura detachment occupied Xinghe.

description.zh: 1937年9月6日，日军独立混成第1旅团河村支队占领南壕堑，掩护兵团右侧；19日占领兴和，随后向凉城（宁远）方向推进，24日与自右玉方向进攻的松井支队会合，攻克隆城。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与《中国抗日战争全史》；《内蒙古区情网》记9月17日日军入侵兴和，正文并列。
description.en: On 6 September 1937 the Kawamura detachment of the Japanese 1st Independent Mixed Brigade took Nanhaojian to cover the army’s right flank; on the 19th it took Xinghe and advanced toward Liangcheng (Ningyuan), joining the Matsui detachment from Youyu on the 24th to capture the town. The Inner Mongolia gazetteer gives 17 September for the Japanese entry into Xinghe; that variant is noted.

sources.title: 1937察哈尔战役日方档案资料（《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿）

summary.zh: 1937年9月24日，日军占领集宁（平地泉）。
summary.en: On 24 September 1937 the Japanese occupied Jining (Pingdiquan).

description.zh: 1937年9月24日，日军独立步兵第11联队占领绥东重镇平地泉（今集宁）。集宁守备司令曾延毅临阵脱逃，守军崩溃。集宁失守后，日军打开西进归绥的门户。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与《中国抗日战争全史》；《内蒙古区情网》记9月27日占集宁，正文并列。
description.en: On 24 September 1937 the Japanese 11th Independent Infantry Regiment took Pingdiquan (modern Jining), the key town of eastern Suiyuan. The garrison commander Zeng Yanyi fled and the defence collapsed. The fall of Jining opened the way west to Guisui. The Inner Mongolia gazetteer gives 27 September; that variant is noted.

sources.title: 1937察哈尔战役日方档案资料（《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿）

summary.zh: 1937年9月24日，日军攻占凉城（宁远）。
summary.en: On 24 September 1937 the Japanese captured Liangcheng (Ningyuan).

description.zh: 1937年9月19日日军占领兴和后，河村支队向凉城（宁远）方向推进；24日与自右玉方向进攻的松井支队会合，攻克隆城。凉城失守后，日军从东南方向逼近归绥。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与《中国抗日战争全史》，两源一致。
description.en: After taking Xinghe on 19 September 1937, the Kawamura detachment advanced toward Liangcheng (Ningyuan); on the 24th it joined the Matsui detachment from Youyu and captured the town. The fall of Liangcheng brought the Japanese toward Guisui from the southeast. Both cited accounts give 24 September.

summary.zh: 1937年10月16日，日军占领萨拉齐县城，制造萨拉齐惨案。
summary.en: On 16 October 1937 the Japanese occupied Salaqi and carried out the Salaqi massacre.

description.zh: 1937年10月14日归绥失陷后，日军沿平包铁路西进，16日上午进犯萨拉齐县城，不到两小时内屠杀居民70人；同日又在公积板村杀害村民41人。17日日军占领包头。日期据《内蒙古区情网》、浙江在线《10月16日》与《日军进犯包头途中的两起大屠杀》，三源一致。
description.en: After Guisui fell on 14 October 1937 the Japanese advanced west along the Beiping–Baotou railway. On the morning of the 16th they entered Salaqi and killed 70 residents in less than two hours, then killed 41 villagers at Gongjiban; Baotou fell on the 17th. Three cited accounts agree on 16 October.

sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2018-04-18

summary.zh: 1938年7月26日，日军第3师团在小池口登陆，占领小池口。
summary.en: On 26 July 1938 the Japanese 3rd Division landed at and captured Xiaochikou.

description.zh: 1938年7月，日军第3师团在海军掩护下于小池口登陆，中国守军刘汝明部多次击退日军进攻，但阵地被飞机、舰炮炸毁，26日小池口失守。小池口失守后，日军打开沿长江北岸西进黄梅的通道。日期据《武汉会战概述》与《中国抗日战争全史》。
description.en: In July 1938 the Japanese 3rd Division landed at Xiaochikou under naval cover. Liu Ruming’s troops beat off several assaults, but the positions were destroyed by air and naval gunfire, and Xiaochikou fell on the 26th. Its loss opened the way west along the north bank of the Yangtze toward Huangmei.

sources.title: 武汉会战概述
sources.author: 湖北政协，抗日战争纪念网 2022-10-29

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第三编第十五章第一节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-20

summary.zh: 1938年8月2日，日军第6师团攻占黄梅县城。
summary.en: On 2 August 1938 the Japanese 6th Division captured Huangmei.

description.zh: 1938年8月2日，日军第6师团自小池口、宿松方向进攻黄梅，出动20余架飞机轰炸县城11次，当晚从北门攻入，黄梅县城失守。黄梅失守后，长江沿岸战事进入湖北境内。日期据《武汉会战概述》与人民网《武汉会战和广州作战》。
description.en: On 2 August 1938 the Japanese 6th Division attacked Huangmei from Xiaochikou and Susong, bombing the town eleven times with more than twenty aircraft and entering through the north gate that evening. Its fall brought the Yangtze campaign into Hubei proper.

sources.title: 武汉会战概述
sources.author: 湖北政协，抗日战争纪念网 2022-10-29

sources.title: 十、武汉会战和广州作战
sources.author: 人民网 2015-05-26

summary.zh: 1938年9月6日，日军第6师团攻占广济（梅川）。
summary.en: On 6 September 1938 the Japanese 6th Division captured Guangji (Meichuan).

description.zh: 1938年8月30日日军第6师团向广济进攻，9月6日突破田家寨、笔架山阵地，中国第4兵团当夜弃守广济（梅川）。《武汉会战概述》记9月17日广济、武穴相继沦陷，与逐日战史相差，正文并列。日期取《小界岭战役》与《中华民族抗日编年》9月6日。
description.en: On 30 August 1938 the Japanese 6th Division attacked Guangji; on 6 September it broke the Tianjiazhai and Bijiaoshan positions, and the Chinese 4th Army Group abandoned Guangji (Meichuan) that night. The Hubei campaign overview gives 17 September; that variant is noted.

sources.title: 武汉会战概述
sources.author: 湖北政协，抗日战争纪念网 2022-10-29

summary.zh: 1938年9月16日，日军第6师团、海军陆战队攻占武穴。
summary.en: On 16 September 1938 the Japanese 6th Division and naval landing troops captured Wuxue.

description.zh: 1938年9月16日日军第6师团、海军陆战队攻占武穴。武穴为长江北岸重要港口，失守后日军完成对田家镇要塞的合围。《武汉会战概述》记9月17日，正文并列。日期据《小界岭战役》与《中国抗日战争全史》。
description.en: On 16 September 1938 the Japanese 6th Division and naval landing troops took Wuxue, the key port on the north bank of the Yangtze. Its fall completed the encirclement of the Tianjiazhen fortress. The Hubei campaign overview gives 17 September; that variant is noted.

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第三编第十五章第一节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-20

summary.zh: 1938年9月24日，日军波田支队、第9师团攻占富池口。
summary.en: On 24 September 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment and 9th Division captured Fuchikou.

description.zh: 1938年9月15日起，日军波田支队与第9师团进攻富池口，中国第54军第18师顽强抵抗，日军施放毒气，24日富池口失守。富池口与田家镇夹江对峙，失守后武汉长江门户洞开。日期据《武汉会战概述》与《中国抗日战争全史》。
description.en: From 15 September 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment and 9th Division attacked Fuchikou. The Chinese 18th Division of the 54th Corps resisted stubbornly, but the Japanese used poison gas and took Fuchikou on the 24th. Fuchikou faced Tianjiazhen across the Yangtze; its loss opened the river gate to Wuhan.

sources.title: 武汉会战概述
sources.author: 湖北政协，抗日战争纪念网 2022-10-29

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第三编第十五章第一节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-20

summary.zh: 1938年9月29日，日军第6师团攻陷田家镇要塞。
summary.en: On 29 September 1938 the Japanese 6th Division captured the Tianjiazhen fortress.

description.zh: 1938年9月18日起，日军第6师团今村支队进攻田家镇要塞北区，中国第2军第57师等部死守，日军以飞机、重炮和毒气猛攻，29日田家镇中心阵地失守。田家镇为武汉东面门户，失守后长江沿岸战事迅速逼近武汉。日期据《武汉会战概述》与人民网。
description.en: From 18 September 1938 the Japanese 6th Division’s Imamura detachment attacked the northern sector of the Tianjiazhen fortress. The Chinese 57th Division and others held on under air, artillery and gas attack until the central position fell on the 29th. Tianjiazhen was the eastern gate of Wuhan, and its loss brought the campaign rapidly toward the city.

sources.title: 武汉会战概述
sources.author: 湖北政协，抗日战争纪念网 2022-10-29

sources.title: 十、武汉会战和广州作战
sources.author: 人民网 2015-05-26

summary.zh: 1938年10月4日，日军攻占半壁山，田家镇—富池口—半壁山要塞群全部陷落。
summary.en: On 4 October 1938 the Japanese captured Banbishan, completing the fall of the Tianjiazhen–Fuchikou–Banbishan fortress group.

description.zh: 田家镇失守后，日军第9师团进攻长江南岸半壁山。10月4日，日军以80余架飞机轰炸并强渡登陆，中国守军第193师第1124团几乎全部战死，半壁山失守。田家镇—富池口—半壁山要塞群全部陷落。日期据《武汉会战概述》与《中国抗日战争全史》。
description.en: After Tianjiazhen fell, the Japanese 9th Division attacked Banbishan on the south bank. On 4 October, after bombing with more than eighty aircraft, the Japanese landed and overran the position; the Chinese 1124th Regiment was almost wiped out. The Tianjiazhen–Fuchikou–Banbishan fortress group was now entirely lost.

sources.title: 武汉会战概述
sources.author: 湖北政协，抗日战争纪念网 2022-10-29

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第三编第十五章第一节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-20

summary.zh: 1938年10月8日，日军第6师团攻占蕲春（蕲州）。
summary.en: On 8 October 1938 the Japanese 6th Division captured Qichun (Qizhou).

description.zh: 1938年10月8日日军第6师团攻占蕲春（蕲州）。蕲春为田家镇以西沿江要地，失守后日军沿江西进浠水、黄冈。《武汉会战概述》记10月10日，正文并列。日期据《小界岭战役》与《武汉会战概述》。
description.en: On 8 October 1938 the Japanese 6th Division took Qichun (Qizhou), the riverside town west of Tianjiazhen. Its fall opened the advance west through Xishui and Huanggang. The Hubei campaign overview gives 10 October; that variant is noted.

sources.title: 武汉会战概述
sources.author: 湖北政协，抗日战争纪念网 2022-10-29

summary.zh: 1938年10月17日，日军第6师团攻占浠水县城。
summary.en: On 17 October 1938 the Japanese 6th Division captured Xishui.

description.zh: 1938年10月17日日军第6师团攻占浠水县城，随后向巴河、团风、黄陂推进。《武汉会战概述》记10月19/21日，正文并列。日期据《小界岭战役》与《武汉会战概述》。
description.en: On 17 October 1938 the Japanese 6th Division took Xishui and advanced toward Bahe, Tuanfeng and Huangpi. The Hubei campaign overview gives 19/21 October; that variant is noted.

sources.title: 武汉会战概述
sources.author: 湖北政协，抗日战争纪念网 2022-10-29

summary.zh: 1938年10月18日，日军波田支队攻占阳新。
summary.en: On 18 October 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment captured Yangxin.

description.zh: 1938年10月18日日军波田支队攻占阳新。阳新为鄂东南门户，失守后日军分兵北趋大冶、鄂城，西攻咸宁。《中国抗日战争全史》记10月22日阳新、大冶、鄂城相继失守，正文并列。日期据《武汉会战概述》与《中国抗日战争全史》。
description.en: On 18 October 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment took Yangxin, the gateway to southeastern Hubei. The Japanese then drove north toward Daye and Echeng and west toward Xianning. The campaign history gives 22 October for Yangxin, Daye and Echeng; that variant is noted.

sources.title: 武汉会战概述
sources.author: 湖北政协，抗日战争纪念网 2022-10-29

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第三编第十五章第一节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-20

summary.zh: 1938年10月19日，日军波田支队、第9师团攻占大冶。
summary.en: On 19 October 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment and 9th Division captured Daye.

description.zh: 1938年10月19日日军波田支队、第9师团攻占大冶。大冶铁矿为日军重要掠夺目标，失守后日军继续北趋鄂城、黄石港。《小界岭战役》记10月22日，正文并列。日期据《武汉会战概述》与《小界岭战役》。
description.en: On 19 October 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment and 9th Division took Daye, whose iron mines were an important Japanese prize. The Japanese then moved north toward Echeng and Huangshigang. The Xiaojieling account gives 22 October; that variant is noted.

sources.title: 武汉会战概述
sources.author: 湖北政协，抗日战争纪念网 2022-10-29

summary.zh: 1938年10月19日，日军波田支队、第9师团攻占鄂城。
summary.en: On 19 October 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment and 9th Division captured Echeng.

description.zh: 1938年10月19日日军波田支队、第9师团攻占鄂城（今鄂州）。鄂城为武昌东面屏障，失守后日军进抵葛店，逼近武昌。鄂州市档案记10月23日沦陷，正文并列。日期据《武汉会战概述》与鄂州市政府《1938年，不能忘却的鄂城记忆》。
description.en: On 19 October 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment and 9th Division took Echeng (modern Ezhou), the eastern shield of Wuchang. The Japanese then reached Gedian and closed on Wuchang. The Ezhou municipal archive gives 23 October; that variant is noted.

sources.title: 武汉会战概述
sources.author: 湖北政协，抗日战争纪念网 2022-10-29

summary.zh: 1938年10月20日，日军攻占黄石港。
summary.en: On 20 October 1938 the Japanese captured Huangshigang.

description.zh: 1938年10月20日日军攻占黄石港，沿江向西攻击。此前中国第82、第93师在西塞山、道士洑、石灰窑一线阻击13昼夜，伤亡4300余人。日期据《武汉会战概述》与黄石市文旅局《抗战中的黄石阻击战》。
description.en: On 20 October 1938 the Japanese took Huangshigang and pushed west along the river. The Chinese 82nd and 93rd Divisions had held the Xisaishan–Daoshifu–Shihuiyao line for thirteen days, suffering more than 4,300 casualties.

sources.title: 武汉会战概述
sources.author: 湖北政协，抗日战争纪念网 2022-10-29

summary.zh: 1938年10月23日，日军第6师团、第116师团攻占黄冈（黄州）。
summary.en: On 23 October 1938 the Japanese 6th and 116th Divisions captured Huanggang (Huangzhou).

description.zh: 1938年10月23日日军第6师团、第116师团攻占黄冈（黄州）。黄冈为鄂东行政中心，失守后日军沿黄陂—汉口公路西进。《武汉会战概述》记10月22日，正文并列。日期据《小界岭战役》与《武汉会战概述》。
description.en: On 23 October 1938 the Japanese 6th and 116th Divisions took Huanggang (Huangzhou), the administrative centre of eastern Hubei. The Japanese then advanced west along the Huangpi–Hankou road. The Hubei campaign overview gives 22 October; that variant is noted.

sources.title: 武汉会战概述
sources.author: 湖北政协，抗日战争纪念网 2022-10-29

summary.zh: 1938年10月23日，日军攻占团风。
summary.en: On 23 October 1938 the Japanese captured Tuanfeng.

description.zh: 1938年10月23日日军攻占团风。团风为长江北岸渡口，失守后日军进逼阳逻、黄陂。《武汉会战概述》记10月20日，正文并列。日期据《小界岭战役》与《武汉会战概述》。
description.en: On 23 October 1938 the Japanese took Tuanfeng, a ferry crossing on the north bank of the Yangtze, and closed on Yangluo and Huangpi. The Hubei campaign overview gives 20 October; that variant is noted.

sources.title: 武汉会战概述
sources.author: 湖北政协，抗日战争纪念网 2022-10-29

summary.zh: 1938年10月24日，日军第6师团攻占黄陂，直抵汉口东北郊。
summary.en: On 24 October 1938 the Japanese 6th Division captured Huangpi and reached the northeastern outskirts of Hankou.

description.zh: 1938年10月24日晚日军第6师团攻占黄陂，直抵汉口东北郊。黄陂失守后，武汉三镇已陷入东、北、南三面包围。日期据《武汉会战概述》与人民网《武汉会战和广州作战》。
description.en: On the night of 24 October 1938 the Japanese 6th Division took Huangpi and reached the northeastern outskirts of Hankou. With its fall Wuhan was encircled from east, north and south.

sources.title: 武汉会战概述
sources.author: 湖北政协，抗日战争纪念网 2022-10-29

sources.title: 十、武汉会战和广州作战
sources.author: 人民网 2015-05-26

summary.zh: 1938年10月25日，日军第13、第16师团越过大别山，攻占麻城。
summary.en: On 25 October 1938 the Japanese 13th and 16th Divisions crossed the Dabie Mountains and captured Macheng.

description.zh: 1938年10月25日日军第13、第16师团越过大别山，攻占麻城。麻城为鄂东北重镇，失守后日军沿宋埠、黄安、河口镇向武汉推进。《武汉会战概述》记10月24日，正文并列。日期据《小界岭战役》与《中国抗日战争全史》。
description.en: On 25 October 1938 the Japanese 13th and 16th Divisions crossed the Dabie Mountains and took Macheng, the key town of northeastern Hubei. The Japanese then advanced via Songbu, Huang’an and Hekou toward Wuhan. The Hubei campaign overview gives 24 October; that variant is noted.

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第三编第十五章第一节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-20

summary.zh: 1938年10月27日，日军第16师团攻占黄安（今红安）。
summary.en: On 27 October 1938 the Japanese 16th Division captured Huang’an (modern Hong’an).

description.zh: 1938年10月27日日军第16师团笠井骑兵部队攻占黄安（今红安）。黄安为鄂东北门户，失守后日军进逼河口镇、黄陂。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与《抗战史记·武汉会战（下）》。
description.en: On 27 October 1938 the Japanese 16th Division’s Kasai cavalry unit took Huang’an (modern Hong’an), the gateway to northeastern Hubei, and closed on Hekou and Huangpi. Both cited accounts give 27 October.

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第三编第十五章第一节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-20

sources.title: 抗战史记｜武汉会战（下）——战略大撤退
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2020-06-28

summary.zh: 1938年10月30日，日军第3、第10师团攻占应城。
summary.en: On 30 October 1938 the Japanese 3rd and 10th Divisions captured Yingcheng.

description.zh: 1938年10月30日日军第3、第10师团攻占应城。日军自应山、安陆、云梦、应城向汉阳、汉口迂回，应城失守后切断了中国第5战区向西撤退的通道。日期据《抗战史记·武汉会战（下）》与《中国抗日战争全史》。
description.en: On 30 October 1938 the Japanese 3rd and 10th Divisions took Yingcheng. Advancing via Yingshan, Anlu, Yunmeng and Yingcheng toward Hanyang and Hankou, the Japanese cut the Fifth War Zone’s westward withdrawal route.

sources.title: 抗战史记｜武汉会战（下）——战略大撤退
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2020-06-28

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第三编第十五章第一节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-20

summary.zh: 1938年10月29日，日军第27师团攻占咸宁县城。
summary.en: On 29 October 1938 the Japanese 27th Division captured Xianning.

description.zh: 1938年10月29日日军第27师团攻占咸宁县城。咸宁为粤汉铁路要地，失守后日军沿铁路南下崇阳、通城，切断粤汉线。日期据咸宁日报《不容抹杀的滔天罪行》与维基百科《咸宁市》。
description.en: On 29 October 1938 the Japanese 27th Division took Xianning, a key point on the Canton–Hankou railway. The Japanese then moved south through Chongyang and Tongcheng, cutting the railway. Both cited accounts give 29 October.

summary.zh: 1938年11月6日，日军第27师团攻占崇阳县城。
summary.en: On 6 November 1938 the Japanese 27th Division captured Chongyang.

description.zh: 1938年11月6日13时，日军第27师团宫崎部队攻占崇阳县城。崇阳为武汉通长沙的公路要地，失守后日军继续南犯通城、岳阳。日期据咸宁日报《不容抹杀的滔天罪行》与崇阳县史志研究中心。
description.en: At 1 p.m. on 6 November 1938 the Japanese 27th Division’s Miyazaki unit took Chongyang, a key point on the Wuhan–Changsha road. The Japanese then pushed south toward Tongcheng and Yueyang. Both cited accounts give 6 November.

sources.title: 全民族抗日战争爆发到崇阳沦陷时的斗争形势（四）
sources.author: 崇阳县史志研究中心 2025-07-21

summary.zh: 1939年5月8日，日军第3师团攻占随县。
summary.en: On 8 May 1939 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Suixian.

description.zh: 1939年5月1日日军第11军向随枣地区进攻，5月8日随县失守。随县为鄂北门户，失守后日军沿襄花公路北进枣阳。日期据随州市政府《不屈的土地 英雄的人民》与维基百科《随枣会战》。
description.en: On 1 May 1939 the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Suixian–Zaoyang area; Suixian fell on the 8th. The town was the gateway to northern Hubei, and its loss opened the advance north along the Xianghua road to Zaoyang.

sources.title: 不屈的土地 英雄的人民——随州大地抗日印记
sources.author: 随州市政府 2021-11-06

summary.zh: 1939年5月8日，日军第13、第16师团攻占枣阳。
summary.en: On 8 May 1939 the Japanese 13th and 16th Divisions captured Zaoyang.

description.zh: 1939年5月8日日军第13、第16师团攻占枣阳。中国第5战区随即转入外线反击，19日收复枣阳，23日收复随县。日期据随州市政府与维基百科《随枣会战》。
description.en: On 8 May 1939 the Japanese 13th and 16th Divisions took Zaoyang. The Chinese Fifth War Zone counterattacked from the exterior, recovering Zaoyang on the 19th and Suixian on the 23rd.

sources.title: 不屈的土地 英雄的人民——随州大地抗日印记
sources.author: 随州市政府 2021-11-06

summary.zh: 1940年6月1日，日军第3、第39师团攻占襄阳。
summary.en: On 1 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd and 39th Divisions captured Xiangyang.

description.zh: 1940年5月31日夜日军第3、第39师团强渡汉水，6月1日攻占襄阳。中国军队3日收复襄阳，日军遂南下进攻宜城、宜昌。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与央视《抗战老兵忆枣宜会战》。
description.en: On the night of 31 May 1940 the Japanese 3rd and 39th Divisions crossed the Han River and took Xiangyang on 1 June. The Chinese recovered the city on the 3rd, and the Japanese turned south toward Yicheng and Yichang.

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第四编第二十二章第三节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-22

summary.zh: 1940年6月3日，日军第3师团攻占南漳。
summary.en: On 3 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Nanzhang.

description.zh: 1940年6月3日日军第3师团攻占南漳。南漳为襄阳西南山地要地，失守后日军沿宜沙公路逼近宜昌。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与维基百科《枣宜会战》。
description.en: On 3 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd Division took Nanzhang, the mountain town southwest of Xiangyang, and then advanced along the Yichang–Shashi road toward Yichang.

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第四编第二十二章第三节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-22

summary.zh: 1940年6月3日，日军第39师团攻占宜城。
summary.en: On 3 June 1940 the Japanese 39th Division captured Yicheng.

description.zh: 1940年6月3日日军第39师团攻占宜城。宜城为汉水西岸要地，失守后日军第3、第39师团并列南下荆门、当阳。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与维基百科《枣宜会战》。
description.en: On 3 June 1940 the Japanese 39th Division took Yicheng on the west bank of the Han River; the 3rd and 39th Divisions then advanced south abreast toward Jingmen and Dangyang.

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第四编第二十二章第三节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-22

summary.zh: 1940年6月6日，日军第13师团、池田支队攻占荆门。
summary.en: On 6 June 1940 the Japanese 13th Division and Ikeda detachment captured Jingmen.

description.zh: 1940年6月6日日军第13师团、池田支队攻占荆门。此前日军从钟祥旧口、沙洋强渡汉水，荆门失守后与北线日军对当阳形成南北夹击。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与央视《抗战老兵忆枣宜会战》。
description.en: On 6 June 1940 the Japanese 13th Division and Ikeda detachment took Jingmen after crossing the Han River at Jiukou and Shayang. Its fall completed the north–south pincer against Dangyang.

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第四编第二十二章第三节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-22

summary.zh: 1940年6月8日，日军第13师团、池田支队攻占江陵（荆州），同日沙市沦陷。
summary.en: On 8 June 1940 the Japanese 13th Division and Ikeda detachment captured Jiangling (Jingzhou); Shashi fell the same day.

description.zh: 1940年6月8日日军第13师团、池田支队攻占江陵（荆州），同日沙市沦陷。江陵为长江中游重镇，失守后日军沿江西进宜昌。央视记6月7日江陵失守，正文并列。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与央视。
description.en: On 8 June 1940 the Japanese 13th Division and Ikeda detachment took Jiangling (Jingzhou), and Shashi fell the same day. Jiangling was the key city of the middle Yangtze; the Japanese then moved upriver toward Yichang. CCTV gives 7 June; that variant is noted.

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第四编第二十二章第三节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-22

summary.zh: 1940年6月9日，日军第3、第39师团攻占当阳。
summary.en: On 9 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd and 39th Divisions captured Dangyang.

description.zh: 1940年6月9日日军第3、第39师团攻占当阳。中国第18军第11师在当阳长坂坡一带顽强抵抗，终因两侧友军后撤而撤退。当阳失守后，宜昌门户洞开。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与央视。
description.en: On 9 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd and 39th Divisions took Dangyang. The Chinese 11th Division of the 18th Corps fought stubbornly around Changbanpo but withdrew when both flanks gave way. The fall of Dangyang opened the gate to Yichang.

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第四编第二十二章第三节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-22

summary.zh: 1943年5月14日，日军第3师团攻占公安。
summary.en: On 14 May 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Gong’an.

description.zh: 1943年5月12日日军第3师团进攻公安，中国第87军第43师弃守西撤，14日日军占领公安。公安失守后，日军第3、第13师团合围松滋、枝江间中国第10集团军。日期据《鄂西会战综述》与《鄂西会战纪实》。
description.en: On 12 May 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division attacked Gong’an; the Chinese 43rd Division of the 87th Corps abandoned it and withdrew west, and the Japanese occupied the town on the 14th. The Japanese 3rd and 13th Divisions then closed on the Chinese 10th Army Group between Songzi and Zhijiang.

summary.zh: 1943年5月18日，日军第3师团攻占松滋。
summary.en: On 18 May 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Songzi.

description.zh: 1943年5月18日拂晓，日军第3师团攻占松滋。松滋为鄂西山地入口，失守后日军西取渔洋关、长阳，威胁石牌。日期据《鄂西会战综述》与《鄂西会战纪实》。
description.en: At dawn on 18 May 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division took Songzi, the entrance to the western Hubei mountains. The Japanese then drove west toward Yuyangguan and Changyang, threatening Shipai.

summary.zh: 1943年5月22日，日军野沟支队与伪第29师攻占宜都。
summary.en: On 22 May 1943 the Japanese Nogawa detachment and the puppet 29th Division captured Yidu.

description.zh: 1943年5月22日，日军野沟支队与伪第29师攻占宜都。宜都为长江南岸要地，失守后日军第39师团从云池渡江，向宜昌西南的偏岩急进。日期据《鄂西会战综述》与《鄂西会战纪实》。
description.en: On 22 May 1943 the Japanese Nogawa detachment and the puppet 29th Division took Yidu, a key point on the south bank of the Yangtze. The Japanese 39th Division then crossed at Yunchi and drove on Pianyan southwest of Yichang.

summary.zh: 1943年5月24日，日军第3师团攻占长阳。
summary.en: On 24 May 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Changyang.

description.zh: 1943年5月24日中午，日军第3师团攻占长阳。长阳为清江要地，失守后日军第3、第13、第39师团向石牌、清江间中国江防军猛攻。日期据《鄂西会战综述》与《鄂西会战纪实》。
description.en: At noon on 24 May 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division took Changyang on the Qing River. The Japanese 3rd, 13th and 39th Divisions then attacked the Chinese river-defence forces between Shipai and the Qing River.

summary.zh: 1945年3月30日，日军攻占樊城。
summary.en: On 30 March 1945 the Japanese captured Fancheng.

description.zh: 1945年3月，日军第39师团、独立第5、第11旅团由荆门北犯，3月29日陷襄阳，30日占樊城。日军随后西犯谷城，策应老河口作战。维基记3月26日陷襄樊，正文并列。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与维基百科《豫西鄂北会战》。
description.en: In March 1945 the Japanese 39th Division and the 5th and 11th Independent Brigades advanced north from Jingmen, taking Xiangyang on 29 March and Fancheng on the 30th. The Japanese then moved west against Gucheng in support of the Laohekou operation. Wikipedia gives 26 March for Xiangyang–Fancheng; that variant is noted.

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第六编第三十五章第四节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-27

summary.zh: 1945年4月7日，日军攻占谷城，占领5天后撤退。
summary.en: On 7 April 1945 the Japanese captured Gucheng and withdrew five days later.

description.zh: 1945年4月7日，日军第39师团一部攻占谷城，至12日撤退，占领谷城5天。谷城为襄河以西要地，日军占谷城旨在策应老河口作战。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与襄阳日报《日军在襄阳地区的主要罪行》。
description.en: On 7 April 1945 a detachment of the Japanese 39th Division took Gucheng and withdrew on the 12th, occupying the town for five days. Gucheng was a key point west of the Han River, and the operation was intended to support the attack on Laohekou.

sources.title: 中国抗日战争全史·第六编第三十五章第四节
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-11-27

sources.title: 日军在襄阳地区的主要罪行
sources.author: 襄阳日报 2016-06-07

summary.zh: 1945年9月18日，第六战区司令长官孙蔚如在汉口接受日军第六方面军投降。
summary.en: On 18 September 1945 Sun Weiru, commander of the Chinese Sixth War Zone, accepted the surrender of the Japanese Sixth Area Army at Hankou.

description.zh: 1945年9月18日下午3时，第六战区司令长官孙蔚如在汉口中山公园受降堂接受日军第六方面军司令官冈部直三郎大将率属21万人投降。武汉受降区负责接受武汉、沙市、宜昌地区日军。受降事件不绘制进攻路线。日期据国家档案局《伟大胜利——中国受降档案》与人民网《1945，难忘的武汉之夏》。
description.en: At 3 p.m. on 18 September 1945 Sun Weiru, commander of the Chinese Sixth War Zone, accepted the surrender of Gen. Okabe Tasaburo, commander of the Japanese Sixth Area Army, and 210,000 troops at the surrender hall in Hankou’s Zhongshan Park. The Wuhan surrender zone covered Wuhan, Shashi and Yichang. No advance route is drawn for a surrender event.

sources.title: 伟大胜利——中国受降档案
sources.author: 国家档案局 2014-09-02

sources.title: 1945，难忘的武汉之夏——日本在汉投降始末
sources.author: 人民网/湖北日报 2014-09-03

name.en: Fall of the Xinqiang River Line

summary.zh: 1939年9月23日，日军第6、第13师团强渡新墙河，中国守军转移。
summary.en: On 23 September 1939 the Japanese 6th and 13th Divisions forced the Xinqiang River and the Chinese defenders withdrew.

description.zh: 1939年9月18日日军第6、第13师团进攻新墙河北岸，中国第52军第2、第195师胡春华营、史思华营死守，至20日北岸阵地全部陷落。23日凌晨，日军在飞机、重炮和毒气掩护下强渡新墙河，中国守军抗击至中午后转移。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）》与《记湘北会战》。
description.en: On 18 September 1939 the Japanese 6th and 13th Divisions attacked the north bank of the Xinqiang River; the Chinese 2nd and 195th Divisions’ Hu Chunhua and Shi Sihua battalions held to the last, and the north-bank positions fell by the 20th. In the early hours of the 23rd the Japanese crossed under air, artillery and gas cover, and the Chinese withdrew after fighting until noon.

sources.title: 湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2014-11-12

summary.zh: 1939年9月23日，日军第3师团上村支队在营田登陆，抄袭新墙河守军侧背。
summary.en: On 23 September 1939 the Uemura detachment of the Japanese 3rd Division landed at Yingtian, turning the Xinqiang River line.

description.zh: 1939年9月23日拂晓，日军第3师团上村支队在海军支援下于洞庭湖东岸营田登陆，抄袭新墙河守军侧背，营田当日失守。日军占领营田后13天内残杀百姓800余人、强奸妇女百人以上。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）》与《记湘北会战》。
description.en: At dawn on 23 September 1939 the Uemura detachment of the Japanese 3rd Division landed at Yingtian on the east shore of Dongting Lake with naval support, turning the Xinqiang River line; Yingtian fell the same day. In the following thirteen days the Japanese killed more than 800 civilians and raped over a hundred women.

sources.title: 湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2014-11-12

name.en: Fall of the Miluo River Line

summary.zh: 1939年9月26日，日军第6师团渡过汨罗江，进抵新市。
summary.en: On 26 September 1939 the Japanese 6th Division crossed the Miluo River and reached Xinshi.

description.zh: 1939年9月25日凌晨日军迫近汨罗江北岸，26日日军第6师团渡过汨罗江进抵新市，在营田登陆的第3师团上村支队突破中国第95师阵地向粤汉路前进。中国第9战区按“后退决战”方针向长沙以东转移。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）》与《记湘北会战》。
description.en: The Japanese reached the north bank of the Miluo in the early hours of 25 September 1939; on the 26th the 6th Division crossed and reached Xinshi, while the Uemura detachment from Yingtian broke the Chinese 95th Division and drove on the Canton–Hankou railway. The Chinese Ninth War Zone fell back east of Changsha under its “retreat and decisive battle” plan.

sources.title: 湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2014-11-12

summary.zh: 1939年9月29日，日军第33师团攻占平江，进抵长寿街、龙门厂。
summary.en: On 29 September 1939 the Japanese 33rd Division captured Pingjiang and reached Changshoujie and Longmenchang.

description.zh: 1939年9月22日日军第33师团自鄂南通城南犯，23日进占麦市、桃树港，29日攻占平江，进抵朱溪厂、龙门厂、长寿街。中国第20、第79军在献钟、南楼岭、桃树港一带夹击，日军未能与湘北主力会合。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）》与《记湘北会战》。
description.en: On 22 September 1939 the Japanese 33rd Division advanced south from Tongcheng in southern Hubei, took Maishi and Taoshugang on the 23rd, and captured Pingjiang on the 29th, reaching Zhuxichang, Longmenchang and Changshoujie. The Chinese 20th and 79th Corps counterattacked around Xianzhong and Nanluling, preventing a junction with the main force.

sources.title: 湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2014-11-12

summary.zh: 1939年9月30日，日军一部进抵长沙以北30公里的永安，为第一次长沙会战日军南侵最远点。
summary.en: On 30 September 1939 a Japanese column reached Yong’an, 30 km north of Changsha, the deepest penetration of the first Changsha campaign.

description.zh: 1939年9月28日日军第6师团在福临铺、金井遭中国第195师等部伏击，损失颇重；29日其主力进至桥头驿，一部进抵永安（距长沙30公里）。这是第一次长沙会战日军南侵最远点。10月1日日军开始撤退，至10月8日退回新墙河北岸。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）》与《记湘北会战》。
description.en: On 28 September 1939 the Japanese 6th Division was ambushed by the Chinese 195th Division at Fulingpu and Jinjing and suffered heavily; on the 29th its main force reached Qiaotouyi and a detachment reached Yong’an, 30 km from Changsha, the deepest point of the Japanese advance. The Japanese began withdrawing on 1 October and were back north of the Xinqiang by the 8th.

sources.title: 湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2014-11-12

summary.zh: 1941年9月7日，日军第6师团进攻岳阳大云山，第二次长沙会战拉开序幕。
summary.en: On 7 September 1941 the Japanese 6th Division attacked Dayun Mountain in Yueyang, opening the second Changsha campaign.

description.zh: 1941年9月7日晨，日军第6师团2个联队从忠防、西塘进攻岳阳大云山，中国第58军新11师、第4军第59师等部反击，10日收复大云山。日军以一部牵制中国5个师，主力已在岳阳正面集结，18日强渡新墙河。日期据光明网《9月7日：第二次长沙会战拉开序幕》与《长沙会战》。
description.en: On the morning of 7 September 1941 two regiments of the Japanese 6th Division attacked Dayun Mountain from Zhongfang and Xitang. The Chinese New 11th Division and 59th Division counterattacked and recovered the mountain on the 10th. The Japanese used this to pin five Chinese divisions while massing their main force at Yueyang, crossing the Xinqiang on the 18th.

sources.title: 抗日战争史上的今天：9月7日第二次长沙会战拉开序幕
sources.author: 光明网 2025-09-07

name.en: Second Fall of the Xinqiang River Line

summary.zh: 1941年9月18日，日军第3、第4、第6、第40师团强渡新墙河。
summary.en: On 18 September 1941 the Japanese 3rd, 4th, 6th and 40th Divisions forced the Xinqiang River.

description.zh: 1941年9月18日拂晓，日军第3、第4、第6、第40师团及荒木、早渊支队在320门火炮、50架飞机支援下，向新墙河南岸20公里正面发起总攻，中国第4军第102师阵地两小时内被突破，日军当晚占领黄沙街、大荆街。日期据光明网与《长沙会战》。
description.en: At dawn on 18 September 1941 the Japanese 3rd, 4th, 6th and 40th Divisions with the Araki and Hayabuchi detachments attacked a 20-km front south of the Xinqiang River with 320 guns and 50 aircraft. The Chinese 102nd Division’s line broke within two hours, and the Japanese took Huangshajie and Dajingjie that evening.

sources.title: 抗日战争史上的今天：9月7日第二次长沙会战拉开序幕
sources.author: 光明网 2025-09-07

name.en: Second Fall of the Miluo River Line

summary.zh: 1941年9月21日，日军主力强渡汨罗江，中国第37军转移。
summary.en: On 21 September 1941 the Japanese main force crossed the Miluo River and the Chinese 37th Corps withdrew.

description.zh: 1941年9月19日日军进抵汨罗江北岸，21日拂晓主力强渡汨罗江，中国第37军抗击后向捞刀河东南转移。日军因破译中国军队电报，改以主力包围汨罗江南岸守军。日期据光明网与《长沙会战》。
description.en: The Japanese reached the north bank of the Miluo on 19 September 1941 and crossed in force at dawn on the 21st. The Chinese 37th Corps resisted and then withdrew southeast of the Laodao River. Having broken Chinese codes, the Japanese switched their main effort to encircling the south-bank defenders.

sources.title: 抗日战争史上的今天：9月7日第二次长沙会战拉开序幕
sources.author: 光明网 2025-09-07

summary.zh: 1941年9月28日，日军早渊支队突入长沙市区，长沙一度失守。
summary.en: On 28 September 1941 the Japanese Hayabuchi detachment entered Changsha, which briefly fell.

description.zh: 1941年9月27日日军第4师团一部与早渊支队渡过捞刀河、浏阳河，28日早渊支队一部自长沙东北角突入城内，当晚全部进入长沙；29日第4师团主力亦开进长沙。日军因粮弹消耗、后方被切断，10月1日开始撤退，10月8日退回新墙河北岸。日期据光明网与《长沙会战》。
description.en: On 27 September 1941 parts of the Japanese 4th Division and the Hayabuchi detachment crossed the Laodao and Liuyang rivers; on the 28th the Hayabuchi detachment entered Changsha from the northeast, and the 4th Division’s main force followed on the 29th. With supplies exhausted and its rear cut, the Japanese withdrew from 1 October and were back north of the Xinqiang by the 8th.

sources.title: 抗日战争史上的今天：9月7日第二次长沙会战拉开序幕
sources.author: 光明网 2025-09-07

summary.zh: 1941年9月29日，日军第3师团一部攻入株洲。
summary.en: On 29 September 1941 a detachment of the Japanese 3rd Division entered Zhuzhou.

description.zh: 1941年9月29日凌晨，日军第3师团第29旅团攻入株洲，中国暂编第2军第8师在龙头铺、大观塘、荷塘铺一带反击，至29日10时将日军击破，日军向北撤退。株洲是第二次长沙会战日军南侵最南点。日期据株洲文明网与《长沙会战》。
description.en: In the early hours of 29 September 1941 the Japanese 3rd Division’s 29th Brigade entered Zhuzhou. The Chinese Provisional 8th Division counterattacked at Longtoupu, Daguantang and Hetangpu and by 10 a.m. had broken the Japanese, who withdrew north. Zhuzhou was the southernmost point of the Japanese advance in the second Changsha campaign.

sources.title: 重走昔日战场 还原株洲抗战第一仗
sources.author: 株洲文明网 2015-08-10

name.en: Fall of the Xinqiang River Line (December 1941)

summary.zh: 1941年12月24日，日军第3、第6、第40师团进攻新墙河，第三次长沙会战开始。
summary.en: On 24 December 1941 the Japanese 3rd, 6th and 40th Divisions attacked the Xinqiang River, opening the third Changsha campaign.

description.zh: 1941年12月24日，日军第11军以第3、第6、第40师团向新墙河发起进攻，中国第20军抗击后转移。日军随后强渡汨罗江，1942年1月1日进攻长沙，遭中国第10军等部顽强抵抗，1月4日撤退，1月15日退回新墙河北岸。日期据维基百科《第三次长沙会战》与《长沙会战》。
description.en: On 24 December 1941 the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Xinqiang River with the 3rd, 6th and 40th Divisions; the Chinese 20th Corps resisted and withdrew. The Japanese crossed the Miluo and attacked Changsha on 1 January 1942, but after stubborn resistance by the Chinese 10th Corps they withdrew on the 4th and were back north of the Xinqiang by the 15th.

name.en: Fall of the Miluo River Line (December 1941)

summary.zh: 1941年12月26日，日军渡过汨罗江，向长沙推进。
summary.en: On 26 December 1941 the Japanese crossed the Miluo River and advanced on Changsha.

description.zh: 1941年12月26日，日军第3、第6、第40师团渡过汨罗江，向长沙推进。中国第9战区按“天炉战法”逐次抵抗，诱敌至长沙外围。日期据维基百科《第三次长沙会战》与《长沙会战》。
description.en: On 26 December 1941 the Japanese 3rd, 6th and 40th Divisions crossed the Miluo River and advanced on Changsha. The Chinese Ninth War Zone fought a delaying action under its “heavenly furnace” plan, drawing the Japanese toward Changsha’s outskirts.

summary.zh: 1942年1月1日，日军第3、第6、第40师团进攻长沙，遭中国第10军顽强抵抗。
summary.en: On 1 January 1942 the Japanese 3rd, 6th and 40th Divisions attacked Changsha and met stubborn resistance from the Chinese 10th Corps.

description.zh: 1942年1月1日，日军第3、第6、第40师团进攻长沙，中国第10军依托城垣和岳麓山炮兵顽强抵抗，日军猛攻4日未能破城，1月4日撤退。中国军队追击，1月15日日军退回新墙河北岸。这是第三次长沙会战的转折点。日期据维基百科《第三次长沙会战》与《长沙会战》。
description.en: On 1 January 1942 the Japanese 3rd, 6th and 40th Divisions attacked Changsha. The Chinese 10th Corps, supported by artillery on Yuelu Mountain, held the city walls; after four days of assault the Japanese withdrew on 4 January. The Chinese pursued, and by 15 January the Japanese were back north of the Xinqiang. This was the turning point of the third Changsha campaign.

summary.zh: 1943年11月3日，日军第68师团户田支队攻占南县。
summary.en: On 3 November 1943 the Toda detachment of the Japanese 68th Division captured Nanxian.

description.zh: 1943年11月2日日军第11军分三路会攻常德，东路第68师团户田支队自华容、石首南犯，3日攻占南县，随后占三仙湖，进抵洞庭湖北岸。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。
description.en: On 2 November 1943 the Japanese 11th Army attacked Changde in three columns. The Toda detachment of the 68th Division advanced south from Huarong and Shishou, took Nanxian on the 3rd and Sanxianhu soon after, reaching the north shore of Dongting Lake.

sources.title: 湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2014-12-29

summary.zh: 1943年11月7日，日军攻占安乡。
summary.en: On 7 November 1943 the Japanese captured Anxiang.

description.zh: 1943年11月7日日军攻占安乡。安乡为洞庭湖西北门户，失守后日军东路由安乡、汉寿指向常德东南，切断常德守军退路。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。
description.en: On 7 November 1943 the Japanese took Anxiang, the northwestern gateway to Dongting Lake. The eastern column then drove via Anxiang and Hanshou toward Changde’s southeast, cutting the defenders’ retreat.

sources.title: 湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2014-12-29

summary.zh: 1943年11月15日，日军第3、第13师团攻陷石门。
summary.en: On 15 November 1943 the Japanese 3rd and 13th Divisions captured Shimen.

description.zh: 1943年11月13日日军第3、第13师团向石门进攻，中国第73军暂5师死守，师长彭士量在突围中殉国，15日晨石门失守。石门为常德西北屏障，失守后日军直趋慈利、桃源。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。
description.en: On 13 November 1943 the Japanese 3rd and 13th Divisions attacked Shimen. The Chinese Provisional 5th Division of the 73rd Corps held on; its commander Peng Shiliang was killed during the breakout, and Shimen fell on the morning of the 15th. The town was Changde’s northwestern shield, and its loss opened the way to Cili and Taoyuan.

sources.title: 湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2014-12-29

summary.zh: 1943年11月17日，日军第116师团攻占澧县。
summary.en: On 17 November 1943 the Japanese 116th Division captured Lixian.

description.zh: 1943年11月15日晚日军第116师团从澧县以北进攻，中国第44军第150师等部防守，17日澧县失守。日军随后经临澧向常德推进。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。
description.en: On the evening of 15 November 1943 the Japanese 116th Division attacked north of Lixian. The Chinese 150th Division of the 44th Corps defended the town, which fell on the 17th. The Japanese then advanced via Linli toward Changde.

sources.title: 湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2014-12-29

summary.zh: 1943年11月22日，日军第13师团攻占慈利。
summary.en: On 22 November 1943 the Japanese 13th Division captured Cili.

description.zh: 1943年11月17日日军第13师团分三路进攻慈利，中国第74军第58师在赤松山、慈利以南阵地抗击，18日慈利失守，22日日军主力进占慈利。慈利失守后，日军西路由慈利、桃源迂回常德西南。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。
description.en: On 17 November 1943 the Japanese 13th Division attacked Cili in three columns. The Chinese 58th Division of the 74th Corps fought at Chisong Mountain and south of Cili; the town fell on the 18th, and the Japanese main force occupied it on the 22nd. The western column then swung through Cili and Taoyuan to cut Changde’s southwest.

sources.title: 湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2014-12-29

summary.zh: 1943年11月22日，日军第3师团攻占桃源。
summary.en: On 22 November 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Taoyuan.

description.zh: 1943年11月19日日军第3师团主力由澧水南渡，直扑陬市、桃源，21日以伞兵配合攻占桃源，22日进占桃源县城并切断常德守军与第74军主力的联系。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。
description.en: On 19 November 1943 the main force of the Japanese 3rd Division crossed the Li River and drove on Zoushi and Taoyuan. On the 21st, with paratroopers, it took Taoyuan and on the 22nd occupied the county town, cutting the link between Changde’s defenders and the 74th Corps.

sources.title: 湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2014-12-29

summary.zh: 1943年12月3日，日军攻占常德，中国第57师大部殉国。
summary.en: On 3 December 1943 the Japanese captured Changde after the Chinese 57th Division was largely destroyed.

description.zh: 1943年11月24日日军环攻常德，中国第74军第57师师长余程万率部死守，激战至12月3日凌晨，守军弹尽粮绝，余程万率残部突围，常德沦陷。12月9日中国军队克复常德。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。
description.en: On 24 November 1943 the Japanese encircled and assaulted Changde. The Chinese 57th Division of the 74th Corps, commanded by Yu Chengwan, held on until the early hours of 3 December, when with ammunition and food exhausted Yu broke out with the survivors and the city fell. The Chinese recaptured Changde on 9 December.

sources.title: 湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2014-12-29

name.en: Fall of the Xinqiang River Line (1944)

summary.zh: 1944年5月28日，日军第68、第116师团渡过新墙河，长衡会战开始。
summary.en: On 28 May 1944 the Japanese 68th and 116th Divisions crossed the Xinqiang River, opening the Changsha–Hengyang campaign.

description.zh: 1944年5月27日日军第11军分三路南犯，中路第68、第116师团于28日上午渡过新墙河，中国第20军抗击后向平江以东山区转移。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。
description.en: On 27 May 1944 the Japanese 11th Army advanced south in three columns; the central 68th and 116th Divisions crossed the Xinqiang on the morning of the 28th. The Chinese 20th Corps resisted and withdrew to the hills east of Pingjiang.

sources.title: 长衡会战
sources.author: 华声在线/抗日战争纪念网 2019-08-14

sources.title: 抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究
sources.author: 台湾国防部

summary.zh: 1944年6月1日，日军第13师团攻占平江。
summary.en: On 1 June 1944 the Japanese 13th Division captured Pingjiang.

description.zh: 1944年5月29日日军东路第3、第13师团突破通城，6月1日攻占平江，随后向浏阳、株洲方向迂回。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。
description.en: On 29 May 1944 the Japanese eastern 3rd and 13th Divisions broke through Tongcheng and on 1 June took Pingjiang, then swung toward Liuyang and Zhuzhou.

sources.title: 长衡会战
sources.author: 华声在线/抗日战争纪念网 2019-08-14

sources.title: 抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究
sources.author: 台湾国防部

summary.zh: 1944年6月5日，日军第40师团攻占沅江。
summary.en: On 5 June 1944 the Japanese 40th Division captured Yuanjiang.

description.zh: 1944年5月28日日军西路第40师团自华容南犯，6月1日夜在赤山半岛以西登陆，6月5日攻占沅江，12日攻占益阳。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。
description.en: On 28 May 1944 the Japanese western 40th Division advanced south from Huarong, landed west of Chishan Peninsula on the night of 1 June, took Yuanjiang on the 5th and Yiyang on the 12th.

sources.title: 长衡会战
sources.author: 华声在线/抗日战争纪念网 2019-08-14

sources.title: 抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究
sources.author: 台湾国防部

summary.zh: 1944年6月12日，日军第40师团攻占益阳。
summary.en: On 12 June 1944 the Japanese 40th Division captured Yiyang.

description.zh: 1944年6月12日日军第40师团攻占益阳，随后向宁乡进攻。中国第24集团军第73、第79军对日军实施钳形攻击，益阳一度被中国军队收复。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。
description.en: On 12 June 1944 the Japanese 40th Division took Yiyang and advanced on Ningxiang. The Chinese 73rd and 79th Corps of the 24th Group Army counterattacked in a pincer, and Yiyang was briefly recovered.

sources.title: 长衡会战
sources.author: 华声在线/抗日战争纪念网 2019-08-14

sources.title: 抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究
sources.author: 台湾国防部

summary.zh: 1944年6月8日，日军第58师团攻占湘阴。
summary.en: On 8 June 1944 the Japanese 58th Division captured Xiangyin.

description.zh: 1944年6月8日日军第58师团第52旅团经汨罗镇、望城坡攻占湘阴。湘阴为长沙北面水陆要地，失守后日军从北面逼近长沙。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。
description.en: On 8 June 1944 the 52nd Brigade of the Japanese 58th Division advanced via Miluo and Wangchengpo to take Xiangyin, the water-and-land gateway north of Changsha. Its fall brought the Japanese to Changsha’s northern approaches.

sources.title: 长衡会战
sources.author: 华声在线/抗日战争纪念网 2019-08-14

sources.title: 抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究
sources.author: 台湾国防部

summary.zh: 1944年6月14日，日军第3师团攻占浏阳。
summary.en: On 14 June 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Liuyang.

description.zh: 1944年6月14日23时30分，日军第3师团攻占浏阳。此前第13师团从浏阳东南迂回，第68师团从镇头攻向普迹，形成合围。浏阳失守后，日军从东南面威胁长沙、株洲。日期据《长衡会战》与《日军侵华战争》。
description.en: At 11:30 p.m. on 14 June 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division took Liuyang, after the 13th Division had swung around its southeast and the 68th Division advanced from Zhentou. Its fall threatened Changsha and Zhuzhou from the southeast.

sources.title: 长衡会战
sources.author: 华声在线/抗日战争纪念网 2019-08-14

sources.title: 抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究
sources.author: 台湾国防部

summary.zh: 1944年6月20日，日军攻占株洲。
summary.en: On 20 June 1944 the Japanese captured Zhuzhou.

description.zh: 1944年6月20日，日军在攻占长沙后沿粤汉铁路南下，先后攻占醴陵、株洲、渌口、湘潭。株洲为粤汉、湘黔铁路交点，失守后日军打开南下衡阳的通道。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。
description.en: On 20 June 1944, after taking Changsha, the Japanese advanced south along the Canton–Hankou railway and took Liling, Zhuzhou, Lukou and Xiangtan in succession. Zhuzhou was the junction of the Canton–Hankou and Hunan–Guizhou railways; its fall opened the way to Hengyang.

sources.title: 长衡会战
sources.author: 华声在线/抗日战争纪念网 2019-08-14

sources.title: 抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究
sources.author: 台湾国防部

summary.zh: 1944年6月20日，日军攻占湘潭。
summary.en: On 20 June 1944 the Japanese captured Xiangtan.

description.zh: 1944年6月20日，日军在攻占株洲的同时攻占湘潭。湘潭为湘江两岸要地，失守后日军沿湘江两岸南下衡阳。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。
description.en: On 20 June 1944 the Japanese took Xiangtan together with Zhuzhou. Xiangtan commanded both banks of the Xiang River; its fall opened the advance south toward Hengyang.

sources.title: 长衡会战
sources.author: 华声在线/抗日战争纪念网 2019-08-14

sources.title: 抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究
sources.author: 台湾国防部

summary.zh: 1944年6月24日，日军东路攻占攸县。
summary.en: On 24 June 1944 the Japanese eastern column captured Youxian.

description.zh: 1944年6月24日，日军东路第3、第13师团南下攻占攸县、安仁、耒阳，迂回衡阳东南。中国第9战区一度收复攸县、官田，7月15日以后日军再陷攸县。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。
description.en: On 24 June 1944 the Japanese eastern 3rd and 13th Divisions drove south and took Youxian, Anren and Leiyang, swinging around Hengyang’s southeast. The Chinese Ninth War Zone briefly recovered Youxian and Guantian, but the Japanese retook Youxian after 15 July.

sources.title: 长衡会战
sources.author: 华声在线/抗日战争纪念网 2019-08-14

sources.title: 抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究
sources.author: 台湾国防部

summary.zh: 1944年6月24日，日军东路攻占耒阳。
summary.en: On 24 June 1944 the Japanese eastern column captured Leiyang.

description.zh: 1944年6月24日，日军东路第3、第13师团攻占耒阳，迂回至衡阳东南约60公里。耒阳为粤汉铁路要地，失守后日军完成对衡阳的东南包围。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。
description.en: On 24 June 1944 the Japanese eastern 3rd and 13th Divisions took Leiyang, swinging to about 60 km southeast of Hengyang. Leiyang was a key point on the Canton–Hankou railway; its fall completed the southeastern encirclement of Hengyang.

sources.title: 长衡会战
sources.author: 华声在线/抗日战争纪念网 2019-08-14

sources.title: 抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究
sources.author: 台湾国防部

summary.zh: 1945年4月16日，日军第34师团、第68师团第58旅团攻占新宁。
summary.en: On 16 April 1945 the Japanese 34th Division and 58th Brigade of the 68th Division captured Xinning.

description.zh: 1945年4月上旬，日军第34师团及第68师团第58旅团分由东安、全县向新宁进犯，4月12日进攻新宁，中国第74军第58师一个营坚守3日，15日日军增援，16日新宁失守。日期据《湘西会战大事记》与维基百科《湘西会战》。
description.en: In early April 1945 the Japanese 34th Division and the 58th Brigade of the 68th Division advanced on Xinning from Dong’an and Quanxian. They attacked on 12 April; a battalion of the Chinese 58th Division held for three days, but after Japanese reinforcements arrived Xinning fell on the 16th.

summary.zh: 1945年4月21日，日军第116师团攻占洞口。
summary.en: On 21 April 1945 the Japanese 116th Division captured Dongkou.

description.zh: 1945年4月21日，日军第116师团第133联队猛攻洞口，中国守军第74军第57师一部抵抗后撤退，洞口失守。洞口为湘黔公路要隘，失守后日军直逼雪峰山主阵地。日期据《湘西会战大事记》与维基百科《湘西会战》。
description.en: On 21 April 1945 the 133rd Regiment of the Japanese 116th Division stormed Dongkou; part of the Chinese 57th Division of the 74th Corps resisted and withdrew, and the town fell. Dongkou was a key pass on the Hunan–Guizhou highway, and its loss brought the Japanese to the main Xuefeng Mountain positions.

summary.zh: 1945年4月27日，日军第68师团围攻武冈，中国守军坚守至5月7日解围。
summary.en: On 27 April 1945 the Japanese 68th Division besieged Wugang; the Chinese garrison held out until relieved on 7 May.

description.zh: 1945年4月27日，日军第68师团3000余人围攻武冈，中国第74军第58师一个加强营依托糯米三合土城墙坚守，至5月7日中国第121师、第44师增援，内外夹击，日军撤退，武冈解围。日期据《湘西会战大事记》与维基百科《湘西会战》。
description.en: On 27 April 1945 more than 3,000 Japanese of the 68th Division besieged Wugang. A reinforced battalion of the Chinese 58th Division held the walls, built with glutinous-rice mortar, until the Chinese 121st and 44th Divisions arrived on 7 May and attacked from inside and outside; the Japanese withdrew and the siege was lifted.

summary.zh: 1945年4月29日，日军第68师团第58旅团攻占武阳。
summary.en: On 29 April 1945 the 58th Brigade of the Japanese 68th Division captured Wuyang.

description.zh: 1945年4月26日日军第68师团第58旅团进攻武阳，中国第74军第58师第174团9连苦战4昼夜，全连殉国，29日武阳失守。5月1日中国第94军第5师克复武阳，歼敌1500余人。日期据《湘西会战大事记》与维基百科《湘西会战》。
description.en: On 26 April 1945 the 58th Brigade of the Japanese 68th Division attacked Wuyang. The 9th Company of the Chinese 174th Regiment, 58th Division, fought for four days and was wiped out; Wuyang fell on the 29th. On 1 May the Chinese 5th Division of the 94th Corps retook Wuyang, killing more than 1,500 Japanese.

summary.zh: 1945年9月15日，第四方面军司令官王耀武在长沙接受日军第20军投降。
summary.en: On 15 September 1945 Wang Yaowu, commander of the Chinese Fourth Front Army, accepted the surrender of the Japanese 20th Army at Changsha.

description.zh: 1945年9月15日，第四方面军司令官王耀武在长沙岳麓山湖南大学科学馆接受日军第20军司令官坂西一良中将投降。长衡岳受降区负责接受长沙、衡阳、岳阳地区日军，日军第20军、第64、第68、第116师团及独立第17、第81、第82旅团等部约7万人投降。受降事件不绘制进攻路线。日期据湖南省档案局《湖南地区日军受降报告书档案》与《人民日报海外版》受降档案。
description.en: On 15 September 1945 Wang Yaowu, commander of the Fourth Front Army, accepted the surrender of Lt. Gen. Sakanishi Ichiro, commander of the Japanese 20th Army, at the Hunan University science building on Yuelu Mountain in Changsha. The Changsha–Hengyang–Yueyang surrender zone covered some 70,000 Japanese troops of the 20th Army, the 64th, 68th and 116th Divisions and the 17th, 81st and 82nd Independent Brigades. No advance route is drawn for a surrender event.

sources.title: 湖南地区日军受降报告书档案

sources.title: 伟大胜利——中国受降档案（长衡区）
sources.author: 人民日报海外版 2014-09-05

summary.zh: 1939年11月15日，日军第5师团、台湾混成旅团在钦州湾登陆，桂南会战开始。
summary.en: On 15 November 1939 the Japanese 5th Division and Taiwan Mixed Brigade landed at Qinzhou Bay, opening the southern Guangxi campaign.

description.zh: 1939年11月15日，日军第21军司令官安藤利吉指挥第5师团、台湾混成旅团及海军陆战队3万余人，在钦州湾龙门港、企沙强行登陆。中国新编第19师抵抗一天后溃退，日军登陆后即分路北上，直指南宁。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。
description.en: On 15 November 1939 Lt. Gen. Ando Rikichi’s 21st Army, with the 5th Division, the Taiwan Mixed Brigade and naval landing troops—over 30,000 men—forced a landing at Longmen and Qisha in Qinzhou Bay. The Chinese New 19th Division held for a day and then collapsed; the Japanese advanced north toward Nanning.

sources.title: “桂南会战”的回顾与反思
sources.author: 钦州军分区，抗日战争纪念网 2016-06-22

sources.title: 桂南会战之昆仑关战役
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-04-09

summary.zh: 1939年11月16日，日军占领防城。
summary.en: On 16 November 1939 the Japanese occupied Fangcheng.

description.zh: 1939年11月16日日军占领防城。防城为钦州湾登陆后第一个县城，失守后日军沿钦防公路北上，17日占钦县。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。
description.en: On 16 November 1939 the Japanese took Fangcheng, the first county town after the Qinzhou Bay landing. They then advanced north along the Qinzhou–Fangcheng road and took Qin County on the 17th.

sources.title: “桂南会战”的回顾与反思
sources.author: 钦州军分区，抗日战争纪念网 2016-06-22

sources.title: 桂南会战之昆仑关战役
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-04-09

summary.zh: 1939年11月17日，日军占领钦县（今钦州）。
summary.en: On 17 November 1939 the Japanese occupied Qin County (modern Qinzhou).

description.zh: 1939年11月17日日军占领钦县（今钦州），随即分兵北上，18日进攻小董。钦县为钦州湾登陆后的交通枢纽，失守后日军沿邕钦公路直指南宁。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。
description.en: On 17 November 1939 the Japanese took Qin County (modern Qinzhou), then divided their force and advanced north, attacking Xiaodong on the 18th. Qin County was the transport hub after the landing, and its loss opened the road along the Yong–Qin highway to Nanning.

sources.title: “桂南会战”的回顾与反思
sources.author: 钦州军分区，抗日战争纪念网 2016-06-22

sources.title: 桂南会战之昆仑关战役
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-04-09

summary.zh: 1939年11月18日，日军进攻小董，中国新编第19师溃退。
summary.en: On 18 November 1939 the Japanese attacked Xiaodong and the Chinese New 19th Division collapsed.

description.zh: 1939年11月18日日军进攻中国新编第19师师部所在地小董，师长黄固临阵退缩，只身逃跑，部队溃散。日军继续北上，22日傍晚抵达南宁邕江南岸。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。
description.en: On 18 November 1939 the Japanese attacked Xiaodong, headquarters of the Chinese New 19th Division. Its commander Huang Gu fled alone and the division collapsed. The Japanese continued north and reached the south bank of the Yong River at Nanning on the evening of the 22nd.

sources.title: “桂南会战”的回顾与反思
sources.author: 钦州军分区，抗日战争纪念网 2016-06-22

sources.title: 桂南会战之昆仑关战役
sources.author: 抗日战争纪念网 2017-04-09

summary.zh: 1939年12月1日，日军攻占高峰隘。
summary.en: On 1 December 1939 the Japanese captured Gaofeng Pass.

description.zh: 1939年11月26日起日军在飞机掩护下猛攻高峰隘，中国守军顽强抵抗，12月1日高峰隘失守。高峰隘为南宁至武鸣要冲，失守后南宁北面门户洞开。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。
description.en: From 26 November 1939 the Japanese attacked Gaofeng Pass under air cover. The Chinese resisted stubbornly, but the pass fell on 1 December. Gaofeng was the key point on the Nanning–Wuming road; its loss opened Nanning’s northern approaches.

sources.title: “桂南会战”的回顾与反思
